* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Deep experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building AI applications.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape, designing comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation, actively coding, building, and deploy cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions such as agentic workflows, Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and applied foundation models, backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value, ensuring all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

### **Program Manager – Job Description**


### **Overview**


We are seeking an accomplished Program Manager to lead large\-scale, complex IT services programs spanning cloud, data, platform, and enterprise application landscapes. This role carries end\-to\-end ownership of program outcomes — balancing hands\-on delivery execution with strategic portfolio alignment across multiple concurrent engagements for internal stakeholders and external clients. The ideal candidate brings both program governance rigor and a **product engineering mindset** — understanding the technical architecture underneath delivery, not just the schedule on top of it.

  

Skills Required:
Program Manager


Role:
### **Key Responsibilities**


**Program Leadership \& Delivery**


* Own end\-to\-end delivery across scope, schedule, cost, and quality — consistently meeting client satisfaction and business outcome targets.
* Establish and govern Agile/hybrid program frameworks, metrics, and tooling (Jira, executive dashboards, status reporting) across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Provide oversight across multi\-vendor, cross\-geography teams, ensuring consistent delivery standards and accountability.

**Product \& Technical Ownership**


* Apply a product development mindset to program delivery — thinking in terms of releases, technical debt, platform scalability, and long\-term maintainability rather than just milestone dates.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to understand system design trade\-offs (cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, integration architecture) well enough to make informed scope, sequencing, and risk calls.
* Own technical roadmap alignment — ensuring program plans reflect realistic engineering constraints (CI/CD maturity, environment readiness, tech debt, dependency mapping across microservices/platforms).
* Drive quality engineering practices across programs — test automation coverage, release readiness gates, defect leakage, and production stability metrics.
* Guide build\-vs\-buy and platform modernization decisions (e.g., cloud migration, data platform re\-architecture) in collaboration with technical leadership.
* Champion DevOps and SDLC maturity — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/CloudFormation), observability, and automated deployment practices across program teams.
* Maintain working fluency in the technology stacks in play (cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP, data platforms like Snowflake/Databricks, integration/API layers) sufficient to challenge estimates, de\-risk technical dependencies, and speak credibly with client engineering teams.

**Strategic \& Portfolio Management**


* Drive strategic planning and portfolio prioritization, aligning programs with organizational goals and client transformation roadmaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and clients, translating business objectives into executable, outcome\-driven program roadmaps.
* Shape enterprise\-scale program governance structures, risk management frameworks, and escalation mechanisms.

**Financial \& Commercial Governance**


* Own financial governance across program budgeting, forecasting, revenue assurance, and margin optimization.
* Oversee contract execution, including SOW compliance, change management, commercial negotiations, and cross\-vendor dependencies.

**Stakeholder \& Client Management**


* Own client communication at executive and steering committee levels — proactively managing expectations, risks, and escalations.
* Build and sustain trusted relationships with client and internal leadership, serving as the primary point of accountability for program health.

**Generative AI \& Innovation**


* Define and drive enterprise adoption of Generative AI for program governance, predictive risk analysis, intelligent status reporting, and data\-driven decision\-making across delivery portfolios.
* Evaluate and pilot AI\-assisted engineering tools (code generation, automated testing, agentic workflows) to improve delivery velocity and quality across programs.
* Establish responsible AI usage standards within program management practices and mentor delivery teams on effective, scaled adoption.

**Team Leadership**


* Lead, mentor, and develop cross\-functional and matrixed delivery teams, fostering a high\-performance, accountable delivery culture.
* Build organizational capability by coaching program and project managers on governance best practices, technical literacy, and stakeholder management.
Experience:
14 to 18 years

534753a0.description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI\-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud\-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.


**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced **Lead Technology Program Manager** to drive the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives that support strategic business priorities and customer commitments.


In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Business teams to plan, coordinate, and execute large\-scale programs.


The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, executive communication skills, technical acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex matrix organization. This leader will manage strategic customer initiatives and technology programs, cross\-functional dependencies, risks, financial planning, and executive reporting while ensuring delivery against business objectives.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Program Planning and Execution**

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of complex technology programs and strategic initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, and milestone tracking.
* Coordinate activities across multiple product, engineering, and business teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Track program progress and drive timely resolution of issues that may impact delivery commitments.

### **Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Customer\-facing teams to align priorities and execution plans.
* Facilitate cross\-functional discussions to manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and resolve conflicts.
* Drive accountability across stakeholders while fostering a collaborative and results\-oriented environment.

### **Governance and Communication**

* Establish and manage program governance processes, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms.
* Prepare and deliver clear, concise program status updates for leadership reviews.
* Communicate key milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Ensure transparency into program health and delivery progress.

### **Risk and Dependency Management**

* Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, issues, and interdependencies.
* Develop mitigation plans and coordinate execution of corrective actions.
* Escalate critical issues with clear recommendations and supporting data.

### **Customer and Business Alignment**

* Support strategic customer initiatives and business\-critical programs.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand objectives, requirements, and success criteria.
* Ensure business priorities are reflected in program planning and execution activities.

### **Continuous Improvement**

* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled program management best practices, tools, and processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery predictability, operational efficiency, and team effectiveness.
* Contribute to organizational learning through lessons learned, retrospective reviews, and process enhancements.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in Technology Program Management, Project Management, Product Delivery, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience leading large, cross\-functional technology initiatives in a matrixed organization.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a data\-driven approach to decision making.
* Experience managing program risks, dependencies, and executive communications.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting strategic customer programs, airline technology, travel technology, distribution platforms, or digital commerce solutions.
* Experience working across globally distributed teams.
* Familiarity with Agile frameworks, Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or similar delivery management tools.
* PMP, Agile, SAFe, or equivalent project/program management certification.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced technology environment undergoing transformation and growth.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

Success in this role will be measured by:


* Delivery of committed program milestones and objectives.
* Effective management of risks, dependencies, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Improved visibility and predictability of program execution.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and confidence in program governance.
* Achievement of customer and business outcomes.
* Contribution to continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.

**Why Join Us**

3bf961d5.title: Technical Program Manager
3bf961d5.description:
You own real programs across our enterprise tech landscape and drive them from ambiguity to Go\-Live. Global stakeholders, hard dependencies, real budgets, no script. We hand you the outcome and get out of your way.
 



  





 We're a small, senior team that takes craft seriously:
 


* Clean architecture
* Documentation people actually read
* Process that speeds work up, not down
* People we don't have to manage, and then don't



  





**What you'll own** 



* Delivery across multiple concurrent programs: scope, timeline, budget
* Cross\-project dependencies, risks, and the bottlenecks nobody flagged
* Scope and change control: assess change request impact, re\-baseline cleanly, stop scope drift
* Stakeholders across Cloud, Security, Compliance, Infrastructure, Architecture, Application, and Business teams (global and zonal)
* Third\-party and vendor coordination where programs depend on external partners
* Governance through SIT, UAT, Cutover, Go\-Live, and Hypercare, including release and production change control
* RAID and decision logs that stay current
* Resource and effort coordination across your programs
* Delivery quality against governance, audit, and compliance requirements
* Exec and steering committee reporting that drives decisions, not just informs
* Financials: Budget vs. LE, forecasts, variance
* Delivery templates and playbooks so the next program starts ahead



  





**What you bring** 



* 3 to 8 years delivering technology programs in large, complex enterprise environments
* Track record running several programs at once and landing them
* Range across Cloud, Infra, Security, Architecture, Applications, Compliance
* Command of governance, dependency, risk, issue, and scope\-change management
* Delivery through SIT, UAT, cutover, go\-live, and hypercare
* Vendor and third\-party delivery coordination
* Financial fluency: budgeting, forecasting, variance, plus Excel and Power BI
* PPM/PM tooling (e.g. Planview, Clarity, ServiceNow, Jira Align, MS Project)
* Technical depth to challenge a bad assumption in the room (not a hands\-on engineering role)
* Comfort when the path isn't drawn for you yet



  





**A plus, not a filter** 



* MBA
* PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe
* Global org experience
* Supply chain, manufacturing, or logistics background



  





**How we actually work** 



* We don't wait to be told
* We own outcomes and challenge assumptions
* We escalate early and close issues, not just report them open
* We write things down
* We build for the next person, not the hero moment



  





 If you want narrow tasks and a manager checking your work, you'll hate it here.
 



 If you've been the one quietly holding a messy program together and wishing someone would let you run it, this is that seat.

cc9f5240.description:
**Description**
 We are hiring Program Managers to run complex and cross functional supply chain projects. This role is a part of the centralized supply chain planning function at Amazon India. The role is very much like an internal consulting role where the incumbent will drive large high impact projects in supply chain. These projects will typically involve designing and building complex new processes, driving technology solutions, driving large cost reduction or efficiency improvement initiatives or launching exciting new supply chain models.
   

  

 The incumbent will be own the following \-
   

  

* They will be responsible for working with finance, supply chain execution, transportation and other Amazon teams to identify pain points and scope out large high impact projects
* They will be responsible for driving cost benefit analysis and go/no\-go decisions on various initiatives
* Once a go decision is made, the program manager will work to evolve a plan and timeline for execution.
* The program manager will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure progress of the initiative they own. They will also own writing reports/documents that detail the progress to leadership on a frequent basis
* They will liaise across functions to drive their project and help clear issues and bottlenecks.
* They will work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed


 Above all, we expect program managers to be single threaded owners for their initiatives. This is a high ownership position where you directly control your destiny.
   

  

 Program Managers will be measured on the impact of their project. Depending on the project, clear financial or other impact goals will be set forth. It is the program manager's responsibility to ensure they drive the program towards achieving those goals.

* 2\+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

7641aabe.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
7641aabe.description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE** 
 Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for financial risk management of banks and the financial services industry. We provide web\-based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents. We help more than 75\+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
   

  

* Attend client requirement discussions and understand business, functional, and solution needs.
* Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, workshops, and presentations for prospective customers.
* Prepare and submit responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other proposal\-related documentation.
* Prepare solution decks, product write\-ups, proposal content, business presentations, and customer\-facing collateral.
* Provide content support for certifications, ratings, analyst questionnaires, industry assessments, and related submissions.
* Work collaboratively with Field Sales, Sales Operations, Inside Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to support sales opportunities.
* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.
* Travel to customer locations for meetings, demonstrations, workshops, and business development activities as required


**Required Skills**
*Functional*
* Good understanding of banking and financial services industry.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities.
* Exposure to Treasury, ALM, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk, IRRBB, FTP, Basel II/III, Stress Testing, or related risk management areas is desirable.
* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.


**Other Essential Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, listening, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across multiple teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Flexible and positive approach to work with willingness to travel based on business requirements.


**Preferred Experience**
* Prior experience in software product pre\-sales, solution consulting, business consulting, or client\-facing product demonstrations.
* Prior exposure to Financial Risk Management products or banking product pre\-sales will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, fintech organizations, or enterprise software companies is preferred

 As the AI Solutions Architect – Legal, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise AI solutions that transform how Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and Regulatory stakeholders operate. You will be responsible for translating complex legal business challenges into scalable, secure, governed, and production ready AI solutions that integrate seamlessly with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms, legal workflow tools, enterprise systems, and authoritative systems of record.
   

  

 This is a hands on architecture role, not a purely advisory position. In addition to owning solution architecture and technical direction, you will actively design, develop, validate, and deploy production ready AI capabilities, reference implementations, integrations, and workflow automation solutions.
   

  

 You will establish architecture patterns, guide platform and technology decisions, evaluate buy versus build opportunities, and ensure AI is embedded into governed and auditable legal processes. Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to influence stakeholders across Legal, IT, Security, Compliance, Procurement, and enterprise technology teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Technical Leadership**
* Architect end\-to\-end AI enabled legal solutions spanning intake, contract lifecycle management, compliance workflows, legal operations, document intelligence, and post signature insights.
* Translate business challenges into scalable technical architectures, including application design, workflow orchestration, integration patterns, data flows, security controls, AI services, and deployment models.
* Define solution blueprints, reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and technical standards for Legal AI initiatives.
* Lead architecture reviews and technical decision making across legal technology platforms, enterprise systems, and AI capabilities.
* Drive technology strategy and roadmap recommendations for legal workflow automation and AI enabled legal operations.


**AI Solution Design \& Delivery**
* Design and deliver production ready AI agents, copilots, orchestration services, APIs, and automation solutions that solve legal business challenges.
* Develop AI enabled capabilities supporting contract analysis, clause extraction, obligation tracking, document summarization, compliance validation, legal intake, risk identification, and workflow acceleration.
* Design and implement agentic and multi agent architectures that integrate intelligence services into governed legal workflows.
* Establish evaluation frameworks, monitoring patterns, observability standards, and performance metrics to ensure reliable AI solution operation.
* Lead architecture decisions regarding model selection, orchestration approaches, retrieval strategies, and enterprise AI integration patterns.


**Enterprise Integration \& Platform Architecture**
* Design secure, scalable integrations between AI capabilities, CLM platforms, workflow tools, enterprise applications, and systems of record.
* Define integration patterns that maintain proper separation between:
+ AI reasoning and intelligence layers
+ Workflow orchestration platforms
+ Business applications
+ Data services
+ Systems of record

* Ensure legal systems retain authoritative ownership of records, approvals, contracts, and compliance workflows while AI capabilities augment decision making and productivity.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, platform engineering, and security teams to establish scalable solution patterns.


**Buy vs. Build \& Vendor Evaluation**
* Lead buy versus build assessments for Legal AI capabilities and workflow solutions.
* Evaluate vendors, platforms, and emerging technologies against business requirements, integration complexity, risk, security, scalability, and total cost of ownership considerations.
* Provide technical due diligence, architecture recommendations, implementation estimates, and adoption strategies for legal technology investments.
* Partner with vendors and implementation teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards.


**Governance, Security \& Responsible AI**
* Establish architecture standards supporting Responsible AI, security, privacy, regulatory compliance, auditability, and enterprise governance requirements.
* Design controls and guardrails that ensure AI solutions operate safely within regulated legal and compliance processes.
* Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, and Legal stakeholders to incorporate governance requirements into solution designs.
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for data protection, access control, monitoring, resiliency, and operational support.


**Technical Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Provide architecture leadership, technical mentorship, and implementation guidance to engineers, data scientists, and solution teams.
* Lead technical design reviews and establish engineering best practices for AI development and deployment.
* Drive adoption of reusable components, reference implementations, and enterprise solution standards.
* Influence cross functional teams through technical expertise, strategic thinking, and collaborative leadership.
* Serve as the primary technical authority for Legal AI architecture and solution design.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise software, workflow, integration, or AI enabled solutions in production environments.
* Proven experience serving as a Solution Architect, Lead Engineer, Technical Architect, or comparable technical leadership role.
* Strong hands on software engineering experience with the ability to personally design, develop, test, and deploy production ready solutions.
* Extensive experience building AI enabled applications leveraging large language models, agentic architectures, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and enterprise AI services.
* Demonstrated experience architecting enterprise workflows that span multiple business systems, applications, data sources, and organizational stakeholders.
* Strong proficiency with Python, API design, integration patterns, cloud native development, and modern software architecture principles.
* Experience leveraging AI assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate software delivery and solution development.
* Proven ability to make architecture tradeoff decisions balancing business value, technical complexity, security, scalability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills with the ability to engage technical teams, business stakeholders, legal professionals, and executive leadership.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing or architecting solutions for Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), legal operations, compliance, procurement, regulatory affairs, or enterprise workflow automation.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Agiloft, Eudia, ServiceNow, GEP, Harvey AI or similar legal technology ecosystems.
* Experience designing AI solutions for:
+ Contract review and analysis
+ Clause and obligation extraction
+ Legal research support
+ Compliance validation
+ Legal intake and matter routing
+ Marketing compliance workflows
+ Procurement contracting

* Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks, integration platforms, API management, and workflow orchestration platforms.
* Experience implementing Responsible AI, AI governance, model evaluation, and enterprise AI monitoring practices.
* Familiarity with security, privacy, auditability, and risk management requirements associated with regulated business processes.
* Experience influencing platform, vendor, and architecture decisions at enterprise scale.


**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

259ba6d8.title: Solution Architect
259ba6d8.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Solution Architect**
**EY Enterprise Technology**
 EY Enterprise Technology group specific in the Digital Experience area is working on implementing EY Specific products on the EYDxP powered by Adobe platform that consists of the Adobe CX Stack including but not limited to Adobe Workfront; AEM; AEP; Target; Analytics; AJO.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Adobe Platform team is looking for an Architect that is able to assist the Agile Workstream in developing a solution and road maps that meets the business needs. The role will be involved in planning, designing and overseeing the construction of projects and systems. You will be involved in new designs, extensions, and enhancements of feature pertaining to the Adobe platform. The goal of this role is to design a solution that both is functionally and architecturally in the right direction to support the business need but aligns as close as possible to the out of box functionality.
   

  

 The Solution Architect is responsible for the architectural leadership and delivery of architecture for projects working under the direction of the Lead Architect. Makes certain the alignment of the IT Strategy to the broader organization's mission, strategy / objectives, capabilities, and processes using industry recognized architectural models. Expands the company's use of technology as a strategic enabler of goals and objectives, realizing global business benefits whilst empowering local service innovation. Responsible for coordination and delivery of important and complex future planning activities to enable key business service, process, organizational and technology initiatives. They engage directly with business sponsors to conceptualize architectural approaches, develop solution architectures to confirm that the proposed architecture will meet the defined business needs. They validate that the engineering design will satisfy the architectural solution. Guides and mentors’ teams on methodologies, processes and best practices according to EY’s Architecture Frameworks and supports the development and maintenance of these frameworks and approaches, including technical / functional logical modelling, architecture governance, and tooling. Associate directors execute on the maturity plan developed by EA leadership intended to enable delivery of seamless, end\-to\-end Enterprise Architecture Services.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Day\-to\-day, this role will:
   

  

* Aligns and communicates clear architecture plans, driving towards the appropriate balance of cost, risk and quality, and effectively and consistently communicates this to stakeholders
* Works with Architecture team to set architectural direction, builds consensus, mediates conflicts, and helps to create an environment which solicits positive contributions from all participants, including Enterprise Architects, engineering teams, project managers, business analysts, test teams, Information Security and Operations
* Architect solutions that leverage data, analytics, and AI\-driven capabilities (e.g., customer profiles, personalization, and orchestration) while ensuring responsible use, governance, and scalability.
* Enforces architecture governance structures, methodologies (architecture and engineering) and compliance activities to maintain regulatory compliance and enterprise standards
* Communicate feedback to the EA leadership team that helps improve and evolve the quality and type of EA services provided
* Overseas communication of the value and promoting usage and harvesting of EA asset content, it is leveraging via logical frameworks and use in enterprise\-wide road\-mapping
* Develops recommendations regarding enterprise architecture tools and strategies to support the continuing improvement of EA, defining their potential impacts or benefits
* Cultivate and build relationships across business, IT and vendors / analysts to gather intelligence and bring insight into the wider enterprise picture and enable the leveraging of emerging industry standards and approaches within EA
* Develops and implements an ongoing communication plan to educate stakeholders on the purpose and benefits of Solution Architecture
* Strong analytical skills capable of assessing complex business requirements from real world scenarios and the ability to translate them into actionable target architectures, readily understood models and architectural plans
* Deep technical proficiency while the ability to keeping an eye on the bigger picture
* Ability to identify, prioritize and weigh different options, balancing business, cost and technology priorities to determine a best solution
* Strong client\-facing facilitation skills and business acumen needed to help business leaders and program managers understand how to apply complex IT / Architecture concepts to solve business problems
* Contributing to and driving global technology standards proposals and filing exceptions as required
* Provides thought leadership into the evolution of the Solution Architecture function, working collaboratively with managers, peers and analysts
* Directs and provides guidance and thought leadership to an Architecture team so that architectural assets, concepts and solutions are built in line with Enterprise Architecture principles
* Drives the creation of relevant and meaningful solution architectures, re\-usable assets and other deliverables that enables the overall business thus driving better performance
* Manages the solution architecture for their program and is accountable for maturing its architectural linkages across the other Enterprise Architecture frameworks


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following core skills:
   

  

* Directs a virtual Architecture team to align with overall Enterprise Architecture objectives
* Deep Adobe CX Stack expertise
* Strong analytical skills
* Good leadership skills coupled with exceptional judgment and tact.
* Strong expertise in industry standard Enterprise and Solution Architecture Frameworks and Governance
* Ability to translate business needs into Solution Architecture requirements, and estimate the financial and architectural impact of alternatives
* Ability to rapidly comprehend the changes to key business processes and the impact on the overall architecture
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to work effectively with clients and team members across multiple geographies
* Good relationship building, facilitation and influencing skills and experience of leveraging these on both ITS and business leadership contexts
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s Degree (required) or equivalent work experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in Adobe Product family as a Solution Architect
* Enterprise scale Adobe Implementation experience
* Strong understanding of digital experience platforms
* Strong conflict resolution and negotiation skills
* Strong verbal, presentation and written communication skills
* Knowledge of current digital marketing trends and best practices on topics such as personalization, cross channel marketing, mobile, data driven optimization of experiences
* Innovative thinker and desire to help us build out a new Consulting practice and be a pioneer within the industry.
* Self\-motivated and able to work with minimal direction.
* Other relevant experience in a related technical field (application development, deployment/implementation and infrastructure)
* Work experience in a professional services industry, or global teams preferred
* Significant work experience IT infrastructure and security projects
* Flexibility to work outside typical hours, as required of a global team
* Flexibility to travel on a very limited basis


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Adobe certifications \- Desired
* Familiarity with ITIL
* Experience in supporting a professional service and/or global IT organization
* An understanding of Information Security tenets and priorities
* Familiarity with the IIBA (BABOK) Practice Standards
* Enterprise Search Implementation Experience – Desired.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re\-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
   

  

 As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well\-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
   

  

 On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
   

  

 AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
   

  

 Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
   

  

 Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
   

  

* Strong Consulting, client\-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post\-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
* Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS

* Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR)

* hand\-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications
* Knowledge of cloud\-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event\-driven systems.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable and highly available applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, etc.
* Preferred experience in optimizing cloud\-based architectures for scalability, security, and high performance.
* Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring

 Diverse Experiences

 The Delivery Manager will be responsible for overseeing and managing the project control functions for complex and high\-stakes projects. This role requires advanced and specialized knowledge and skills to deliver complex assignments and projects. The Delivery Manager will lead client projects or functional teams, manage important resources, navigate complex negotiations, and address high\-risk and complex issues. This position serves as a point of reference for peers due to the level of specialization and experience in interpreting client or functional technical issues and recommending best practices.
   

  

 Your role

* Develop and implement project control processes, tools, and best practices to improve project delivery and performance.
* Work closely with senior management and other stakeholders to define project control strategies and ensure alignment with business objectives.

0d62aae7.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Strategic programs, PRISM, Last Mile Delivery Tech
0d62aae7.description:
**Description**
 How does Amazon deliver millions of packages faster than customers expect, across the globe, every single day?
   

  

 If that question excites you, keep reading. We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the strategy and execution of programs across Last Mile Delivery. This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role where your work will shape the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer\-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we’re constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. Our Last Mile organization is at the forefront of this mission: pioneering new products and services, partnering with Delivery Service Partners and Amazon Flex, and building a world\-class operation that spans North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Speed is one of the most customer\-visible and strategically important pillars of this work, and you'll be at the center of it.
   

  

 As part of Amazon Delivery's PRISM (Central TPM) organization, you will own the end\-to\-end program strategy for last mile initiatives, driving cross\-functional alignment across business, product, and engineering teams to launch and scale programs that move the needle on delivery. You will partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to define priorities, remove blockers, and deliver results.
   

  

 The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings strong business and technical judgment, and has a track record of delivering complex programs. You are a crisp communicator who can influence at the VP level and translate business goals into actionable roadmaps. If you want to solve one of the most challenging problems in logistics, making delivery faster for every customer, everywhere, this is your role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the single\-threaded leader owning complex programs across multiple VP organizations
* Identify business and technical requirements with science, operations, product, and engineering stakeholders, translating them into specifications, scoped deliverables, and program roadmap from design through launch
* Lead design and implementation efforts across cross\-functional teams, making trade\-offs to optimize time\-to\-market
* Own stakeholder communication through all stages of the product lifecycle, clearly articulating goals, roles, and desired outcomes
* Drive high\-level strategic initiatives while being willing to roll up your sleeves and get the job done


 The right candidate will have a strong program management background, demonstrated experience leading large to extra\-large projects, and a well\-rounded technical foundation. You must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day starts by connecting the dots across teams, aligning product, engineering, and operations leaders on what matters most for our customer and business. You will run strategic reviews, unblock cross\-functional dependencies, and make trade\-off decisions that keep programs on track. Some days you are deep in data, shaping the roadmap; other days you are in a room full of senior leaders driving alignment on the next big bet. No two days look the same, but every day you are directly influencing how fast customers get their packages.
   

  

**About The Team**
 PRISM is Amazon Delivery's central Technical Program Management organization. We drive programs that span Last Mile and partner organizations including Robotics, Pharmacy, Prime Air, and more. The problems we solve sit at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and operations at massive scale. If you want to work on programs that shape how Amazon delivers to customers globally, this is the team to be on.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 4\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* 3\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience building and evaluating system\-level technical design
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Company Description** 




 Bildwell — Construction Simplified is a cloud\-based construction operating platform designed for architects, contractors, and design\-build teams. It connects the entire contracting workflow, from lead management and project planning to site execution, BoQs, procurement, inventory, invoicing, payment tracking, and reporting. The platform replaces fragmented tools such as spreadsheets, messaging apps, and manual follow\-ups with structured workflows, real\-time visibility, and accountable execution. Bildwell serves a wide range of construction businesses, including interior contractors, design\-and\-build firms, turnkey contractors, commercial fit\-out contractors, residential builders, MEP and civil contractors, EPC subcontractors, industrial contractors, and multi\-city and large regional construction companies. The company focuses on transforming construction operations through intuitive technology and data\-driven insights.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Solution Consultant – SaaS \| ConstructionTech / PropTech role at Bildwell is a full\-time, on\-site position based in New Delhi. This role involves engaging with prospective and existing customers to understand their construction workflows, pain points, and business goals, and mapping these to Bildwell’s platform capabilities. The Solution Consultant will conduct product demonstrations, lead presales conversations, prepare solution proposals, and collaborate closely with sales teams to drive adoption and deal closures. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include analyzing customer requirements, configuring and showcasing relevant product modules, supporting pilots and onboarding, and providing feedback to product and engineering teams for enhancements. The role also involves maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders, documenting use cases, and contributing to continuous improvement of sales and implementation processes.

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret business workflows, assess customer requirements, and translate them into effective SaaS solutions.

* Candidates should possess Presales skills, including discovery, solutioning, product demonstrations, proposal creation, and collaboration with sales teams.
* Candidates should possess Sales\-related capabilities, such as stakeholder management, negotiation support, and driving customer value and conversion.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to coordinate pilots, onboarding, and implementation activities across internal and customer teams.
* Relevant experience in ConstructionTech, PropTech, ERP, or SaaS platforms, especially in contracting or project\-based businesses, is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, comfort working with both business and technical stakeholders, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment are expected.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, business, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience in solution consulting or presales will be considered.

2f4b1b8d.title: Partner Solution Engineer
2f4b1b8d.description:
**The Role**
 Lyzr, the enterprise AI agent platform, seeks a North American Partner Solution Engineer to fill a cross\-functional role, including 1/ Building agentic solutions using Lyzr’s platform with partner technologies to create POCs, demos, and related content for Lyzr Cloud, ISV, and Hardware Partners 2/ Envisioning, creating, and presenting technical assets to partners (both marketing and deployment/integration materials), 3/ onboarding partner sales teams (technical and business personas) to understand Lyzr solutions/resources to cosell with Lyzr 4/ building and maintaining internal GTM tools, and 5/ cultivating strategic relationships with cloud partners.
   

  

 You will join the Strategic Alliances team \- we build, market, and sell alongside the world’s largest tech companies (AWS, GCP, MSFT, Accenture, others). We lead strategic vision and tactical execution for successful Lyzr partnerships. Strategic Alliances at Lyzr manages relationships with various partners, potentially including hyperscalers, neo\-clouds, software companies, systems integrators, consulting firms, etc.
   

  

 In a rapidly scaling startup, this is a cross\-functional role at the intersection of customer/partner solutions engineering, solution architecture, partner enablement, technical marketing, and GTM engineering. You will be the technical face of Lyzr to partners — enabling partner technical teams, creating technical marketing content, and building the tools for scalable partner GTM for Lyzr.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role initially reporting to the VP of Strategic Alliances with visibility to the CEO. Lyzr is the agent platform for enterprise partnership \- the best company to build with. Period. The next 2 years will define how enterprise customers realize value from AI through software alliances, and we are leading the expedition. Join us at Lyzr to drive AI into the biggest industries in the world.
   

  

**About You**
 The ideal candidate is deeply technical yet communicates very clearly in US English. You have a good sense for cost vs benefit \- when to chase a tech issue for hours vs. when to step away and move on to higher priority work. You obsess about customer experiences, and pay attention to detail. You dive deep into agentic AI and work with the latest tech. You already use the latest AI tools for coding, testing, and accelerating your work. You recognize that the way things were done even 3 years ago won’t cut it this year, yet you are eager to learn from experienced leaders. You love to build real solutions that work in production, document them clearly for others, and you connect tech to real business problems. You take coaching well, even when you think you nailed it, you recognize there’s always room to improve. You adapt quickly when leadership priorities shift \- even when it means pausing work you care about. You have an idea how to manage projects, prioritize relentlessly, and set expectations clearly. You are able to laugh at yourself and know when to keep it profesh.
   

  

**About Lyzr**
 Lyzr is the AI agent platform for enterprise. Lyzr AI solutions enable enterprises to design, deploy, and govern AI agents at scale. Enterprise technology lives in our DNA: security and governance are built into Lyzr from the start; not bolted\-on as an after\-thought. Lyzr’s full\-stack approach rapidly moves customers from idea to production without having to stitch together point solutions from a dozen different vendors. We enable enterprises to move beyond isolated AI use cases and into reliable, production\-grade agentic workflows with strong controls around security, accuracy, and compliance.
   

  

 Recognized by Accenture, Harvard Business School innovation ecosystems, and finalist for AWS global AI awards, Lyzr works with global enterprises to reimagine complex workflows using agentic AI. We focus on making AI agents dependable at scale \- so teams can replace fragmented tool stacks with a unified, governed intelligence layer. We have great investors, great leaders, and we are ready to scale. Join us as we create simplicity from the chaos of AI in business environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Building agentic solutions: Own the design/delivery of joint agentic solutions — production\-grade deployments and prototype demos alike — built on Lyzr and partner tech. Applies established blueprints and architectural patterns from Lyzr \+ partners; operates with or without external engineering support depending on engagement context.
* Hands\-on development capability: Writes and reviews Python (or equivalent) code directly, and leverages AI\-assisted code\-gen tools to accelerate solution development. Comfortable working in cloud\-hosted development environments and contributing code alongside or independent of partner engineering teams.
* Creating Technical Marketing \& Enablement Content for Partners: Build and maintain partner/customer\-facing assets; including integration guides, reference architectures, tech white papers, hands\-on labs, solution briefs/accelerators, competitive positioning, case studies, step\-by\-step customer guides, playbooks, webinars, and similar assets. Enable internal \& external stakeholders to understand Lyzr solutions and identify business problems solved by Lyzr solutions. Develop compelling demos and video walkthroughs for partners and customers.
* Delivering Partner/Customer Enablement as the Subject Matter Expert (SME): Join partner and/or customer\-facing meetings to support field sales resources (Lyzr \& partner sellers) to land the value proposition of Lyzr solutions and drive revenue. Delivering hands\-on workshops as needed, and explaining delivery playbooks in real time.
* Technical SME \- Support strategic customer/partners serving as a technical escalation point for complex agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment patterns. Act as a SME for Lyzr solutions, including Lyzr Blocks, Studio, GitAgent, LyzrGPT, Architect.new, and more.
* Design and build Lyzr GTM tools to accelerate Lyzr’s GTM efforts.
* Assist in instrumenting and measure partner GTM impact — tracking metrics like partner\-sourced pipeline, influenced revenue, and related dashboards.
* Onboard partners with structured technical onboarding experiences; from initial architecture review through first joint customer deployment.
* Lead/support "office hours" enablement with partners to deepen expertise and identify customer opportunities.
* Synthesize partner feedback/learning into actionable product insight; capture field experience and delivery patterns to share with product and deployment teams.
* Collaborate with leadership to shape joint business plans, especially focused on technical integration goals with strategic partners.


**What We Seek**
* Experience: Varies by country: 3\-12 years of experience in customer/partner\-facing engineering roles, sales engineer, product engineer, solution engineer, solutions architect, forward deployed engineer, technical consultant, or similar. Enterprise experience preferred, with ability to operate independently in highly ambiguous startup situations.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and tools, including some mixture of Lyzr, LangChain, CrewAI, N8N, leading code\-gen solutions, \*claw, git, and others
* US Eastern Time\-Zone (GMT \-5\): Weekdays must be available with high\-quality internet for voice calls with internal or external stakeholders during a range from 800 \- 1800 hrs US Eastern Time (i.e. until 330am India time)
* Exceptional English Communication: Written and spoken, must demonstrate strong English communication. You are able to convey ideas succinctly (or are willing to learn).
* Cloud Fluency: Demonstrated depth on at least one cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and strong understanding of cloud ecosystems. You understand that each cloud partner speaks their own language and expects us to speak THEIR language.
* Ability to Ship Solutions: Strong skill in python or similar programming capabilities. You understand how to move from creative ideation, to prototyping, to shipping an MVP according to the specs assigned by leadership. You understand how to take partner/customer ideas, turn them into a multi\-stage project, and build the first functional stage to deploy rapidly.
* Passion for AI: A genuine interest in AI and shipping product. You must be able to assess new tech to identify how we can use them to solve real problems with partner tech
* Education: Depending on location: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Math/Physics or other technical discipline; Masters or advanced degree preferred. Work experience \+ portfolio may substitute for a degree.


**Bonus Points**
* Previous success building technical partnerships with cloud partners and cloud marketplaces (e.g., AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, et al). Demonstrated content creation, implementation experience, all highly desired.
* Project Management Experience: You understand and/or are willing to learn relentless prioritization. You understand how to track 50 projects, but only spend time on the top 5 deliverables that impact us this week.
* Persuasive with Experienced Tech Leaders: You are capable of navigating complex organizations and are persistent in getting mindshare from busy partners.
* Current experience with leading AI players \- you’ve done it successfully, not just dreamed about it…
* Start\-up experience while understanding enterprise DNA — you are comfortable with ambiguity and wearing multiple hats, but you understand that enterprise customers operate differently than a startup. Professionalism, clear communications, and capability all earn trust with enterprise customers and partners.


**Why Join Us?**
* Great Team, Great Tech: Work with a mission\-driven team to create the cutting edge of Agentic AI.
* Impact: Your work will directly influence Lyzr’s revenue trajectory.
* Growth: We are a team that values learning, humility, and coaching. Work with great leaders both here at Lyzr and with our partners.

Job Title: Associate Solution Architect  
**Experience Required:** 7 plus years

**Location:** Mohali(Punjab), Bangalore

**About the Role**

We are seeking a motivated and technically strong **Associate Solution Architect** to join our team at Iota Analytics. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in software development, cloud technologies, microservices, and distributed systems, along with an interest in solution architecture.

In this role, you will work closely with senior architects, developers, and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, integrate, and implement scalable and secure technology solutions. You will contribute to architectural decisions, technical discussions, and cloud\-native implementations while gaining exposure to enterprise\-level solution architecture.

Key Responsibilities

* Work with senior architects and technical teams to understand business and technical requirements and translate them into effective technology solutions.
* Assist in designing and developing scalable, reliable, and secure end\-to\-end applications and systems.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of **cloud\-based solutions** on platforms such as Azure and AWS.
* Support the development and integration of **microservices\-based architectures** and distributed systems.
* Work with containerization technologies such as **Docker and Kubernetes**.
* Collaborate with development and DevOps teams to support **CI/CD pipelines** and automated deployments.
* Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and solution design sessions.
* Assist in evaluating technologies, frameworks, and tools and provide recommendations based on project requirements.
* Help ensure solutions follow best practices related to **security, scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability**.
* Troubleshoot technical and architectural issues and work with development teams to identify appropriate solutions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and solution design documents.
* Work closely with senior architects and developers to continuously improve existing applications and systems.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and contribute ideas for improving the organization's technology landscape.

Requirements

* **7 plus years of experience** in software development, technical architecture, cloud engineering, or a similar role.
* Good understanding of **cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS**.
* Strong understanding of **microservices architecture and distributed systems**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Docker** and exposure to **Kubernetes**.
* Understanding of **CI/CD concepts and tools**.
* Good knowledge of software architecture principles, design patterns, APIs, and system integration.
* Understanding of **security best practices**, scalability, performance optimization, and application reliability.
* Experience working with databases, APIs, and enterprise application integrations.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively with developers, DevOps teams, senior architects, and business stakeholders.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field**.

Good to Have

* Experience with Azure/AWS architecture and cloud\-native services.
* Knowledge of **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** tools such as Terraform or ARM/Bicep.
* Experience with messaging and event\-driven architectures such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Azure Service Bus.
* Understanding of monitoring and observability tools.
* Exposure to **AI/ML, data platforms, or enterprise SaaS applications**.
* Relevant cloud certifications such as **AWS Solutions Architect Associate** or **Microsoft Azure certifications**.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is technically curious, proactive, and eager to grow into a **Solution Architect** role. The candidate should have strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand complex technical problems, collaborate with multiple teams, and contribute to designing practical and scalable solutions.

About Iota Analytics

Headquartered in the UK, with offices in the US and Centers of Excellence in India, **Iota Analytics** is a tech\-led legal process and analytics firm bringing together technology, data science, and process outsourcing to support legal teams globally.

Our focus is on providing data and technology\-led insights to corporate counsels, law firms, and R\&D leaders.

We have a team of **450\+ professionals**, including attorneys, engineers, data scientists, and solution architects, spanning leadership, R\&D, service delivery, sales, and enabling functions. Our legal and technology specialists leverage technology and data science to deliver next\-generation, AI\-driven precision and speed for complex legal workflows.

* **Legal Support Services:** Technology\-enabled solutions for Cyber Incident Response, Managed eDiscovery Services, and Managed Document Review.

We serve Am Law 100 firms, leading ALSPs, and global enterprises while fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and the highest standards of data privacy and client trust.

**About this team** 




 This team is responsible for creating APIs and backend integration following microservices architecture principals on AWS cloud infrastructure stack. This Solution Architect position is a highly technical role with accountability for architecture scoped to business\-transformative projects and is involved with projects from inception through implementation.
 



 Our team is fast\-paced and taking on exciting new initiatives to support a fast\-growing business. We strive to adopt leading\-edge technology and seek to improve on the solutions continuously. We are not afraid to try new things, have fun, and encourage each other to take on new challenges. We support each other in growing professionally and personally. We fail forward and learn from our mistakes, thus creating a better path ahead. We create space for team members to share feedback and ideas that can help us continually grow as an organization.
 



 We operate following agile framework and leverage multiple product teams across our various functions. We encourage our teams to norm and figure out the best way to deliver critical business initiatives. We institute a culture of fun and lightheartedness to enjoy work each day. We are inclusive and know that we are stronger as a team than as an individual.
 



  





**A day in the life:** 




 As a Solution Architect, you will interface with key stakeholders and apply your technical proficiency across different stages of the Project Life Cycle including Requirements Elicitation, Application Architecture definition, Design and Development. You will ensure that the backend integrations are well designed using best practices to meet the scalability and reliability for growing global commerce business. The Architect partners with delivery teams to architect, design, and build flexible, scalable, and resilient applications and services that can more easily adapt to future business needs.
 


* Provide strategic guidance to multiple teams to ensure systems are high\-performing, reliable, and sustainable.
* Lead solution architecture aligned with enterprise standards, using reusable frameworks and components.
* Ensure end\-to\-end system design meets both business and technical needs.
* Translate conceptual ideas into detailed, implementable designs.
* Support system implementation, including development and configuration.
* Maintain architecture documentation, including current and future\-state models.
* Assist with effort estimation for development and QA, ensuring clarity and best practices.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts to define and refine technical requirements.
* Participate in technology reviews, audits, and help design operational support plans.
* Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies; build proof\-of\-concepts to test new ideas.

* Mentor team members build scalable and high\-performance solutions.

* 4\+ years of experience in front\-end development using Node.js, React.js, Angular or others.
* 2\+ years of experience with CI/CD tools (GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, others).

* Good to have strong grasp of programming and integration concepts, event\-driven and messaging architectures (pub/sub, queuing), with hands\-on experience designing resilient, fault\-tolerant solutions in cloud\-native environments.
