c77291c9.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Headless CMS Solutions Architect based in India.**
 This is a senior, client\-facing opportunity focused on designing modern, scalable digital content platforms using headless and composable CMS technologies.
   

  

 You will lead discovery engagements, translate business and editorial needs into technical solutions, and guide clients through technology evaluation and architecture decisions.
   

  

 The role combines content strategy, cloud architecture, systems integration, development considerations, security, and enterprise digital transformation.
   

  

 You will work across platforms including Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, and Strapi, objectively assessing their capabilities against specific client requirements.
   

  

 The position also requires a strong understanding of AWS environments and how CMS platforms integrate with cloud\-based applications and infrastructure.
   

  

 You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate architectural recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 This role is well suited to an experienced architect or consultant who enjoys solving complex digital\-content challenges and shaping practical implementation roadmaps.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and consulting engagements to understand business, editorial, technical, integration, security, and content requirements.
* Gather, analyze, and document current\-state requirements and translate them into scalable future\-state digital platform architectures.
* Evaluate headless CMS platforms and objectively recommend solutions based on client needs, technical constraints, scalability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Design scalable content models, schemas, reusable components, taxonomies, metadata structures, and composable content architectures.
* Define editorial workflows, approval processes, role\-based permissions, localization strategies, and publishing processes.
* Design integrations between CMS platforms and enterprise applications, services, APIs, and other digital systems.
* Develop architectures for multilingual content, accessibility, technical SEO, search, content governance, and modern web standards.
* Design CMS migration strategies for legacy platforms such as Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore, and custom\-built systems.
* Assess how headless CMS solutions should integrate with AWS\-based applications and infrastructure, including services such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Cognito, IAM, Route 53, WAF, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and EventBridge.
* Collaborate closely with front\-end, cloud, DevOps, security, UX, and development teams to ensure architectural decisions can be implemented effectively.
* Produce architecture diagrams, technology recommendations, implementation roadmaps, technical documentation, and other solution\-design materials.
* Present architectural recommendations clearly to executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, and developers.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability challenges throughout discovery and solution design.
* Challenge requirements constructively when simpler, more scalable, or more maintainable approaches are appropriate.
* Support implementation planning and ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives and technical realities.


**Requirements**
* Significant professional experience working with headless CMS and composable digital\-platform architectures.
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least two of Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, or Strapi, with familiarity across the broader platform landscape preferred.
* Practical experience with Storyblok features such as Visual Editor, components, workflows, localization, roles and permissions, Content Delivery API, and Management API.
* Practical experience with Sanity, including Sanity Studio, structured content, schemas, GROQ, Content Lake, custom editorial experiences, and integrations.
* Practical experience with Contentful, including content models, localization, environments, permissions, workflows, Content Delivery API, and Content Management API.
* Practical experience with Strapi, including Content Type Builder, components, Dynamic Zones, REST and GraphQL APIs, permissions, plugins, and cloud or self\-hosted deployments.
* Experience leading CMS or digital\-platform discovery and recommending enterprise content\-management solutions.
* Strong understanding of AWS and cloud\-based architecture, with the ability to design solutions and collaborate effectively with cloud and DevOps specialists.
* Strong knowledge of REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, API integrations, structured content, and composable architecture.
* Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern front\-end frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Nuxt.
* Experience designing enterprise systems integrations and CMS migration strategies.
* Strong understanding of content governance, multilingual and localized content, role\-based permissions, editorial workflows, technical SEO, accessibility, and modern web standards.
* Experience producing architecture diagrams, technical documentation, implementation roadmaps, and technology recommendations.
* Strong consulting, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for different audiences.
* Comfortable working with executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, developers, and other technical specialists.
* Ability to evaluate technologies objectively, identify risks and dependencies, and communicate architectural trade\-offs clearly.
* Experience with enterprise search, Digital Asset Management, CRM, LMS, marketing automation, analytics, or identity platforms is an asset.
* Additional experience with AWS Solutions Architect certification, CMS certifications, Next.js/React, Node.js, Terraform or Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevOps, AWS OpenSearch, Digital Asset Management platforms, CRM, marketing automation, or Learning Management Systems is considered a plus.


**Benefits**
* Fully remote working arrangement.
* Opportunity to work on modern headless and composable CMS architectures.
* Exposure to multiple leading CMS platforms, including Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, and Strapi.
* Opportunity to design and advise on enterprise digital platforms within an AWS cloud environment.
* Senior, client\-facing role with significant involvement in discovery, consulting, architecture, and implementation planning.
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams spanning cloud, DevOps, security, UX, front\-end, and development.

256d0f79.title: Principal Solutions Architect - SAARC
256d0f79.description:
**About Us**
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
   

  

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI\-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

**Available Locations: Bengaluru/Mumbai/New Delhi**
**About The Role**
 As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted advisor to Cloudflare's most strategic enterprise customers across the Asia Pacific region. You will work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and executive influence, helping organisations in industries such as financial services, government, and telecommunications navigate complex digital transformation journeys using Cloudflare's platform.
   

  

 You'll speak the "customer language", understand the CxO mindset, and influence technology decisions at the intersection of risk, resilience, and innovation. Whether it's advising a CISO on a Zero Trust security strategy, helping a CIO rationalise their network architecture, or working with engineering leadership on edge\-native application modernisation, you'll help our most important customers reimagine how the Internet works for them and position Cloudflare as the foundational platform for that future.
   

  

 You'll be embedded in account planning with our sales and solutions engineering teams, operating proactively across the full customer lifecycle; from early strategic discovery through to long\-term platform adoption and expansion. As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll also play a significant role in raising the architectural capability of the broader Solutions Engineering organisation across APAC.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own long\-term executive relationships across Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts; engaging CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs on their multi\-year technology agendas and positioning Cloudflare as a foundational platform, not a point solution.
* Design and facilitate executive vision\-setting and architecture workshops that produce tangible outcomes: multi\-year roadmaps, reference architectures, and business cases co\-developed with customers' enterprise architects and engineering leadership.
* Translate industry trends like Zero Trust, Digital Sovereignty, AI workload security, cloud\-to\-edge migration into actionable architectural strategies tailored to each customer's business context and regulatory environment.
* Guide clients across the full engagement lifecycle; from strategic discovery and architecture design through proof of concept, value realisation, and expansion planning while proactively partnering with the Sales and Solutions Engineering team to surface architectural opportunities before deals are formally scoped.
* Elevate the architectural capability of the broader APAC Solutions Engineering team by developing reusable workshop frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices that others can apply independently; and by mentoring Solutions Engineers in senior stakeholder engagement.
* Represent Cloudflare externally at industry events, executive roundtables, and sector forums as a credible peer to enterprise architects and technology leaders; produce content: white papers, architectural guidance that establishes Cloudflare's voice on key transformation themes across the region.


**What Success Looks Like** 
  

  

* In your first 6 months:
+ You've established trusted advisor relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders across 3\-5 of Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts.
+ You've designed and facilitated 2\-3 executive vision\-setting or architecture workshops that have resulted in documented multi\-year roadmap alignment with Cloudflare embedded as a core platform component.
+ You've shaped at least one strategic engagement where you've connected Cloudflare's developer and edge compute capabilities to a customer's application modernisation or AI strategy; demonstrating platform breadth beyond security alone.
+ You've contributed at least one reusable asset to the APAC SE team; a workshop framework, reference architecture, or architectural playbook that others can apply independently.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 12\+ years of experience in technical presales, enterprise architecture, or IT leadership (e.g., Chief Architect, CTO, CISO).
* A genuine ability to operate at two levels simultaneously: credible in a boardroom conversation about digital strategy, and capable of going deep on architecture design with engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading executive\-level workshops, technology strategy sessions, or architectural visioning engagements with tangible business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of transformation priorities relevant to APAC enterprises: Zero Trust architecture, cloud and network modernisation, digital sovereignty and data residency, AI infrastructure, and application performance at scale.
* Experience with modern application architecture patterns (microservices, APIs, event\-driven systems, CI/CD, serverless and edge compute).
* A track record of proactively contributing to pipeline and account expansion through architectural influence — not just responding to requests.
* Proven ability to enable and elevate peers: you've built frameworks, run internal enablement, or mentored others at scale.
* Confident, compelling communicator in both executive business settings and technical deep dives and comfortable representing Cloudflare publicly at industry events.
* Bonus: Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF), security standards (NIST SP 800\-207, ISO 27001\), and IT risk management principles relevant to regulated industries.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or related field.
* Experience in regulated industries (FSI, Government, Telco) or complex multi\-cloud/hybrid environments.
* Hands\-on technical curiosity: you stay current across networking, cloud infrastructure, application security, and developer platforms; not because the job requires it, but because you find it genuinely interesting.
* Prior experience in a role that required navigating cultural and linguistic diversity across multiple APAC markets.


 What Makes Cloudflare Special?
   

  

 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
   

  

**Project Galileo** 
 : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers\-\-at no cost.
   

  

**Athenian Project** 
 : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
   

  

**1\.1\.1\.1** 
 : We released 1\.1\.1\.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy\-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use \- it is the first consumer\-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal \- we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
   

  

 Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in\-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
   

  

 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
   

  

 Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
   

  

 Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e\-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107\.

**Job Description: Oracle Cloud GL (General Ledger) — Application Support Consultant** 




**Experience Required:** 
 6–8 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (1st preference). Other locations are also fine.
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud General Ledger (GL) Support Consultant with strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Cloud GL, with proven experience resolving production issues, handling period\-close activities, and providing day\-to\-day operational support in a live Oracle Cloud Financials environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide L2/L3 production support for Oracle Cloud General Ledger module, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests within defined SLAs
* Manage and troubleshoot day\-to\-day GL issues: journal posting errors, allocation failures, reconciliation mismatches, ledger balancing issues
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities including journal review, accruals, revaluation, translation, and consolidation
* Monitor and resolve issues in scheduled processes (ESS jobs) related to GL — posting, import, allocations, period close
* Handle intercompany transactions, elimination entries, and cross\-ledger balancing issues
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and recommend permanent fixes/configuration changes
* Coordinate with Oracle Support (SRs/Service Requests) for bug fixes, patches, and quarterly update issues
* Support functional testing of Oracle Cloud quarterly patches/updates and regression testing for GL processes
* Work closely with subledger (AP, AR, FA \& CM) support teams to resolve cross\-module integration issues impacting GL
* Assist in FBDI\-based data loads, journal uploads, and correction of failed interface/import processes
* Maintain and update support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles
* Handle minor enhancements, CRs (Change Requests), and configuration updates as per business need
* Provide end\-user support, training, and query resolution related to GL processes
* Track tickets via ITSM tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and report on SLA compliance and ticket trends
* Participate in on\-call/rotational support and be available during period\-close windows (including weekends, if required)



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 6–8 years of experience in Oracle applications, with at least 4–5 years dedicated to Oracle Cloud GL support/operations
* Strong hands\-on experience in a
 **production support environment**
* Solid understanding of GL configurations: Chart of Accounts, Ledgers, Calendars, Journal Sources/Categories, Data Access Sets
* Practical experience with allocations, revaluation, translation, and consolidation processes
* Experience handling period\-close cycle issues and providing close\-window support
* Working knowledge of GL integration points with AP, AR, FA, CM, and Expenses
* Hands\-on experience with OTBI, FRS (Financial Reporting Studio), and Smart View for troubleshooting/reporting issues
* Familiarity with FBDI templates and resolving failed import/interface issues
* Experience raising and managing Oracle Service Requests (SRs) via My Oracle Support (MOS)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud release cycles (quarterly updates) and their impact on GL configurations
* Good knowledge of ITSM/ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy)
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize under pressure



  





**Preferred/Good to Have** 



* Oracle Cloud Financials (GL) certification
* Prior experience in AMS/support engagements (as opposed to only implementation projects)
* Exposure to SLA\-driven support models and ticket\-severity frameworks (P1/P2/P3\)
* Basic understanding of SQL for data validation/debugging (not mandatory)



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset with a sense of urgency during close periods
* Good client communication and ticket documentation skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tickets/priorities simultaneously
* Team player with willingness to support on\-call/rotational schedules

b87694ae.description:
About Aerchain (Why Us?)
 



  





 We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI\-first platform that powers $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
 



  





 From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise\-grade, AI\-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own enterprise accounts end\-to\-end — accountable for the outcomes they realise, from sales handover through go\-live, adoption, and value confirmation. You’ll be the single point of contact and the face of Aerchain for your accounts, make delivery predictable across clients and calm for leadership, validate that what was sold matches what the product can support, and orchestrate the delivery team behind the scenes so the customer experiences one seamless Aerchain delivery. You report to the Value Owner.
 



  





 What You’ll Drive
 



  





 Customer Ownership
 


* Own your accounts end\-to\-end — from understanding the customer’s problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
* Be the single point of contact and the face of Aerchain for your accounts — through delivery, adoption, and outcome validation.
* Build trusted executive relationships; manage leadership expectations on readiness, residual risk, and trade\-offs.



  





 Delivery Leadership \& Governance
 



  




* Own project \& portfolio plan stability across your accounts; enforce governance, cadence, and metrics.
* Approve baselines, review delivery \& sprint health, and drive milestone predictability across every account.
* Enforce exception \& escalation governance with quality and timeliness — keep delivery calm and predictable for leadership.
* Orchestrate the delivery execution team and partners so the customer experiences one seamless Aerchain delivery; guide allocation, correct gaps, and keep the team unblocked.



  





 Solution Oversight \& Scope Discipline
 



  




* Review BRDs for feasibility, product alignment, and long\-term supportability.
* Validate sold solutions against product capability; enforce scope discipline post\-discovery.
* Confirm functional \& operational readiness at go\-live.



  





 Stakeholder \& Escalation Management
 



  




* Establish executive governance, escalation paths, and SteerCo cadence for your accounts.
* Own escalation resolution across client and internal stakeholders (Product, Sales, Tech, and delivery partners).
* Be the customer’s single point of escalation — all external escalation flows through you.



  





 Adoption \& Value Realisation
 



  




* Own post\-go\-live outcomes — stay in the loop until value is confirmed, not until the feature ships.
* Hold the customer\-value metrics standard across your accounts; track adoption and drive value realisation.
* Turn delivered outcomes into references and case studies; feed structured customer insight back into the product.



  





 You’ll thrive here if
 



  




* 8–12 years in Product/Solution Consulting, Engagement or Account Management, or Enterprise SaaS delivery, with clear progression to end\-to\-end account ownership.
* You own outcomes — you stay in the loop until value is confirmed.
* You make delivery predictable across clients, scalable across teams, and calm for leadership.
* You validate solutions against product capability and hold scope discipline under pressure.
* Executive\-level stakeholder management and structured, calm communication across every delivery stage.
* Pragmatic decision\-making under pressure, with a critical\-path focus.
* Strong B2B SaaS \& enterprise\-workflow understanding.
* Bonus: Procurement / supply chain / spend\-management domain exposure, experience with Indian \& US enterprise customers; MBA preferred.



  





 What’s In It For You
 



  




* End\-to\-end ownership of enterprise accounts, with real client impact and full accountability for outcomes.
* Be the face of Aerchain to your customers — with the authority to make delivery happen.
* Influence product direction through structured customer feedback.
* A direct line to delivery leadership, with no bureaucracy between your judgment and the decisions that matter.
* A high\-growth environment scaling from $4M → $25M ARR and beyond.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded — and the opposite is called out.



  





 Ready to build Aerchain’s future?
 



  





 If owning enterprise outcomes end\-to\-end and making delivery predictable at scale excites
 



 you, let’s talk. Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

20de312c.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
20de312c.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 The Product and Engineering team in the Cloud Native Business Unit is looking to bring on a Senior Technical Program Manager to join a team of TPMs focused on driving complex and cross\-cutting initiatives and programs to meet our top objectives and key results to delight our customers.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* You will take charge using your technical leadership and program management skills to drive execution with high quality for these key initiatives.
* You will be responsible for establishing best practices, collaborating across multiple business units and managing dependencies and deliverables for multiple programs.
* You will be working with a global team of software engineers who develop new features and capabilities with a rapid rate of change.
* You will be responsible for driving multiple parallel product releases in a fast pace environment.
* We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**What You Bring**
* Minimum 8\+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager (TPM) leading product delivery teams for enterprise commercial software organizations
* MS in computer science, MBA or engineering management equivalent preferred.
* Minimum 6\+ years hands\-on experience delivering enterprise commercial software releases in a dynamic environment
* Proven ability for this release TPM to develop and use Agentic AI in their day\-to\-day job.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with technical and non\-technical, cross\-functional groups.
* Advanced understanding and extensive use of Jira Cloud in software development program management and release management
* Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Big picture thinker providing clarity on what we are trying to accomplish, understanding of the business objectives and driving the outcome for the program
* Capabilities to identify and recommend process changes that would enable faster time to market while driving organization consistency and efficiency.
* Solid knowledge of end\-to\-end SDLC best practices
* Experience in managing projects throughout the entire SDLC, including investigation, design, planning, execution and delivering products to market on schedule, and addressing customer feedback in development. Solid knowledge of end\-to\-end SDLC best practices
* Drive content, schedule and overall delivery of the program and set it up for success in the field and customer base for overall Go\-To\-Market readiness and New Product Introduction
* Recognize when trade\-offs and timely decisions are needed; drive the necessary discussions to conclusion and drive accountability for delivery and ensure that the objectives of the program are met
* Use your solid project and technical skills and judgment to build credibility with technical leaders and demonstrate the ability to influence multiple functions across the organization
* Strong team and customer focus.
* Take ownership of the product experience, product quality and associated health metrics
* Set goals for the program, track and periodically communicate to stakeholders as well as executive leadership
* Ensure corrective actions and risk mitigations are in place as needed to keep programs and releases on track
* Be the single point person for delivery decisions, exec and cross team communication and working with various functional groups to deliver the program
* Optimize team processes to improve quality, productivity, and responsiveness to feedback and changing priorities along with setting up the program for success in the field
* Highly collaborative; overcome obstacles by resolving issues, regardless of team boundaries, and identify and resolve teamwork issues.


**INCLUDE FOR POSTING LOCATION IDENTIFICATION**
**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. f05744ad.title: Program Manager
f05744ad.description:
**Purpose of the Role** 




 Agratas is seeking a dynamic and experienced Programme Manager to join our cutting\-edge R\&D facility. This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in driving innovation, overseeing complex projects, and ensuring successful delivery of strategic programmes in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  





 We are seeking a strategically astute and technically accomplished Programme Manager to drive the industrialisation roadmap from next\-generation battery cell design and development through to manufacturing at our Bangalore facility. This is a pivotal role, charged with aligning technical programme execution with corporate strategy, driving operational transformation, and building long\-term organisational capability in advanced manufacturing.
 



  





 The Programme Manager will serve as a key contributor to the leadership team, bringing together strategy, innovation, and execution to ensure that the India R\&D and industrialisation programme delivers industry\-leading outcomes in cost, quality, scale, and sustainability.
 



  





 By joining Agratas R\&D in Bangalore, you’ll be part of a world\-class research hub focused on advancing battery cell technology. Whether you’re an engineer, technician, or scientist, you’ll contribute to projects that power the future of mobility and energy, while working in an environment that values both technical excellence and sustainability.
 



  





 Agratas R\&D in Bangalore offers the rare combination of cutting\-edge science, meaningful impact, and career\-building opportunities—all within a supportive, forward\-looking team.
 



  





**Key Responsibility Areas** 



* Lead and manage cross\-functional programmes from concept to completion
* Align project outcomes with business objectives and R\&D priorities
* Collaborate with technical teams, stakeholders, and senior leadership
* Ensure timelines, budgets, and quality standards are consistently met
* Strategic Programme Leadership
* Corporate Strategy Integration \& Business Planning
* Anticipate global technology, regulatory, and competitive trends and proactively adjust programme priorities to maintain market leadership.
* Programme Leadership: Lead the execution of multiple process engineering projects, driving the industrialisation of advanced battery cell manufacturing technologies.
* Development, governance and delivery of timing, budget and capability requirements for our UK Gigafactory Project as well as leadership of technology development programmes.
* Process Development \- Oversee programmes to design, deploy and optimise the manufacturing systems for electrode manufacturing, cell assembly and Formation, Aging \& Test. Equipment Integration.
* Technology Transfer: Lead cross\-functional teams in transferring technologies from both R\&D and other technical partners to manufacturing.
* Lead the strategic prioritisation of technology development and industrialisation projects based on business value, technical risk, and time\-to\-impact.
* Ensure seamless technology transfer from R\&D into commercial production, including roadmaps for scale\-up and automation.
* Define and govern programme portfolio metrics to ensure maximum ROI, cost leadership, and resilience.
* Operational Excellence \& Transformation
* Provide strategic oversight for supplier engagement and procurement decisions to ensure global supply chain scalability and resilience.
* Deliver operational excellence through robust cost control, financial modelling, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Collaborate with external partners, including material suppliers and automation vendors.
* Risk Mitigation: · Identify and mitigate technical risks across all stages of process development and scale\-up.



  





**Job Context** 




 About You:
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field.
* Advanced technical certifications in programme management or manufacturing are highly desirable.
* Strong technical experience in battery cell design and manufacturing processes and a proven record of delivery in dynamic, fast\-paced environments.
* High level of understanding of lithium\-ion battery chemistries and manufacturing process equipment, as well as technical and environmental standards for battery cell production.
* Strong background in using project management tools and methodologies. Proven ability to manage complex, large\-scale programmes with a focus on technical deliverables and timelines.
* Relative experience in large\-scale, complex R\&D, manufacturing or engineering programmes
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment



  





 Joining Agratas R\&D in Bangalore means becoming part of a cutting\-edge team shaping the future of sustainable energy storage, with the backing of Tata Sons and the excitement of a scale\-up environment.
 



  





 Join us at Agratas and help shape the future of advanced research and development.

NICE, the market leader in cloud\-based contact center technology, is looking for an experienced Solution Consultant to excite potential customers about its extensive portfolio and aid them in ultimately becoming a NICE customer. A successful Solution Consultant will work consultatively with prospects to identify their goals and business drivers, and creatively design a solution that will meet the ever\-growing demands of their contact center needs. **How will you make an impact?**


* Own Presales end\-to\-end: pipeline, solution strategy, POC governance, and win/loss review
* Lead on complex enterprise AI deals from first discovery through technical sign\-off
* Design and oversee POCs — including data requirements, model evaluation, integration architecture, and results framing
* Coach Solutions Consultants on AI solutioning, technical storytelling, and commercial positioning
* Build repeatable playbooks, demo frameworks, and discovery guides specific to AI/ML products
* Feed structured field intelligence back into Product and GTM strategy
* Represent the company at industry events and in customer advisory conversations.

**Have you got what it takes?**


* 12–16 years in Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, or Sales Engineering — 3\+ years leading a team
* Last 2\+ years hands\-on in AI product Pre\-Sales — not adjacent to it, in it
* Working knowledge of the AI stack: LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, inference costs, token economics, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and API\-based AI services
* Able to scope and run technically rigorous POCs without needing an engineer to translate
* Commercial fluency around AI pricing models — tokens, compute, licensing, and total cost of ownership conversations with procurement and finance
* Deep experience with complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
* A coach who leads by doing — you get in the deal, run the discovery, fix the demo, then debrief the team on why
* Ideal experience around 15\-18 Years
* Has been in an Architect/ Gen AI front ending Technology role in the past 2\-3 years
* Is conversational and understands Gen AI positioning and has exposure to banking, insurance, retail in similar profiles,

**What’s in it for you?**


* Join an ever\-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE\-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face\-to\-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.


**Requisition ID: 10789**
  

**Reporting into:** Director, Portfolio Solution Engineering
  

**Role Type:** Individual Contributor

*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.*

*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30\+ countries.*

Nemetschek India Private Limited is a global organization and with a legacy of over half a century. It is a public company listed on MDAX and TecDAX (Germany) stock exchanges. The Nemetschek Group is a forerunner of digital transformation in the AEC/O (Architecture, Engineering, Construction \& Operations) industry and covers the entire life cycle of construction and infrastructure projects. With intelligent software solutions, we lead our customers into the future of digitalization. By using our solutions customers can plan, build, manage, and operate buildings and infrastructure projects.
 



  





 Nemetschek India is looking for a strong Technical Sales Specialist / Senior Solution Consultant to support enterprise growth across the AEC and infrastructure ecosystem in India. This is an individual contributor role focused on partnering with enterprise sales on strategic pursuits, shaping solution value for customers, and helping drive adoption of digital workflows and platforms at scale.
 



  





 The role combines deep domain understanding in AEC, BIM, and digital construction with strong customer\-facing consulting and commercial support skills. The successful candidate will work directly with sales teams, customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to translate business needs into compelling technical solutions, demonstrations, workshops, proposals, and proof points.
 



  





 Strategic sales support
 



 • Partner with enterprise sales teams on key pursuits, strategic accounts, and large opportunities.
 



 • Support discovery conversations with CXOs, CTOs, CIOs, Digital Heads, Design Heads, and project stakeholders to understand business priorities and digital transformation goals.
 



 • Contribute to large enterprise sales cycles including RFPs, bids, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations.
 



  





 Solutioning and value articulation
 



 • Translate customer business challenges into solution concepts, technical recommendations, and ROI\-oriented value propositions.
 



 • Shape solution architecture and workflow positioning across design, collaboration, construction, and asset lifecycle use cases.
 



 • Lead product demonstrations, proof of value discussions, workshops, and customer use case sessions tailored to account needs.
 



 • Work closely with account teams to articulate how Nemetschek solutions address customer pain points, workflow gaps, and digital maturity goals.
 



  





 Domain and technical consulting
 



 • Bring strong understanding of AEC, BIM, digital delivery, and construction workflows into customer engagements.
 



 • Hands\-on experience on tools like Allplan, Archicad, Vectorworks, SDS/2 etc.
 



 • Advise customers on adoption approaches for digital workflows, data\-driven collaboration, cloud\-enabled processes, and connected project environments.
 



  





 Market and customer development
 



 • Identify whitespace opportunities across infrastructure, real estate, EPC, design, and government sectors, and support account teams in developing solution\-led opportunities.
 



 • Collaborate with marketing on customer events, industry campaigns, workshops, and thought\-leadership engagements.
 



 • Help build reference customers, success stories, and repeatable value narratives from field engagements.
 



  





 Partner and ecosystem collaboration
 



 • Work with system integrators, consultants, channel partners, and technology partners on joint opportunities and solution positioning.
 



 • Support technical enablement of partners where required, including solution use cases, demonstrations, and technical messaging.
 



 • Collaborate with customer success and services teams to help ensure smooth transition from sales to adoption
 



  





 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 Experience
 



 • 10\-15 years of experience in technical sales, pre\-sales, solution consulting, or solution engineering roles.
 



 • Strong exposure to AEC, BIM, infrastructure, engineering, or construction technology environments and software like Allplan,SDS/2, Archicad, Vector works etc
 



 • Experience in customer\-facing solution presentations, workshops, and consultative technical selling.
 



  





 Skills and capabilities
 



 • Strong understanding of AEC workflows, BIM\-led collaboration, and digital transformation challenges across the project lifecycle.
 



 • Ability to connect customer business goals with technical solution value and adoption outcomes. • Strong presentation, demonstration, and workshop facilitation skills.
 



 • Comfort engaging both executive stakeholders and detailed technical users.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration capability.
 



 • Familiarity with platforms and technologies such as BIM, digital twins, project controls, cloud SaaS, interoperability, and workflow integration.
 



  





 Preferred background
 



 • Experience with enterprise software vendors serving AEC, infrastructure, engineering, or construction customers.
 



 • Exposure to consultative selling in complex multi\-stakeholder environments.
 



 • Experience working with strategic accounts, ecosystem partners, and enterprise bid cycles.
 



  





 WHAT WE OFFER
 



 • A young, dynamic, and innovation\-oriented environment.
 



 • A wide variety of projects within different industries.
 



 • A very open and informal culture where knowledge sharing, and employee development are key. • Room for personal initiative, development, and growth.

 Technical Skills \-

 Aventior is a leading provider of innovative, end\-to\-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions.
 



  





 At Aventior, our strength lies in combining deep industry expertise with advanced technical capabilities. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision\-making.
 



  





 We bring a holistic, cross\-industry perspective to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support. With a global delivery model, a multi\-country presence, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well\-positioned to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes at scale.

1c21131d.description:

We are currently seeking a dynamic Pre\-Sales System Engineer to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.
 



  





 You would act as the key Systems Engineer to work closely with a sales representative in to handle MSSP/Telco customers. The Systems Engineer's main mission will be to support the sales organization in all technical matters regarding pre\-sales, sales calls, and post\-sales.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and present Fortinet multi\-tenant security architectures to support MSSP service delivery models, including single\-tenant, multi\-tenant, and hybrid deployments.

* Work closely with customers using a consultative approach to understand their business and technical requirements, and recommend the most appropriate Fortinet solutions.
* Understand telecom/service provider networks, data center architectures, cloud environments, and edge security requirements.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Sales, and Channel teams to align technical solutions with MSSP and Telco go\-to\-market strategies.
* Deliver technical training and enablement sessions for MSSP partners and customers.
* Maintain awareness of the competitive landscape and effectively position Fortinet solutions against competitors such as Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, and Check Point.
* Support strategic customer engagements and help drive technical wins.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 




 Minimum 15 years of experience in cybersecurity solutions, presales, telecom/service provider networks, data centers, cloud security and managed services.
 


* Strong understanding of networking technologies, such as Routing, Switching, BGP, Load Balancers, and DNS.
* Solid knowledge of cybersecurity technologies such as NGFW, IPS/IDS, VPN, Zero Trust, SD\-WAN, SASE etc.
* Good understanding of cloud security in public and private cloud environments.
* Experience in application and endpoint security solutions, such as WAF, ADC, EDR/XDR etc.

**Experience Requirements**

* Excellent presentation, whiteboarding, and communication skills.

2d86694d.title: Senior Solutions Lead (Pre-Sales & Implementation)
2d86694d.description:
**About This Job**
**Knowmax**
**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Technology, Information and Internet
   

  

**Job Description**
 Knowmax is an AI Knowledge Management platform built for enterprise CX teams. Telecom, BFSI, healthcare and BPO leaders use us to turn scattered process documentation into guided, AI\-ready answers their agents and customers can act on, across every channel.
   

  

 Governed knowledge that drives action. That is the whole idea.
   

  

 We are part of the KocharTech group, and we serve enterprise customers across North America, the GCC, Southeast Asia and APAC. The US is our biggest growth bet right now, and this role sits close to it.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 You win the deal, then you deliver it.
   

  

 Most companies split this into two jobs and lose something in the handover. The promise made in the demo quietly becomes someone else's problem at kickoff. We keep it in one pair of hands. You shape the technical solution during the sales cycle, then own the implementation once the contract is signed.
   

  

 Roughly half your time is pre\-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, RFPs. The other half is implementation: configuration, integrations, go\-live, early adoption. In practice the split flexes week to week with whatever is closing or going live.
   

  

 You will be the technical face of Knowmax to enterprise buyers and the steady hand that gets them live. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership individual contributor seat, not a people management track.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 Pre\-sales
   

  

 Run technical discovery. Map the prospect's contact centre stack, content estate and integration surface before anyone promises anythingBuild and deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept against the buyer's actual use cases, not a generic scriptOwn the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs and security questionnairesWork alongside sales as the trusted technical advisor through the deal cycleTranslate requirements into clear solution designs, scopes of work and timelines we can actually holdCall out the deals we should not chase. A clean no early is worth more to us than a messy yes.
   

  

 Implementation
   

  

 Own enterprise implementations end to end, from kickoff to go\-liveConfigure the platform, run integrations across CRM, CCaaS, ticketing, SSO and APIs, and oversee content migrationRun onboarding and enablement so customer teams genuinely adopt what we build, not just receive itCoordinate across customer success, engineering and product to clear blockersBuild the implementation playbooks, templates and documentation that make the next ten deployments faster than the last
   

  

**What The First Six Months Look Like**
 Month 1: fluent in the product. Shadowing live deals and one active implementationMonth 3: running discovery and demos independently, and owning at least one enterprise implementation through to go\-liveMonth 6: the default technical voice on our largest pursuits, with a documented implementation playbook a new joiner can follow
   

  

**What You Bring**
 Must have

**Job Title**

Principal Functional Architect
**Join Amadeus: Lead Innovative Solutions for Global Travel**
-------------------------------------------------------------

Would you like to help create impactful solutions that connect aviation and technology? At Amadeus, we partner with some of the world’s leading airlines to design and deliver advanced solutions that shape the future of travel.  



  

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a **Principal Functional Architect** who will design scalable solutions and guide their successful implementation across internal teams and customer projects. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands\-on collaboration, with a strong focus on aligning client needs and Amadeus’ enterprise vision.  



  

**In this role, you’ll:**
-------------------------

* Analyze business needs, design cross\-functional solutions, and ensure alignment with strategic goals.
* Work closely with product managers, architects, and delivery teams to oversee solution feasibility and integration.
* Prepare and present solution recommendations in a way that is clear for diverse stakeholders.
* Promote collaboration across functions to create synergy and maintain solution consistency.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor progress and communicate status updates effectively, ensuring transparency and risk awareness.
Support smooth transition of approved designs into development using agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe).  
* 

  

**Your Profile:**
-----------------

* Extensive experience in solution architecture, business analysis, or related roles (typically 10\+ years).
* Ability to design complex solutions involving multiple systems; familiarity with aviation or travel industry is advantageous.
* Strong communication skills to simplify technical information for varied audiences.
* Experience in managing or contributing to large\-scale, cross\-functional projects.
* Comfortable working in agile environments (knowledge of SAFe or similar frameworks preferred).
* Analytical mindset with an ability to identify dependencies and risks, and propose practical mitigation strategies.
Collaborative, adaptable, and proactive approach to problem\-solving.  
* 

  

**What we can offer you**
-------------------------

A truly global DNA \- Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  

Great opportunities to learn \- Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on\-the\-job training, formal learning activities, and day\-to\-day interactions with colleagues.

A hybrid working model \- We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.

**Company Description** 
 IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients, health, and biosciences, creating innovative solutions that enhance everyday products and experiences. The company combines science, creativity, and an entrepreneurial mindset to advance wellness, delight the senses, and support a more sustainable future. With approximately 22,000 employees across 65 countries, IFF operates over 110 manufacturing facilities and 100 R\&D centers, serving 33,000 customers worldwide. Team members collaborate across disciplines to develop industry\-defining solutions that benefit both people and the planet, offering opportunities to work on impactful, global initiatives. To learn more about IFF’s mission and culture, visit www.iff.com.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Moveworks AI Solution Architect at IFF is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Chennai, responsible for designing and implementing Moveworks AI\-based solutions that support internal business functions. This role focuses on translating business requirements into scalable technical architectures, integrating Moveworks with existing enterprise systems, and ensuring alignment with IFF’s technology standards. The Solution Architect partners with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors to assess current processes, recommend improvements, and drive end\-to\-end solution delivery. Day\-to\-day activities include creating architectural diagrams, overseeing configuration and development efforts, coordinating integration and testing, and supporting deployment and post\-implementation optimization. The role also involves documenting best practices, mentoring technical teams, and proactively identifying opportunities to enhance user experience and operational efficiency through AI\-driven automation.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Solution Architecture skills, including designing scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise solutions.
* Candidates should possess Consulting and Business Process skills to analyze requirements, map workflows, and advise stakeholders on optimal AI\-driven solutions.
* Candidates should possess Software Development skills, with experience in implementing, configuring, and extending enterprise platforms or AI\-based solutions.
* Candidates should possess Integration skills to connect Moveworks and related systems with APIs, middleware, and enterprise applications.
* Relevant skills such as experience with ITSM tools, collaboration platforms (e.g., Microsoft 365, Slack), and cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS) are beneficial.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and documentation abilities, with a collaborative approach to cross\-functional work.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Prior experience in AI\-powered enterprise solutions, automation, or digital workplace technologies is an advantage.

d434c41e.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience performing customer\-facing services focused on translating enterprise customer needs into cloud architectures.
* Experience writing software in one or more languages (e.g., Java, Python, Go).
* Experience developing software, internet infrastructure, or migration solutions in virtual environments.
* Experience leading technical execution for multi\-system projects and delivering technical strategies to executive stakeholders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience designing cloud\-native distributed systems and integrating artificial intelligence models into enterprise applications.
* Experience establishing technical strategies, data governance standards, and architectures for regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience with standard IT security practices, including identity and access management, data protection, and encryption.
* Experience automating infrastructure provisioning, continuous integration pipelines, and container orchestration technologies.
* Ability to advise executive stakeholders on capability mapping and aligning technical roadmaps with business objectives.


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web\-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.
   

  

 As a Principal Enterprise Architect, you will act as a trusted domain expert bridging complex commercial direction with production\-grade technical implementations. You will lead strategic relationships with executive stakeholders, advising them on how to optimize their use of cloud technology to support overarching business processes. Operating at the intersection of business strategy and software engineering, you will own the technical execution of partnerships, translate enterprise needs into architectures, and guide teams through complex digital transformations.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead discovery workshops, construct business capability maps, and define long\-term technical road maps. You will apply core software engineering and system design principles to modernize existing applications and architect novel, cloud\-native solutions incorporating advanced artificial intelligence and agentic workflows. By overseeing system\-level architecture, evaluating technical trade\-offs, and establishing data governance and reliability standards, you will ensure solutions are secure, and commercially viable.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with executive stakeholders to advise on technology strategy, translating ambiguous enterprise needs into structured technical road maps and solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops and business capability mapping sessions to define solution constraints, operational goals, and value\-based implementation sequences.
* Oversee the design and execution of cloud\-native system architectures, utilizing domain\-driven design, event\-driven patterns, and secure integration blueprints.
* Guide the technical development of repeatable solutions, application modernization frameworks, and artificial intelligence orchestrations while ensuring system diagnostics and compliance with industry standards.
* Provide technical direction and mentorship to cross\-functional delivery teams, driving agile governance, code design reviews, and architecture decision logs to ensure product excellence.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

87bbb410.title: Senior Solutions Architect
87bbb410.description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve
   

  

 Cognite operates at the forefront of
 **industrial digitalization, building AI** 
 , and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest\-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low\-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.
   

  

 We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward \- not backwards \- you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

 Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.
   

  

**How You’ll Demonstrate Ownership**
 As a Senior Solution Architect at Cognite, you will play a pivotal role in the Technology department within our Value Delivery organisation. In this customer\-facing position, you will work directly with key customers, field sales, delivery teams, and product development. You will use your seniority and technical competencies to help to lead Norwegian and international industrial customers to increase productivity, profitability, reduce environmental impact and reduce costs. Our customers are large international process and energy industries, with challenges in asset performance and maintenance, production efficiency, and sustainability. Together with the team, you will define solutions and support each integration through to a successful finish.
   

  

* End\-to\-end architecture and solution design leadership.
* Providing strategic and technical expertise to support customers and the customer\-facing project teams.
* Defining enterprise and solution architecture, including integration and data models and data ingestion pipelines, as well as user\-facing solutions
* Expressing complex technical solutions through architecture modeling tools
* Ensure operational responsibility and support agreements for the delivered solutions
* Building strong relationships with key stakeholders, C\-level executives, and IT and Business Data Managers to drive long\-term adoption of Cognite’s products and services
* Training internal teams and partners in your area of specialization
* Collaborating with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management teams to translate customer needs into product offerings
* Independently work with managing integration, data modeling, and related activities using Cognite data connectors and extractors, SQL, Python/Java, Rest APIs and Cloud platform providers like Azure, AWS \& Google
* Collaborate with our Sales, Engineering and Product Management teams to turn customer needs into a prioritised pipeline of product offerings
* Develop and maintain technical and business expertise for Cognite’s products


**The Impact you bring to Cognite**
* We expect all our solutions architects to be hands\-on in python as well as a good hands\-on expertise with software development best practices.
* Open to travel.
* You must be highly organised, thorough, and communicate well with all stakeholders.
* Take ownership and drive tasks independently
* You will be required to collaborate, lead, and coach, as well as work independently.


**Required Qualifications**
* 9\+ years of experience working as a Data Engineer
* Technical background, willing and able to dive in and contribute code for advanced topics when needed


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in Data Engineering is preferred.
* Experience from domains like Manufacturing, Energy, O\&G, Pharma, Life sciences is preferred


**Learn More About Us**
* Impact 2025
* Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
* We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.


***Equal Opportunity***
*Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.*
