Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced SAP Solution Architect with a strong track record in SAP S/4HANA implementation and solution design across at least one major end\-to\-end business process, such as Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Plan to Produce, Account to Report, or Inbound to Outbound.
   

  

 In this role, you will design, deliver, and maintain secure, compliant, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions that meet business needs and enable efficient operations. You will work closely with business\-facing organizations, business partners, process architects, project teams, implementation partners, and operational teams throughout the planning, preparation, execution, and monitoring of projects and business enhancements.
   

  

 You will lead solution discussions, contribute to enterprise architecture decisions, and ensure effective integration across ERP components and connected applications. You will also be accountable for solution quality across the application life cycle, from initial concept and design through implementation, deployment, stabilization, and operational support.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Lead the design and delivery of SAP S/4HANA solutions and related project activities.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, compliant, maintainable, and supportable SAP solutions.
* Collaborate with business partners and process architects to identify fit\-for\-purpose, sustainable, and value\-adding solutions.
* Assess solution options, provide architecture recommendations, and contribute to design decisions that shape the SAP landscape.
* Ensure effective integration across SAP modules including SD/LE, MM, EWM, TM, FI, CO, GTS, EH\&S, and non\-SAP applications like OpenText, Loftware, 3PL systems, Tax applications.
* Provide technical leadership throughout project delivery, business enhancements, testing, deployment, go\-live, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through high\-quality solution design, application life\-cycle management, reliable project delivery, and effective service introduction.
* Ensure compliance with internal process and security requirements and external obligations, including GxP, GDPR, and software licensing requirements.
* Minimize business disruption during go\-live through robust design, effective testing, cutover planning, operational readiness, and a formal project handover process.


**Project delivery**
* Define solution scope, dependencies, interfaces, non\-functional requirements, and technical acceptance criteria.
* Review and approve solution designs in accordance with architecture principles, development standards, and established guidelines.
* Support project planning, execution, monitoring, risk management, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure that solution documentation, test evidence, operational procedures, and handover materials are complete before production release.
* Support post\-go\-live stabilization and the transition of new or enhanced solutions into operational support.


**Change, release, and application life\-cycle management**
* Ensure adherence to change and release management processes in line with relevant standard operating procedures.
* Monitor execution of the application life\-cycle management plan for applications in scope.
* Ensure complete and accurate handover documentation is created and approved before production release.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve the SAP application landscape.


**Who You Are**
* Master’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* At least 12 years of professional experience with SAP applications.
* At least 6 years of experience working in an international environment.
* Proven experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation, project delivery and solution architecture.
* Experience leading technical discussions and coordinating internal teams, business stakeholders, and external delivery partners.
* Experience in regulated environments and with compliance\-related requirements is an advantage.
* Management and leadership experience in an international environment.
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with business partners, process architects, vendors, and technical teams.
* Ability to make sound decisions, manage ambiguity, and act autonomously.
* Strong customer focus and a high level of ownership for solution quality and delivery outcomes.


**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
   

  

 Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

e9b487a2.title: Senior / Solution Consultant - Veeva Quality India
e9b487a2.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.### **The Role**



The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer\-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value\-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross\-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof\-of\-concepts and executive engagement.



The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.



### **What You’ll Do**


* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, differentiated Veeva Quality solution approaches.
* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.
* Lead consultative engagements—including discovery workshops, solution workshops, conference room pilots and proof\-of\-concepts—to demonstrate business value.
* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.
### **Requirements**

* 5\+ years overall experience including 3\+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre\-sales and solution consulting customer\-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of time within India.
* Based in or able to work from the target territories: Mumbai, Hyderabad or Bangalore.
* English and Hindi proficiency; familiarity with relevant regional languages is an advantage.

### **Nice to Have**


* Experience with software solutions used by Quality Assurance and Manufacturing organizations in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech or Diagnostics.
* Hands\-on knowledge of one or more enterprise applications such as QMS, DMS, LMS, VMS or LIMS.
* Experience with SaaS/cloud technology and enterprise software platforms.
* Consulting, business analysis or software implementation experience.
* Previous experience with Veeva applications, including Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Safety.
* Experience in competitive software evaluations and legacy\-system replacement programs.
* Strong teamwork and willingness to contribute to broader team goals.
* The candidate should be curious, energetic, commercially aware, collaborative and comfortable taking ownership of customer\-facing engagements from preparation through follow\-up.
### **Perks \& Benefits**


* Health \& wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break
###### **\#LI\-Remote**


###### **\#LI\-Associate**

  

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

e16960b9.title: Sr. Solution Architect, Startups
e16960b9.description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Do you like startups? Are you interested in Cloud Computing \& Generative AI? Yes? We have a role you might find interesting.
   

  

 Startups are the large enterprises of the future. These young companies are founded by ambitious people who have a desire to build something meaningful and to challenge the status quo. To address underserved customers, or to challenge incumbents. They usually operate in an environment of scarcity: whether that’s capital, engineering resource, or experience. This is where you come in.
   

  

 The Startup Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with these early stage startup companies as they build their businesses. We’re here to make sure that they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible – and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so.
   

  

 We are looking for technical builders who love the idea of working with early stage startups to help them as they grow. In this role, you’ll work directly with a variety of interesting customers and help them make the best (and sometimes the most pragmatic) technical decisions along the way. You’ll have a chance to build enduring relationships with these companies and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.
   

  

 As well as spending time working directly with customers, you’ll also get plenty of time to “sharpen the saw” and keep your skills fresh. We have more than 175 services across a range of different categories and it’s important that we can help startups take advantages of the right ones. You’ll also play an important role as an advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products for the startups you work with. And for the customers you don’t get to work with on a 1:1 basis you’ll get the chance to share your knowledge more broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You’re surrounded by innovation. You’re empowered with a lot of ownership. Your growth is accelerated. The work is challenging. You have a voice here and are encouraged to use it. Your experience and career development is in your hands. We live our leadership principles every day. At Amazon, it's always "Day 1".
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 8\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience in a technical role within a sales organization


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

0e05356d.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI and DATA - Azure Data Solution Architect
0e05356d.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D\&A) –Azure Data Solution Architect**
 As part of our EY\-GDS D\&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Managers (Big Data Architects) with strong technology and data understanding having proven delivery capability. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm as well as a part of a growing Data and Analytics team.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develop standardized practices for delivering new products and capabilities using Big Data \& cloud technologies, including data acquisition, transformation, analysis, Modelling, Governance \& Data management skills
* Interact with senior client technology leaders, understand their business goals, create, propose solution, estimate effort, build architectures, develop and deliver technology solutions
* Define and develop client specific best practices around data management within a cloud environment
* Recommend design alternatives for data ingestion, processing and provisioning layers
* Design and develop data ingestion programs to process large data sets in Batch mode using ADB, ADF, PySpark, Python, Snypase
* Develop data ingestion programs to ingest real\-time data from LIVE sources using Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming and related technologies
* Have managed team and have experience in end to end delivery
* Have experience of building technical capability and teams to deliver


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding \& familiarity with all Cloud Ecosystem components
* Strong understanding of underlying Cloud Architectural concepts and distributed computing paradigms
* Experience in the development of large scale data processing.
* Hands\-on programming experience in ADB, ADF, Synapse, Python, PySpark, SQL
* Hands\-on expertise in cloud services like AWS, and/or Microsoft Azure eco system
* Solid understanding of ETL methodologies in a multi\-tiered stack with Data Modelling \& Data Governance
* Experience with BI, and data analytics databases
* Experience in converting business problems/challenges to technical solutions considering security, performance, scalability etc.
* Experience in Enterprise grade solution implementations.
* Experience in performance bench marking enterprise applications
* Strong stakeholder, client, team, process \& delivery management skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Design and propose Azure\-based data and AI solutions that align with customer objectives and solve business challenges.
* Develop and present demonstrations, prototypes, and PoCs to showcase the value and capabilities of the proposed solutions.
* Create technical proposals, presentations, and respond to requests for proposals (RFPs) and information (RFIs).
* Lead the technical aspects of project delivery, ensuring that implementations align with the initial solution design.
* Define and implement best practices and agile methodologies for the delivery of scalable Cloud solutions.
* Provide expert guidance on data strategy, cloud architecture, and the technology stacks needed for data modernization, AI, and machine learning workloads.
* Data: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, and Cosmos DB.
* AI/ML (knowledge): Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI.
* Minimum 7 years hand\-on experience in one or more of the above areas.
* Minimum 10 years industry experience


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

Serving over 200M customers globally, our Customer Service (CS) organization is at the forefront of shaping how customers experience Amazon. Our team enables Amazon CS’ frontline teams to deliver seamless, consistent, convenient, and delightful customer service to all our customers across every interaction.  

We are looking for a Program Manager to join the Service Delivery organization’s associate empowerment team for associate\-facing products. This role is responsible for owning the programmatic charter to support associate\-facing product roadmaps and strategy across multiple Tech teams. You will partner with Tech teams to evaluate and improve existing tooling, define and design the end\-to\-end experience of associate\-facing tools, and test and implement tools and AI capabilities across one of the largest customer service operations globally. You will work backward from associate pain points, define product requirements, and partner with engineering, operations, and stakeholder teams to deliver solutions at scale. You will balance short\-term tactical improvements with long\-term strategic bets to continuously raise the bar on the associate experience.
  

The ideal candidate combines strong product and program management capabilities, business acumen in operations and product sense with deep associate empathy. You are equally comfortable diving into data and anecdotes to identify opportunities, writing narratives for new concepts, and influencing without authority to align cross\-functional teams on a shared vision. You thrive in ambiguity, are biased toward action, and have a track record of delivering programs smoothly, ideally in an operational or technical environment. Disrupting the status quo by challenging mental models, organizational focus, and technology will be part of your day to day.  

  

This role can be located in Hyderabad.

* Own user acceptance testing (UAT) and incubation management. Define and own success metrics and KPIs; use data to measure launch success and ongoing experience health, informing roadmap prioritization
* Drive framework and mechanisms on AC3 bug/issue management \& resolution

* Partner with Tech, UX design, data science, and operations teams to deliver product features from concept through launch and iteration. Create frameworks to help Tech stakeholders raise the bar on the associate experience.
* Influence and alignment of senior leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders on product direction through compelling narratives and data\-driven recommendations

Our global program team owns Standard Work and Associate Empowerment for Amazon Customer Service. Spread across the globe, we support our operations through tooling, frameworks and standard processes that help us deliver consistently amazing customer experiences.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience

* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience delivering cross functional projects
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams
* Experience with product and feature delivery, incl testing and change management

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

**Description**
 Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.
   

  

 The IPP team designs and builds high\-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross\-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single\-threaded owner for end\-to\-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.
   

  

**Role**
 We are seeking a strategic, experienced Senior Program Manager to own the strategy, execution, and cross\-organizational integration for Band Protections — turning reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention that directly reduces brand abuse for rights owners globally. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high\-ambiguity brand protection challenges with senior leadership visibility
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies
* Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self\-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities
* Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space
* Drive clear communication channels and strategic stakeholder engagement for both internal teams and external brand partners globally
* This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role requiring exceptional judgment, the ability to shape strategy from scratch, and comfort operating in ambiguity. You will work across 5\+ teams and multiple geographies, building solutions that protect millions of brands and strengthen the trustworthiness of Amazon's marketplace.


 This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Identify and resolve ambiguity across organizational boundaries — scoping problems, proposing solutions, and driving alignment where no playbook exists.
* Analyze defects trends, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs
* Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross\-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
* Manage competing priorities across regional teams, making trade\-off recommendations and surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions.
* Own complex enforcement decisions in ambiguous, high\-stakes situations, setting precedents that scale across geographies


**About The Team**
 The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.

**About Us:**


We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH\+.

  



One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH **here**.


**POSITION SUMMARY:**

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer (Web) with deep expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) and a specialization in PWA Kit / Composable Storefront. You will be responsible for designing and developing high\-performance, headless B2C eCommerce solutions.

  



The ideal candidate is an expert in React, who has been part of migration projects from different eCommerce platforms and from SFCC – SFRA into SFCC – PWA Kit, is an expert in Managed Runtime (MRT) , can establish and follow coding standards, resolve bugs, vulnerabilities created by QA and Code quality platforms tools like SonarQube, and bridge modern frontend frameworks with SFCC’s backend power.

  


**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES/ACCOUNTABILITIES OF THE JOB:**


* Develop Headless Features: Build and maintain PWA storefront features including PDP, PLP, Cart, and Checkout using the Retail React App template.


* Code Optimization: Lead the cleanup of the codebase by monitoring SonarQube reports and implementing architectural fixes to ensure high quality\-gate scores.


* API Orchestration: Implement and extend SCAPI/OCAPI integrations and handle complex data mapping between SFCC and the React frontend.


* Managed Runtime (MRT): Deploy and manage bundle versions and environment configurations within the Salesforce Managed Runtime.


* Security \& Auth: Implement secure shopper authentication using SLAS (Shopper Login and API Access Service).


* UI/UX Excellence: Translate Figma/high\-fidelity designs into responsive, accessible, and performant React components.


* Collaboration: Partner with Product, UX/UI, and Backend teams to ensure seamless end\-to\-end user journeys.


* Troubleshooting: Use SFCC Log Center, MRT logs, and browser debugging tools to resolve complex production issues.


* Team work: Participate in scrums and work with SI partners to deliver business requirements.

**INTERNAL \& EXTERNAL CONTACTS:**


* **Internal:** Works closely with business and technology teams, including engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.


* **External:** Engages with technology vendors, consultants, and industry partners to stay updated on best practices and emerging trends.


**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Direct: None


* Indirect: Provide leadership \& guidance to outsourced vendor resources


**BUDGETARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Maintain the environment to minimize budget overflows

**DECISION MAKING:**


* Leads decision\-making on data product development and prioritization in collaboration with stakeholders.


* Recommends technology investments and improvements to enhance data product capabilities.


**RESOURCEFULNESS/CREATIVITY:**


* Ensures technology solutions align with business needs, emphasizing usability, scalability, and cost\-effectiveness.


* Requires strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex business and technical challenges.


**ENVIRONMENT:** This role requires the ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities effectively. Domestic and international travel may be required.

  


**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:**

**Experience:**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience.


* 2\+ Headless storefront implementation experience preferably with full cycle implementation of SFCC Composable storefront/PWA Kit.


* Expert\-level React knowledge, including Hooks, Context API, SSR (Server\-Side Rendering), and state management.


* Strong grasp of SFCC Core Concepts: Mastery of SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API) and OCAPI is essential.


* Code Quality Specialist: Proven experience resolving issues reported by Code quality platforms, including security vulnerabilities, code smells, and maintainability debt.


* Modern Frontend Stack: Expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, ES6\+, and Chakra UI (or similar CSS\-in\-JS libraries).


* Integration Expertise: Experience integrating with OMS, Payment Gateways (via SLAS), and third\-party services in a decoupled environment.


* Performance Mindset: Strong understanding of Core Web Vitals, Service Workers, and caching strategies within Managed Runtime.


* Agile/Scrum: Experience delivering scalable UI within fast\-paced Agile environments.

  


 

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree required, in any relevant business, liberal arts, STEM, or technology/engineering disciplines

  



 **Skills:**


* SFCC PWA Kit and Composable Storefront.


* Experience with 3rd Party tools like Optimizely, Content stack


* Experience with Mocha for automated testing.


* Knowledge of traditional SFRA (to assist in migration/logic extraction).


* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.


* Languages: JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, JSON, SCSS.


* SFCC: PWA Kit, Composable Storefront, SCAPI, OCAPI, Business Manager, SLAS.


* Frontend: React (Expert), TypeScript, Node.js, CSS\-in\-JS (Chakra UI).


* Quality/DevOps: SonarQube, Git, Jira, Postman, Managed Runtime (MRT).


* Legacy Systems: SFRA, ISML (understanding required for migration logic).


* Note: **Apex\-only or traditional SFRA\-only profiles are NOT suitable;** this role requires deep React and Headless\-specific SFCC experience. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to refactor legacy logic into modern React patterns. Candidates must have recent, hands\-on experience with **PWA Kit implementation**.

*PVH Corp. or its subsidiary ("PVH") is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants for employment on the basis of their individual capabilities and qualifications without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military status or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law. In addition to complying with all applicable laws, PVH is also committed to ensuring that all current and future PVH associates are compensated solely on job\-related factors such as skill, ability, educational background, work quality, experience and potential.*

bf9859ac.title: AI Architect Senior Advisor
bf9859ac.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

 AI Architect Senior Advisor
   

  

 The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a senior, customer\-facing practitioner who connects customer needs, measurable business outcomes, and technology solutions. Working directly within customer environments, the FDE partners with business and technical stakeholders to understand complex challenges, reduce ambiguity, make opportunities tangible, and establish a credible path from idea to production value.
   

  

 The FDE combines depth in a relevant specialist discipline with broad knowledge of company and partner platforms, products, accelerators, and reusable assets. They apply domain context, technical judgement, and commercial awareness to identify high\-impact opportunities and determine the most appropriate route to the customer outcome, including bespoke AI delivery, product capabilities, platform or infrastructure services, and reuse of existing assets.
   

  

 The FDE acts as the persistent outcome thread between customer stakeholders and internal engineering, product, architecture, delivery, and operations teams. They shape validated opportunities into delivery\-ready work, remain connected through implementation and adoption, and use customer feedback and production evidence to guide improvement without replacing the accountable production delivery or managed service teams.
   

  

 Combining domain understanding, technical credibility, strong client emotional intelligence, and outcome leadership, the FDE operates independently in ambiguous enterprise environments and is trusted to lead complex customer engagements. The role requires hands\-on problem solving, sound judgement, effective stakeholder influence, and the ability to orchestrate the right capabilities while maintaining focus on measurable customer value and scalable delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand business objectives, workflow challenges, desired outcomes, and the measures that will demonstrate success.
* Lead discovery, assessment, and solution\-shaping activities that translate ambiguous business needs into clear, prioritised opportunities.
* Establish outcome hypotheses, success measures, key assumptions, and customer ownership before recommending material investment or progression.
* Create or direct rapid prototypes, proof points, experiments, and demonstrations that test the assumptions most critical to value and feasibility.
* Assess solution feasibility across AI, data, integration, architecture, security, privacy, Responsible AI, operational readiness, and cost considerations.
* Shape validated opportunities into production\-ready work, including target workflow, architecture direction, prioritised backlog, dependencies, acceptance direction, estimates, and mobilisation requirements.
* Build trusted relationships with technical, business, and senior stakeholders, providing clear guidance and constructive challenge throughout customer engagements.
* Collaborate across engineering, architecture, product, delivery, operations, industry, transformation, and account teams to orchestrate the capabilities required for successful outcomes.
* Analyze and resolve complex business, technical, and operational challenges using sound judgement, evidence, and structured problem\-solving.
* Identify high\-value use cases by combining domain context, stakeholder insight, technology capability, feasibility, and measurable business impact.
* Determine the most appropriate delivery route, including AI Studio, company products, AI Factory, transformation services, partner capabilities, reuse, further validation, or stop.
* Maintain the outcome thread as work moves into delivery by validating major decisions, assumptions, user feedback, adoption needs, and continued alignment to the intended value.
* Capture field feedback, implementation learning, defects, feature requests, customer signals, and reusable patterns from customer engagements.
* Contribute to internal IP, accelerators, reference architectures, implementation playbooks, reusable assets, and continuous improvement of the Forward Deployed and AI Studio methods.
* Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to FDE Candidates and delivery practitioners to strengthen capability and successful outcomes.
* Role may require working at customer sites, company offices, or hybrid delivery locations depending on engagement needs.


**Knowledge and Attributes**
* Strong domain awareness with the ability to understand customer workflows, value drivers, operating constraints, industry context, and relevant success measures.
* Strong technical credibility across enterprise solution architecture, engineering practices, data, integration, cloud platforms, and production technology delivery.
* Applied understanding of artificial intelligence, generative AI, agentic systems, RAG, automation, model and tool integration, and emerging AI technologies.
* Understanding of production AI considerations including evaluation, security, privacy, Responsible AI, observability, AgentOps, FinOps, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Strong client emotional intelligence, consulting, stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly in senior customer environments.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, experimentation, and evidence\-based decision\-making capabilities.
* Deep working expertise in at least one relevant specialist area such as AI engineering, architecture, industry, transformation, product, data, or AI infrastructure.
* Broad knowledge of relevant company and partner platforms, products, accelerators, implementation methods, and reusable assets, and when to apply them.
* Ability to learn and apply domain context quickly, including processes, terminology, regulations, data flows, user roles, constraints, and business metrics.
* Commercial awareness to connect technical choices with business value, risk, cost, time to value, adoption, and the appropriate delivery model.
* Strong outcome leadership, including the ability to define measurable outcomes, surface assumptions, prioritise evidence, and drive Build, Iterate, Route, or Stop decisions.
* Strong reuse and product\-feedback mindset, including the ability to distinguish customer\-specific needs from patterns and improvements that should be scaled.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly with domain, business, executive, engineering, architecture, and operational stakeholders using the appropriate level of detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, challenge constructively, and balance business, technical, commercial, and operational priorities.
* Ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders across multiple organizational levels without relying on formal authority.
* Strong collaboration, relationship\-building, mentoring, and knowledge\-sharing skills, with a bias toward creating customer and practice capability rather than individual dependency.


**Required Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Relevant industry certifications in cloud technologies, solution architecture, data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, agile delivery, industry domains, or related disciplines are beneficial. Certifications support but do not replace demonstrated FDE capability and accreditation.


**Required Experience**
* Typically 8\+ years of relevant experience in software or AI engineering, solution architecture, consulting, customer engineering, product engineering, industry transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines, with equivalent demonstrated depth considered.
* Significant experience working directly with enterprise customers and building credibility with business, technical, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience independently leading discovery, problem framing, solution shaping, or complex customer workstreams in ambiguous environments.
* Experience creating or directing prototypes, proof points, technical experiments, or working solutions to validate customer and technology assumptions.
* Experience shaping and delivering enterprise technology solutions involving architecture, data, integration, security, deployment, and production constraints.
* Experience applying domain or functional context to customer workflows, constraints, KPIs, value drivers, and solution decisions.
* Experience connecting technology decisions to measurable customer outcomes, adoption, business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, or customer experience.
* Experience collaborating with product, engineering, platform, industry, transformation, delivery, and business teams to determine the right solution and delivery route.
* Experience evaluating build, buy, reuse, product, partner, and platform options pragmatically rather than defaulting to bespoke implementation.
* Experience operating within complex enterprise environments and navigating dependencies across technology, data, governance, operations, and customer organizations.
* Experience operating independently, exercising sound judgement, influencing decisions, and maintaining momentum through uncertainty and changing priorities.
* Experience capturing reusable patterns, field feedback, lessons learned, methodologies, accelerators, or other assets that improve future delivery.
* Experience providing guidance, mentoring, peer review, or knowledge sharing to colleagues and developing practitioners.


**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\-term success. We invest over $3\.6 billion each year in R\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start\-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

The role combines hands\-on architecture of cloud\-ready, event\-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle \- setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future\-proof solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture.
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams.
* Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions.
* Design and oversee the development of Java\-based, cloud\-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event\-driven architectures.

* Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support).
* Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices.
* Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption.
* Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability.
* Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
* Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities


**Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3\+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale, distributed applications and microservices.
* Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security).
* Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required.
* Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies.

7d440a2c.title: AI Architect Lead Advisor
7d440a2c.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

 AI Architect Lead Advisor
   

  

 The Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (Lead FDE) is a senior, customer\-facing leader who owns the outcome thread across complex and strategic customer engagements. Working directly with executive, business, and technical stakeholders, the Lead FDE turns ambiguous priorities into measurable outcomes, establishes the path from opportunity to production value, and ensures the right combination of Forward Deployed, product, engineering, transformation, and platform capabilities are brought together around the customer need.
   

  

 The Lead FDE combines deep expertise in a relevant specialist discipline with broad understanding of enterprise AI, technology platforms, industry context, commercial models, and company and partner capabilities. They apply judgement across domain, technology, client relationships, and outcome leadership to shape high\-impact opportunities, determine the most appropriate delivery route, and guide customers through material investment and delivery decisions.
   

  

 The Lead FDE provides continuity across the customer lifecycle, from discovery and validation through production delivery, adoption, value measurement, and continuous improvement. They orchestrate specialist FDEs and scalable delivery teams, maintain alignment between customer outcomes and technical execution, and intervene where assumptions, priorities, risks, or delivery decisions threaten the intended value. The Lead FDE does not replace accountable customer ownership, delivery leadership, or managed service responsibilities.
   

  

 Combining executive\-level client emotional intelligence, strong domain and technical credibility, commercial judgement, and outcome leadership, the Lead FDE operates independently in high\-ambiguity enterprise environments. They lead complex multi\-domain engagements, develop trusted senior relationships, mentor and assure other FDEs, contribute to strategic pursuits, and convert field learning into reusable assets, improved methods, and stronger company capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with executive, business, and technical stakeholders to define strategic objectives, priority workflows, measurable outcomes, and the decisions required to achieve them.
* Lead complex discovery, assessment, and solution\-shaping engagements, turning ambiguous customer priorities into a coherent portfolio of validated opportunities and delivery decisions.
* Establish and maintain the outcome framework across engagements, including business ownership, baselines, target measures, assumptions, dependencies, and evidence required for progression.
* Direct rapid prototyping, proof points, experiments, and demonstrations, ensuring technical effort is focused on the assumptions most critical to customer value, adoption, and feasibility.
* Provide senior technical and solution judgement across AI, data, integration, architecture, security, privacy, Responsible AI, operational readiness, infrastructure, cost, and scalability.
* Shape strategic opportunities into production\-ready work, ensuring architecture direction, backlog, dependencies, acceptance criteria, estimates, governance, and mobilisation are sufficiently mature for scalable delivery.
* Build trusted relationships with executive, business, and technical stakeholders, acting as a senior advisor who can simplify complexity, challenge constructively, and guide material customer decisions.
* Orchestrate specialist Forward Deployed practitioners and teams across industry, transformation, AI Studio, product, AI Factory, architecture, engineering, delivery, and operations around a single customer outcome.
* Lead resolution of complex business, technical, operational, and organisational challenges using sound judgement, structured problem\-solving, evidence, and appropriate escalation.
* Identify, qualify, and prioritise high\-value opportunities by combining domain context, customer strategy, technology capability, feasibility, adoption requirements, and measurable business impact.
* Determine and recommend the most appropriate delivery route, including AI Studio, company products, AI Factory, transformation services, partner capabilities, reuse, further validation, or stop.
* Maintain executive\-level outcome stewardship as work moves into delivery and operation, validating major decisions, changes in assumptions, adoption signals, realised value, and the need to optimise, scale, redirect, or stop.
* Provide engagement\-level assurance for Forward Deployed work, reviewing quality, customer readiness, production shaping, reuse, and transition into scalable delivery models.
* Capture field intelligence, customer signals, product feedback, implementation learning, reusable patterns, and recurring constraints, and translate them into improvements to products, platforms, offers, standards, and delivery methods.
* Develop FDE capability through mentoring, coaching, peer review, Candidate residency, accreditation input, knowledge sharing, and creation of reusable playbooks and assets.
* Role may require working at customer sites, company offices, or hybrid delivery locations depending on engagement needs.


**Knowledge and Attributes**
* Deep domain and business awareness with the ability to understand customer strategy, workflows, economics, operating constraints, industry context, and the measures that determine business value.
* Strong technical credibility across enterprise solution architecture, AI engineering, data, integration, cloud and infrastructure platforms, security, and production technology delivery.
* Broad applied understanding of artificial intelligence, generative AI, agentic systems, RAG, automation, model and tool integration, and the implications of emerging AI technologies for enterprise transformation.
* Strong understanding of production AI considerations including evaluation, security, privacy, Responsible AI, observability, AgentOps, FinOps, resilience, service transition, and operational readiness.
* Exceptional client emotional intelligence, executive communication, consulting, facilitation, stakeholder management, and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to establish trust quickly in complex senior customer environments.
* Strong systems thinking, analytical judgement, problem\-solving, experimentation, and evidence\-based decision\-making capabilities across business and technical domains.
* Deep working expertise in at least one relevant specialist area such as AI engineering, architecture, industry, transformation, product, data, or AI infrastructure, with sufficient breadth to lead multidisciplinary engagements.
* Broad knowledge of relevant company and partner platforms, products, accelerators, implementation methods, commercial offers, and reusable assets, and the judgement to determine when and how they should be applied.
* Ability to rapidly understand unfamiliar domain context, including processes, terminology, regulation, data flows, organisational dynamics, user roles, constraints, and business metrics.
* Strong commercial judgement, including the ability to connect solution choices to business value, risk, cost, margin, time to value, adoption, delivery capacity, and the appropriate commercial and delivery model.
* Advanced outcome leadership, including the ability to establish measurable outcomes, challenge assumptions, prioritise evidence, align stakeholders, and drive Build, Iterate, Route, Scale, or Stop decisions.
* Strong reuse, product\-feedback, and portfolio mindset, with the ability to distinguish customer\-specific needs from patterns, assets, and platform improvements that should be standardised and scaled.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts and trade\-offs clearly with executive, domain, business, engineering, architecture, operational, commercial, and risk stakeholders using the appropriate level of detail.
* Ability to operate independently in high\-ambiguity situations, maintain momentum across competing priorities, challenge constructively, and make sound decisions with incomplete information.
* Ability to influence senior technical and non\-technical stakeholders across organisational boundaries without relying on formal authority, and to align multiple teams around one outcome.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, mentoring, coaching, and knowledge\-sharing skills, with a commitment to developing other FDEs and creating scalable customer and practice capability.


**Required Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and significant relevant professional experience.
* Relevant industry certifications in cloud technologies, solution architecture, data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, agile delivery, industry domains, or related disciplines are beneficial. Certifications support but do not replace demonstrated Forward Deployed leadership capability and experience.


**Required Experience**
* Typically 10\+ years of relevant experience in AI or software engineering, solution architecture, consulting, customer engineering, product, industry transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines, including substantial senior customer\-facing responsibility.
* Proven experience leading complex enterprise engagements and building trusted relationships with executive, business, technical, and operational stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success as a senior Forward Deployed practitioner, customer engineering leader, solution leader, or equivalent across multiple complex engagements.
* Experience leading ambiguous opportunities from discovery and problem framing through evidence, investment decisions, production shaping, adoption, and measurable impact.
* Experience directing prototypes, proof points, experiments, and solution validation while focusing effort on the assumptions most critical to value and feasibility.
* Experience shaping and assuring enterprise solutions involving architecture, AI, data, integration, security, governance, infrastructure, deployment, and production constraints.
* Experience applying industry, business, or functional context to customer workflows, operating models, KPIs, value drivers, and transformation decisions.
* Experience connecting technical and delivery decisions to customer outcomes, adoption, value realisation, commercial considerations, and scalability.
* Experience orchestrating multidisciplinary teams across product, engineering, platform, industry, transformation, architecture, delivery, operations, and account functions.
* Experience evaluating build, buy, reuse, product, partner, platform, and infrastructure options without defaulting to a single solution path.
* Experience operating independently with senior stakeholders, exercising sound commercial and technical judgement, resolving conflict, and maintaining momentum through ambiguity.
* Experience creating or scaling reusable patterns, reference architectures, playbooks, methodologies, accelerators, product improvements, or other assets from field engagements.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring FDEs or FDE Candidates, providing peer assurance, and contributing to capability standards, accreditation, or communities of practice.


**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\-term success. We invest over $3\.6 billion each year in R\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start\-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

eb4259ff.title: Oracle Cloud Technical Senior Consultant
eb4259ff.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Cloud Technical \- Senior Consultant, Managed Services**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations maximize value from enterprise technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As a Senior Consultant within Managed Services, you will support clients in sustaining, enhancing, and optimizing cloud\-based solutions that drive operational performance and business continuity. Working as part of a team of experienced advisors and technical specialists, you will help deliver scalable solutions, solve complex operational challenges, and support ongoing transformation through technology, process improvement, and managed services delivery.
   

  

**Level** 
 : Senior Consultant or equivalent
   

  

 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant, Managed Services on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing, developing, and supporting Oracle Cloud technical solutions across managed services engagements
* Building and maintaining reports, interfaces, extensions, and data conversion components using SQL, BI Publisher, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, Financial Reporting Studio, and File\-Based Data Import templates
* Developing and supporting integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, Service\-Oriented Architecture, Representational State Transfer services, Simple Object Access Protocol services, and Web Services Description Language\-based services
* Performing production support activities, including issue analysis, queue monitoring, ticket updates, code migration support, and resolution within service\-level requirements
* Collaborating with functional, technical, onsite, and offshore teams to support testing, deployments, enhancements, and ongoing platform stability


**The team**
 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
   

  

 The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 24x7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 6\-10 years of experience in Oracle Cloud technical implementation, enhancement, or managed services support
* Experience developing conversions, interfaces, reports, and extensions using SQL, BI Publisher, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, Financial Reporting Studio, and File\-Based Data Import templates
* Experience supporting 4\-5 Oracle Cloud modules, including navigation, data tables, and end\-to\-end process flows
* Experience developing or supporting integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, Service\-Oriented Architecture, Representational State Transfer services, Simple Object Access Protocol services, and Web Services Description Language
* Experience with BI Publisher reports, Enterprise Scheduler Service jobs, data conversions, and production support activities
* Experience with information technology service management processes, including incident, problem, and enhancement management, stakeholder updates, and service\-level agreement\-based support
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or business


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience delivering 2\-3 integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud or Service\-Oriented Architecture
* Experience applying cloud integration patterns in Oracle Cloud environments
* Experience with business intelligence security roles
* Experience with code migration, code reviews, naming standards, and technical quality practices
* Experience with performance tuning and SQL optimization
* Experience supporting global delivery teams across onsite and offshore models


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

d2d02e03.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI and DATA - Azure Data Architect - Manager
d2d02e03.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D\&A) – Manager – Azure Data Architect**
 As part of our EY\-GDS D\&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Managers (Big Data Architects) with strong technology and data understanding having proven delivery capability. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm as well as a part of a growing Data and Analytics team.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develop standardized practices for delivering new products and capabilities using Big Data \& cloud technologies, including data acquisition, transformation, analysis, Modelling, Governance \& Data management skills
* Interact with senior client technology leaders, understand their business goals, create, propose solution, estimate effort, build architectures, develop and deliver technology solutions
* Define and develop client specific best practices around data management within a cloud environment
* Recommend design alternatives for data ingestion, processing and provisioning layers
* Design and develop data ingestion programs to process large data sets in Batch mode using ADB, ADF, PySpark, Python, Snypase
* Develop data ingestion programs to ingest real\-time data from LIVE sources using Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming and related technologies
* Have managed team and have experience in end to end delivery
* Have experience of building technical capability and teams to deliver


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding \& familiarity with all Cloud Ecosystem components
* Strong understanding of underlying Cloud Architectural concepts and distributed computing paradigms
* Experience in the development of large scale data processing.
* Hands\-on programming experience in ADB, ADF, Synapse, Python, PySpark, SQL
* Hands\-on expertise in cloud services like AWS, and/or Microsoft Azure eco system
* Solid understanding of ETL methodologies in a multi\-tiered stack with Data Modelling \& Data Governance
* Experience with BI, and data analytics databases
* Experience in converting business problems/challenges to technical solutions considering security, performance, scalability etc.
* Experience in Enterprise grade solution implementations.
* Experience in performance bench marking enterprise applications
* Strong stakeholder, client, team, process \& delivery management skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Design and propose Azure\-based data and AI solutions that align with customer objectives and solve business challenges.
* Develop and present demonstrations, prototypes, and PoCs to showcase the value and capabilities of the proposed solutions.
* Create technical proposals, presentations, and respond to requests for proposals (RFPs) and information (RFIs).
* Lead the technical aspects of project delivery, ensuring that implementations align with the initial solution design.
* Define and implement best practices and agile methodologies for the delivery of scalable Cloud solutions.
* Provide expert guidance on data strategy, cloud architecture, and the technology stacks needed for data modernization, AI, and machine learning workloads.
* Data: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, and Cosmos DB.
* AI/ML (knowledge): Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI.
* Minimum 7 years hand\-on experience in one or more of the above areas.
* Minimum 10 years industry experience


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

a4935e85.title: Associate Consultant / Manager Consulting Expert - DevOps Architect
a4935e85.description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: Associate Consultant / Manager Consulting Expert \- DevOps Architect  

Position: Associate Consultant / Manager Consulting Expert  

Experience: 12\-18 Years  

Category: Software development / Engineering  

Shift: General Shift  

Main location: Bangalore/Mumbai/ Chennai  

Position ID: J0626\-1452  

Employment Type: Full Time  

  

Position Description:  

12\+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering — you have rebuilt a slow, fragile pipeline before and can show the outcome. Deep hands\-on expertise in GitHub Actions (or equivalent); you write pipelines as production code, not YAML copy\-paste. Strong grasp of dependency analysis — build graphs, artifact registries, incremental compilation, and test\-impact analysis.  

Proven experience designing automated rollback and blue\-green or canary promotion strategies in a multi\-tenant environment. Comfortable with Terraform, Kubernetes (AKS), and policy\-as\-code – you can trace a change from Git commit to running workload. Communicates trade\-offs clearly to both engineering teams and leadership; writes the design doc before writing the code

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Audited and instrumented the end\-to\-end CI/CD pipeline to identify bottlenecks, analyze stage dependencies, and improve pipeline visibility through comprehensive dependency mapping and performance metrics.
* Redesigned the CI/CD architecture by implementing parallel execution, incremental builds, intelligent caching, artifact promotion, and reproducible environments to accelerate build and deployment cycles.
* Engineered automated rollback capabilities across deployment pipelines, ensuring every promotion stage was fully reversible without manual intervention to minimize release risks and downtime.
* Enhanced pipeline resilience by implementing flaky test isolation, configurable retry mechanisms, circuit breakers for external dependencies, and proactive monitoring with automated alerts to maintain pipeline reliability.
