2279539b.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program management.
* 2 years of experience designing, constructing, or managing infrastructure projects.
* Experience creating infrastructure designs (e.g., telecom, electrical, mechanical), drawing sets for builds, and remodels of data center networking spaces.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in Network, Electrical, Industrial, Mechanical, or other Engineering related field.
* Experience with data center, networking, or telecom operations.
* Experience with both Outside Plant (OSP) and Inside Plant (ISP) fiber optic infrastructure, including deep knowledge of Dark Fiber, Network Infrastructure, ISP/OSP Network Architecture, Network Topology, and Field Deployment.
* Excellent problem solving and communication skills, with the ability to construct, articulate, and defend simple messages or insights from analysis.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Our team is responsible for planning, design, sourcing and delivery of the global network infrastructure that connects every Google application and Google Cloud product to our users and customers globally. With the planned rollout of new AI hub in India, the role is critical to ensure timely, quality and cost effective delivery of scalable network connecting existing and upcoming Data Centers across India and rest of the world.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to understand or identify defined work problems and program goals, obtain prioritized deliverables, and discuss program impact.
* Prioritize program goals, understand and translate other stakeholders needs into program goals and prioritized deliverables with minimal assistance, and contribute to decisions on prioritizing goals and deliverables.
* Ensure unit cost delivery for Google network infrastructure aligned to near build cost economics. Review key metrics pertaining to a program, monitor potential deviations, and define actions for critical deviations.
* Identify, communicate, and collaborate with relevant stakeholders within one or more teams to drive impact and work toward mutual goals. Build, maintain and enhance business, operational, and management dashboards.
* Manage the approved network plan with internal contributors such as network negotiators or vendor delivery managers to ensure infrastructure is delivered on\-time.

e7b64253.title: Principal Project/Program Manager
e7b64253.description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into intelligent system solutions that drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world.


With annual revenue exceeding $14 billion and approximately 25,000 employees worldwide, ADI enables today’s innovators to stay *Ahead of What’s Possible.*  



**About the Role**

The Software and Digital Platforms Group at ADI is seeking an accomplished Principal Project/Program Manager to lead the end\-to\-end development of complex, multi\-core SoCs and platform\-based products.


In this high\-impact role, you will drive requirements alignment, risk\-managed execution, and on\-time delivery across diverse cross\-functional teams spanning hardware, software, IP, system architecture, and foundry engineering. You will help define and deliver the next generation of integrated digital platforms that power ADI’s intelligent edge solutions.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* **Lead Complex SoC Development Programs**  

Drive product execution from concept through silicon delivery and production release — managing hardware, software, IP, and system integration across global teams.
* **Own Program Planning and Governance**  

Define and manage the Plan of Record (POR) including scope, schedule, cost, and risk. Apply structured change management through the Change Request (CR) process to maintain execution discipline and traceability.
* **Align Technical and Business Requirements**  

Partner with product, architecture, and engineering teams to translate system\-level requirements into actionable technical milestones and verification goals. Ensure alignment across HW/SW interfaces and third\-party IPs.
* **Ensure Predictable, On\-Time Execution**  

Develop detailed program schedules across multiple functional workstreams. Track dependencies, identify risks early, and drive timely mitigation to maintain schedule fidelity.
* **Drive Proactive Risk Management**  

Establish a culture of early risk identification, quantification, and mitigation. Lead structured risk reviews and implement data\-driven trade\-off decisions to keep projects on track.
* **Enable Cross\-Functional Collaboration**  

Foster strong collaboration between system, hardware, software, IP, and foundry teams to ensure seamless integration and efficient debug/validation closure.
* **Drive Process and Execution Excellence**  

Contribute to **continuous process improvements** across planning, execution, and communication workflows. Identify and implement enhancements that improve efficiency, predictability, and quality across programs.
* **Communicate with Clarity and Influence**  

Provide transparent, data\-backed program updates to engineering leadership and business stakeholders. Balance customer commitments with long\-term platform scalability.
* **Mentor and Lead by Example**  

Support the growth of ADI’s project management community through mentorship, coaching, and promoting best practices in program execution, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.
  

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 15\+ years of experience leading complex SoC or ASIC programs with high system integration.
* Proven success managing multi\-core processors, HW/SW co\-development, and multi\-IP integration.
* Deep understanding of SoC design flows including architecture, RTL, verification, validation, and productization.
* Demonstrated excellence in requirements management, schedule control, and risk management.
* Experience working within a phase\-gate or hybrid product development lifecycle.
* Strong organizational, leadership, and communication skills; able to engage effectively across technical and executive levels.
* PMP certification or equivalent experience preferred.
* Experience collaborating with external IP vendors, foundries, and system\-level customers is highly desirable.
  

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

At ADI, you’ll be part of a team that thrives at the intersection of technology and impact. You’ll have the opportunity to shape complex digital platforms that define the future of intelligent systems — all while working in an environment that values innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning.


Join us to lead transformation at the intelligent edge — and help the world stay *Ahead of What’s Possible.*

**Flex Work Policy**

* Flexibility to work remotely up to 2 days per week.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce \- Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State \- Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*

Job Req Type: Experienced  

Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time  

Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

9fe443d6.description:
**Description**
 Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go\-to partner for the world’s most forward\-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting\-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI\-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI\-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.
   

  

**Overview**
 Synaptics is looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our Global Operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, coupled with exceptional program management skills. As the ASIC Program Manager, you will oversee the entire product lifecycle from concept through production, working closely with cross\-functional teams including design, verification, validation, and manufacturing to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality ASICs. The successful candidate will play a key project leadership role, acting as the primary owner of SOC program execution on the project planning scheduling, inter\-team coordination, status tracking and reporting. Sr. Director, Program Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Competencies**
 Job Duties
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
* Lead and coordinate all aspects of ASIC development programs from requirements gathering through to final product release, including design, verification, validation, and production rampup
* Work closely with internal engineering teams (ASIC design, firmware, validation, etc.), external partners, and vendors to manage deliverables and ensure alignment on project goals and schedules
* Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
* Actively support sustainable, effective cross\-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
* Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
* Act as the primary point of contact between engineering, product management, and senior leadership, providing regular status updates on program progress, issues, and risk management
* Monitor and manage the program budget, ensuring projects are delivered within financial constraints
* Manage relationships with operation team and external ASIC vendors, ensuring that they meet technical and delivery requirements
* Ensure proper documentation of program processes, designs, and decisions throughout the ASIC development lifecycle
* Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems


 Competencies
   

  

* Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
* Developing talent, ability to inspire and excite team
* Highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team


**Qualifications (Requirements)**
* Bachelor's (Master’s preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent
* A deep understanding of ASIC design, verification, and manufacturing processes is essential.
* 15\+ years of experience in Program Management, including 5\+ years of expertise in engineering program management Experience in rigorous life\-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
* Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (Jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
* Hands\-on technical experience preferred
* No travel required

 Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Market Engagement Manager, SheConnects Digital Accelerator based in India.**
 This role offers the opportunity to combine commercial strategy with meaningful digital inclusion initiatives across India and Africa.
   

  

 You will work with a diverse portfolio of partners to accelerate women's adoption and use of the internet, with a particular focus on smartphone ownership and digital access.
   

  

 The position blends strategic advisory work, market analysis, project delivery, and senior stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 You will help partners identify market opportunities, develop scalable propositions, and translate insights into practical interventions with measurable commercial and social outcomes.
   

  

 You will also contribute to knowledge sharing across the broader digital inclusion ecosystem through research, case studies, workshops, events, and thought leadership.
   

  

 The role operates in a fast\-paced, international environment where collaboration with businesses, governments, donors, mobile operators, and ecosystem organizations is central to success.
   

  

 It is particularly suited to a commercially minded professional who is motivated by the potential of digital services to improve women's livelihoods, economic security, and resilience.

* Manage the effective contracting, coordination, and delivery of technical assistance packages and advisory engagements.
* Analyze markets, business models, data, and emerging opportunities to identify interventions that can generate both commercial value and social impact.
* Contribute to the design and delivery of propositions and strategies that address barriers to digital adoption, including smartphone affordability and access.
* Facilitate strategy workshops and other collaborative sessions with partners and stakeholders to translate insights into actionable plans.
* Track commercial and social outcomes across partner engagements, ensuring initiatives remain focused on measurable impact and sustainable scale.
* Develop and communicate market insights, partner learnings, and evidence that can encourage increased awareness and action across the digital inclusion ecosystem.
* Document findings through presentations, case studies, toolkits, blogs, events, and stakeholder meetings.
* Facilitate knowledge exchange and learning between partners across different markets and geographies.
* Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across the private sector, mobile ecosystem, governments, donors, and other relevant organizations.
* Use evidence, industry insights, and compelling recommendations to influence stakeholders and support sustainable action.
* Collaborate closely with internal and external teams to ensure effective delivery of multiple workstreams and high\-quality outputs.


**Requirements**
* Significant commercial experience gained through management consulting, corporate strategy, business planning, marketing, or a related strategic function.
* Experience working within or alongside the digital, technology, telecommunications, or mobile ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with strategies designed to improve inclusion for underserved populations, particularly women, with an understanding of approaches to smartphone affordability, adoption, and usage.
* Ability to quickly understand new data, markets, technologies, and business models and identify opportunities that can generate both commercial and social value.
* Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to distill complex information into clear insights and practical recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to engage confidently with senior executives and other decision\-makers across private\-sector, government, donor, and ecosystem organizations.
* Strong influencing and persuasion skills, with the ability to build alignment around evidence\-based recommendations.

* Strong project and delivery management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and workstreams while maintaining quality and deadlines.

* Commercial awareness and understanding of market dynamics, business models, and the factors that influence sustainable adoption of digital products and services.
* Collaborative and self\-aware approach, with a strong ability to work as part of a team, support colleagues, and seek assistance when needed.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, adaptability, and ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced international environment.
* Genuine interest in the transformative potential of internet access and digital services to improve women's livelihoods, economic security, and resilience.


**Benefits**

* Fixed\-term contract through March 31, 2028\.
* Flexible working arrangements, including flexi\-time and remote working options.
* Generous holiday allowance.

* Strong learning and development opportunities to support continued professional growth.
* Exposure to the global mobile, technology, and digital inclusion ecosystem.
* Opportunities to work on international projects spanning India and Africa.

ecae14e1.description:
“ARE YOU A THINKING, SLEEPING, EATING TECHNOLOGY ENTHUSIAST WITH A HEAD FOR BUSINESS AND HIGH\-LEVEL STRATEGIES?"

  



Do you have very good acumen to understand technology, but you are not picking up a traditional job at a software services company or core job?


Do you have loads of potential, but you need serious business mentorship and training to realize it?


Do you love analytical challenges, but can’t find the right place to really push your growth?


If this sounds like you, and if you are pursuing engineering or just completed one and looking for an internship or starting\-level job, we’ve got your perfect job.

  



Join GreyB’s Graduate Program in Solutioning and Welcome to the ‘6ie’ world of IP (Intellectual Property) which is based on innovation, cutting\-edge technology and long\-term strategy for the intangible assets of an organization.

  



We are looking for engineers who have:


* good skills to understand technology concepts


* likes analysis, reading data patterns, and wants to apply analytical skills


* smart communication skills, specially the written communication and ability to understand technology concepts by lot of reading of technical documents.

  



This is your chance to learn and take part in analyzing technology concepts, find relations between data points, contribute in building client relationships, and conveying insights to upper management to help them make strategic business decisions.

  



Note: This is not a marketing or sales role. If you do not like reading about and understanding complex concepts across various technology domains – this is not a right fit for you.

  



How it works?

  



Stage 1: First 1 month get hands on experience in Industry research and analysis


Stage 2: Next 5 months get you on board of Strategic Solutions and start hustling.


Stage 3: Join our rock rock\-solid solutions team. You will start assisting your Managers in their day\-to\-day activities {Message: Learning on the job and on the live scenarios}

  



What will you get from this role? (provided you work hard)

  



In the span of 2\-3 years working in this role, you would learn and accrue skills that even the major B\-school students envy as you’ll be immediately thrust into the heart of the company, doing serious work.

  



Using your engineering expertise, you will be directly involved in the research for technology concepts and inventions and then translating the research findings to reports, proposals, presentations that help clients answer their IP problems.


You will be given the chance to learn and get involved with upper management in designing major marketing/ sales campaigns, and be responsible for its successful implementation.


You will have direct exposure to strategy teams and they will train and coach you and teach you everything you need to know to succeed at your tasks. They will expect you to crush them, and then mentor you when you don’t.

  



You will learn to think like a CEO

  



But before you get all excited and start applying, understand one very important thing:


This work is no joke.

  



You’d better be willing and able to learn quickly, work hard, and get results. This is NOT for someone who wants to “play start\-up.” This role is for a hustler looking for an incredible opportunity to use their drive to learn invaluable skills and advance quickly. If that describes you, come get it.

  



What are the qualities we are looking for? (candidates will be tested for these qualities)

  



The candidate we are looking for would have an ideal mix of the following qualities:

  



Quick on the uptake – You should be a fast learner adept at grasping new concepts and technologies across a variety of cross domain areas (Electronics/ Life sciences/ Industrial/Communication, etc.), as well as quickly adapt to changing situations.

  



Creative Thinker – You should have the flair to innovate and be creative, even with minimal input and resources.

  



Problem Solver – You should have the ability to quickly use logical approaches to solve real\-life business problems.

  



Perseverant – You should be ‘hell\-bent’ on achieving goals, no matter how much you get beat down.

  



What are the skills you should have?

  



1\. Excellent written and spoken English skills.


2\. Ability to articulate and communicate your thoughts effectively \- verbally and also on paper.


3\. Basic MS Word, PowerPoint and Excel skills

  



Important tips to keep in mind when applying – When submitting your Resume and cover letter, remember – hundreds of others are applying as well. Use your creativity to make your letter and resume stand out. (This is your first test!)


{Hint – Businesses are built on providing ‘value’ to customers. In your cover letter, show how you can add value to GreyB.

  



Additional Hint – Read up on the internet on ‘effective email writing’ or ‘effective article/blog writing’ before writing your letter}

  



Summary of Job Function:


* Work closely with customers (Patent Attorneys/ IP Counsels) and build a comprehensive understanding of customers’ business and functional needs in order to propose customized solutions based on your technical expertise, and GreyB’s capabilities in the area of Intellectual Property Support Services and Patent Research \& Analytics.
* Through secondary research and business insights, advise and support the sales team in the sale of IP services.
* Build close working relations with customers so that you are the ‘go\-to’ person for solving their problems.
* Work with Operations team to track and monitor status of customers project.
* Act as ‘inside customer’ to Ops and make sure customer expectations are being met.
* Collaborate with Sales/ Marketing teams to design and implement targeted Sales/ Marketing strategies.

d5bb2e65.description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Network Architect \| HM\- Ashish Pawar**

**Your Day at Altera Digital Health**

The **Senior Network Architect** is a highly skilled subject matter expert responsible for designing, architecting, and leading complex and strategic network initiatives.


This role involves setting network technology standards, driving innovation, and providing technical leadership in network infrastructure design and implementation.


The Senior Network Architect plays a pivotal role in shaping network strategies and ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.


**Location:** Pune, India – Remote
  

**Experience:** 15–18\+ Years
  

**Certification:** **CCIE – Mandatory**

**What You'll Be Doing**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and architecture of advanced network solutions, including **LAN, WAN, Data Center, Cloud, and Hybrid Cloud environments** .
* Develop highly scalable, secure, resilient, and high\-performing network architectures to meet current and future business requirements.
* Define and establish network technology standards, best practices, architecture principles, and technology roadmaps.
* Evaluate new networking technologies and recommend their adoption based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to strategic network initiatives that align with the company's long\-term technology and business goals.
* Introduce innovative solutions and approaches to enhance network performance, security, availability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Lead and manage network projects from inception through completion.
* Ensure project objectives are achieved, resources are allocated effectively, and project milestones are delivered successfully.
* Collaborate closely with senior leadership, cross\-functional teams, and business stakeholders to ensure network solutions align with overall business strategies.
* Serve as a senior\-level subject matter expert and provide technical guidance, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to network engineering and operations teams.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with network vendors, service providers, cloud providers, and technology partners.
* Evaluate vendor offerings and technical solutions and provide recommendations aligned with organizational requirements.
* Lead efforts to optimize network performance by analyzing traffic patterns, implementing appropriate QoS strategies, improving network resiliency, and enhancing availability.
* Stay current with emerging networking technologies, industry trends, and technology developments and assess their applicability to the organization.
* Develop and maintain high\-level network documentation, including architecture diagrams, HLD/LLD documents, configuration templates, standards, and technical guidelines.
* Perform network capacity planning to accommodate anticipated business growth and evolving technology requirements.
* Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership for network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
* Lead architecture reviews and ensure network designs comply with established enterprise standards, security requirements, and best practices.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex network architecture, performance, and connectivity issues.

**Knowledge and Attributes**

* Extensive understanding of advanced networking concepts, protocols, architectures, and services.
* Extensive proficiency in designing, configuring, and managing complex network environments, including **routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, SD\-WAN, and cloud networking technologies** .
* Extensive knowledge of advanced network protocols and technologies such as **BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VXLAN/EVPN, SD\-WAN, QoS, IPv4/IPv6, and advanced security protocols** .
* Strong understanding of enterprise LAN, WAN, Data Center, Internet, and Hybrid Cloud architectures.
* Extensive experience with **Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud networking** .
* Strong understanding of network security architecture, firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, network segmentation, and secure connectivity.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with network monitoring, analysis, troubleshooting, and performance management tools.
* Excellent documentation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Extensive proficiency in network administration, configuration, and architecture tools.
* Proven experience leading and managing large\-scale network architecture, transformation, and migration projects.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
* Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures.
* Strong ability to align network strategies and technology roadmaps with business objectives.
Ability to work effectively with global teams, senior leadership, vendors, service providers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.  
* 

  

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in **Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field** .
* **Active CCIE certification is mandatory.**
* Preferred CCIE specializations include:
	+ CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure
	+ CCIE Service Provider
	+ CCIE Security
* Relevant cloud certifications such as **Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud** are preferred.
* Additional networking or security certifications are an advantage.

**Required Experience**

* **Minimum 15–18\+ years of experience in the Network and Security domain.**
* Extensive experience in network engineering, architecture, and progressively responsible technical leadership roles.
* Extensive experience working in large\-scale enterprise networking environments.
* Extensive experience designing and architecting complex **LAN and WAN** environments.
* Extensive experience with **network security** and enterprise security architectures.
* Extensive experience with **Data Center networking and connectivity** .
* Extensive experience with **cloud networking, including Azure and/or AWS** .
* Extensive experience with **SD\-WAN and software\-defined networking (SDN)** concepts.
* Proven experience with network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
* Proven experience working with network vendors, ISPs, cloud providers, and technology partners.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership and architectural direction to engineering and operations teams.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* **15–18\+ years of relevant Network and Security experience.**
* **Active CCIE certification – Mandatory.**
* Strong enterprise network architecture and design experience.
* Expert\-level Cisco networking experience.
* Strong expertise in **BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD\-WAN, LAN/WAN, and Data Center networking** .
* Strong experience with network security technologies.
* Strong experience with cloud and hybrid network architectures.
* Proven experience leading complex network projects and strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
   

  

 Job Title: Associate Consultant / Manager Consulting Expert \- DevOps Architect
   

  

 Position: Associate Consultant / Manager Consulting Expert
   

  

 Experience: 12\-18 Years
   

  

 Category: Software development / Engineering
   

  

 Shift: General Shift
   

  

 Main location: Bangalore/Mumbai/ Chennai
   

  

 Position ID: J0626\-1452
   

  

 Employment Type: Full Time
   

  

 Position Description:
   

  

 12\+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering — you have rebuilt a slow, fragile pipeline before and can show the outcome. Deep hands\-on expertise in GitHub Actions (or equivalent); you write pipelines as production code, not YAML copy\-paste. Strong grasp of dependency analysis — build graphs, artifact registries, incremental compilation, and test\-impact analysis.
   

  

 Proven experience designing automated rollback and blue\-green or canary promotion strategies in a multi\-tenant environment. Comfortable with Terraform, Kubernetes (AKS), and policy\-as\-code – you can trace a change from Git commit to running workload. Communicates trade\-offs clearly to both engineering teams and leadership; writes the design doc before writing the code
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

* Audited and instrumented the end\-to\-end CI/CD pipeline to identify bottlenecks, analyze stage dependencies, and improve pipeline visibility through comprehensive dependency mapping and performance metrics.
* Redesigned the CI/CD architecture by implementing parallel execution, incremental builds, intelligent caching, artifact promotion, and reproducible environments to accelerate build and deployment cycles.
* Engineered automated rollback capabilities across deployment pipelines, ensuring every promotion stage was fully reversible without manual intervention to minimize release risks and downtime.
* Enhanced pipeline resilience by implementing flaky test isolation, configurable retry mechanisms, circuit breakers for external dependencies, and proactive monitoring with automated alerts to maintain pipeline reliability.
* Established automated quality gates incorporating unit, smoke, security, and policy validation checks to prevent unsafe deployments while preserving fast feedback and deployment velocity.
* Developed reusable DevOps frameworks, Infrastructure\-as\-Code modules, and standardized CI/CD templates, while documenting architectural decisions, conducting code reviews, and enabling seamless knowledge transfer to support long\-term maintainability and team adoption.


**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12\+ years of relevant experience.
   

  

 Must to Have:
   

  

 Azure Devops Automation, Coding/scripting, Kubernetes, Ansible, Docker, Container, Argo CD, ConfigMap, Terraform, Control plane. DevOps Engineering,Python¸ Groovy, Containerization¸ Github
   

  

 Good\-to\-Have Skills: Database, Sygnoz/NewRelic/Dynatrace, RDBMS understanding, Development/Automation background with proven work experience.
   

  

 CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
   

  

 Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

**Requirements**

80070fdf.title: GenAI Planning Program Manager, AWS Supply Chain - IPS
80070fdf.description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low\-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain \& Procurement (ISCaP) organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly\-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!
   

  

 The GenAI Spares Planning Team RMA Program Manager is the single\-threaded owner for ensuring Nvidia GPU material flows correctly through the returns lifecycle across the GenAI accelerator fleet. Nvidia GPUs are among our highest\-value spare parts, and as the fleet scales, spares supportability increasingly depends on the timely recovery and re\-induction of RMA returns. Execution sits with cross\-functional partners (HWEng, Logistics, AIS\-SC, Nvidia); this role monitors that flow end\-to\-end, holds SLA adherence at every handoff, escalates disruptions, and drives owners to recovery — backed by the reporting mechanisms that make the program scalable.
   

  

 If you love being at the forefront of industry growth and development, developing and executing processes in a highly ambiguous environment, identifying information gaps and collaboration needs, and driving business strategy, then this is the spot for you. This is a high impact role offering an opportunity to drive and influence business\-critical decisions impacting the long\-term future of the business.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Owns monitoring SLA adherence across all Nvidia GPU components covered under RMA agreements, at key handoffs and nodes throughout the supply chain cycle.
* Escalates disruptions and drives recovery plans to resolution, coordinating across HWEng, Supporting Logistics Teams, AIS\-SC, Nvidia, and GenAI SPMs.
* Ensures readiness of RMA programs for new Nvidia GPU components ahead of platform launches – including
* Collecting AFRs from HWEng
* Coordinating with SPMs to size initial seed stock pool
* Raising Buffer Stock RMA submissions in Nvidia’s portal
* Monitoring fulfillment of initial seed stock allocations from Nvidia
* Monitors approved failure log coverage and surfaces gaps to HWEng.
* Expands NVTool into a scalable mechanism that supports budget planning for GPU spares, including ongoing monitoring of actual vs. planned spend
* Leads initiatives to streamline and optimize the RMA supply chain, including onboarding Nvidia to the Janus Spares Supply Model.
* Monitors degrade rates post\-launch to identify shortages to required target levels (considering purchased inventory and seed stock), advocating for additional seed stock supply, as needed.
* Monitors and escalates stuck inventory (e.g. replaced GPUs held without logs) requiring state change back to SPARE.


**About The Team**
 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
* 4\+ years of relevant strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
* 2\+ years of data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years experience in global supply chain management, managing cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced consumer electronics product company


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field

The architect will lead solution scoping, requirement analysis, technical design, and deployment oversight while ensuring compliance, security, performance, and regulatory alignment across markets.

 FinTech Solution Design \& Architecture
 



 Design scalable, secure, and regulatory\-compliant solutions for digital payments, wallets, merchant transactions, lending, credit scoring, and financial ecosystem integrations.
 



 Analyze customer financial operations, transaction flows, risk controls, and compliance requirements to define optimized solutions.

 Cross\-Functional Collaboration

 Provide continuous feedback to improve solutions, architecture patterns, and product capabilities.

 Architecture design (cloud/on\-prem), microservices, containerization, high\-availability and DR setups.

 Strong understanding of digital payments, wallets, mobile money, merchant acquiring, lending platforms, KYC/AML, fraud systems, and transaction processing.

c2fdbcdc.title: Solutions Architect
c2fdbcdc.description:
**About ZEISS VisioGen** 




  





 ZEISS VisioGen is building the future of AI\-powered healthcare by developing human\-verified clinical communication solutions for ophthalmology practices. We combine cutting\-edge Generative AI with clinical expertise to build scalable, production\-ready applications that enhance patient engagement and improve healthcare delivery.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a
 **Solution Architect** 
 to support the design, implementation, integration, and scaling of
 **ZEISS VisioGen** 
 , a human\-verified AI patient engagement platform built for premium ophthalmology practices.
 



  





 The role will act as a bridge between business teams, product teams, engineering, IT, customer success, and external clinic partners. The Solution Architect will be responsible for understanding clinic workflows, defining technical solution designs, supporting integrations, ensuring secure and scalable implementation, and helping convert business requirements into practical technology solutions.
 



 This role requires a strong understanding of SaaS platforms, healthcare workflows, AI\-enabled products, API integrations, data security, and enterprise IT governance.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Solution Design \& Architecture** 



* Design scalable, secure, and clinic\-ready solution architectures for VisioGen implementations.
* Convert business and customer requirements into clear technical solution designs.
* Define end\-to\-end workflows covering chatbot interface, AI response generation, human review, clinic escalation, reporting, and system integration.
* Ensure the platform architecture supports reliability, performance, security, and future scalability.



**2\. Customer \& Clinic Implementation Support** 



* Work with US ophthalmology clinics to understand their website, patient inquiry flow, appointment booking process, CRM usage, and operational workflow.
* Identify how VisioGen can be embedded into each clinic’s digital ecosystem.
* Support technical discovery calls with customers, partners, and vendors.
* Prepare implementation documents, integration notes, workflow maps, and technical requirement documents.



**3\. Integration \& API Management** 



* Evaluate and design integrations with clinic websites, CRMs, scheduling tools, marketing platforms, analytics tools, and communication systems.
* Work with APIs, webhooks, data exchange formats, and middleware platforms such as Zapier, HubSpot, or similar systems.
* Coordinate with internal and external development teams to ensure integrations are delivered correctly.
* Troubleshoot integration gaps and recommend practical workarounds where needed.



**4\. Security, Compliance \& Governance** 



* Ensure all solution designs follow healthcare data privacy, security, and compliance expectations, including HIPAA\-aligned workflows where applicable.
* Work closely with ZEISS IT, CIT, InfoSec, and compliance teams for tool approvals and architecture reviews.
* Support risk assessment, data flow documentation, access control planning, and vendor evaluation.
* Ensure AI workflows are designed with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop review and governance.



**5\. Product \& Platform Enablement** 



* Partner with product managers to define technical feasibility for new product features.
* Provide architecture inputs for dashboards, analytics, reporting, AI workflows, and clinic\-specific customization.
* Identify reusable implementation models that can reduce deployment time across multiple clinics.
* Support creation of internal playbooks, SOPs, technical FAQs, and implementation templates.



**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Collaborate with sales, customer success, clinical operations, engineering, product, IT, and external clinic stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales conversations by explaining technical capabilities in simple business language.
* Help sales teams respond to technical questions from clinics, marketing partners, and service providers.
* Act as the technical owner during implementation and post\-go\-live stabilization.



  
 



**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  





**Technical Skills** 



* Strong experience in solution architecture, SaaS implementation, or enterprise platform design.
* Good understanding of APIs, webhooks, system integrations, middleware, and cloud\-based platforms.
* Experience with CRM, scheduling, chatbot, marketing automation, or patient engagement platforms is preferred.
* Understanding of AI\-enabled workflows, GenAI platforms, and human\-in\-the\-loop review models.
* Ability to create technical diagrams, workflow maps, data flow documents, and integration architecture notes.
* Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure, authentication, access control, monitoring, and data security.



**Healthcare / Domain Skills** 



* Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, ophthalmology, patient engagement, or clinical workflow platforms is preferred.
* Understanding of HIPAA, healthcare data privacy, and patient communication workflows will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand clinic operations, patient inquiry journeys, appointment booking workflows, and escalation models.



**Business \& Communication Skills** 



* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable working with global teams, especially US\-based customers and internal ZEISS stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with the ability to balance speed, compliance, and scalability.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Digital Health, or related field.
* 10\-20 years of experience in solution architecture, technical consulting, SaaS implementation, or healthcare IT.
* Prior experience working with startups, venture\-backed products, or fast\-moving digital product teams is a plus.
* Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Zapier, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Google Analytics, or similar platforms is an advantage.
* Experience preparing architecture documents for IT, security, compliance, or enterprise approval processes.



  
 



**Key Success Metrics** 




  




* Faster and smoother VisioGen clinic implementations.
* Reduced dependency on ad hoc technical decision\-making.
* Clear integration and architecture documentation for each customer.
* Improved collaboration between business, product, IT, and engineering teams.
* Scalable implementation framework for onboarding multiple ophthalmology clinics.
* Secure, compliant, and reliable solution designs.



  
 



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





 The ideal candidate is someone who can think like an architect, communicate like a consultant, and execute like a product implementation owner. They should be comfortable working in a startup\-like environment within a large enterprise ecosystem. They should be able to simplify complex technical topics, work with multiple stakeholders, and design solutions that are practical, secure, scalable, and customer\-ready.

**Role: Solution Architect – Claims Platform (Life \& Health)** 




  





 Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for the Claims Platform for large, global insurers across Life and Health insurance lines. This role is responsible for ensuring the  platform is implemented correctly, integrated effectively within complex insurer  ecosystems, and successfully taken from discovery through production go\-live. 
 



 The Solution Architect acts as the single point of architectural ownership across  customer stakeholders, internal product teams, delivery teams, implementation  partners, and third\-party vendors. 
 



 This is not a purely advisory or remote architecture role. The expectation is that the  individual has operated on the ground, worked closely with insurers during critical  implementation phases, handled ambiguity, and made real\-time decisions during UAT,  cutover, and go\-live. 
 



**Core Responsibilities** 




**1\. International On\-Site Implementation Ownership (Mandatory)** 




 • Must have prior experience travelling internationally for enterprise insurance  platform implementations. 
 



 • Must have led implementations on\-site from requirements gathering through  solution design, UAT, cutover, go\-live, and hypercare. 
 



 • Serve as the primary architectural authority during customer engagements and  represent the product confidently in front of senior stakeholders. 
 



 • Work closely with: 
 



 o Claims business teams 
 



 o Operations teams 
 



 o Customer IT, architecture, and security teams 
 



 o System integrators 
 



 o Third\-party vendors and external partners 
 



 • Drive workshops to understand current\-state processes, future\-state  requirements, gaps, and dependencies. 
 



 • Convert business requirements into practical, scalable solution designs while  balancing product capability versus customer\-specific customisation. • Handle ambiguity during discovery phases and bring structure to incomplete or  evolving requirements. 
 



 • Make real\-time decisions during testing, cutover, and production support  situations. 
 



 • Support high\-pressure go\-live activities, defect triage, business escalations, and  hypercare. 
 



 • Ensure customer confidence through strong communication, ownership, and  decisive problem\-solving. 
 



  





**2\. Enterprise Integration Ownership** 




  





 • Own end\-to\-end integration architecture between the Claims Platform  and the insurer ecosystem. 
 



 • Hands\-on experience integrating claims solutions with: 
 



 o Policy Administration Systems 
 



 o CRM and omni\-channel platforms 
 



 o Document Management Systems (DMS) 
 



 o Payment and finance systems 
 



 o External provider, hospital, TPA, and regulatory ecosystems 
 



 o Customer communication platforms such as SMS, email, portals, and  contact centres 
 



 • Define and drive the overall API and integration strategy for customer  implementations. 
 



 • Design synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns across upstream  and downstream systems. 
 



 • Own error handling, retry mechanisms, exception management, reconciliation,  and operational monitoring for integrations. 
 



 • Ensure end\-to\-end data consistency and transaction integrity across multiple  systems. 
 



 • Work with customer enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure the  solution fits within the broader insurer landscape. 
 



 • Support data mapping, interface specifications, payload definitions, and  integration testing. 
 



 • Provide architectural guidance on performance, dependency management, and  system interoperability. 
 



  





**3\. Claims Product \& Domain Mastery** 




 • Demonstrate deep expertise in Life and Health claims processes and operating  models. 
 



 • Strong understanding of: 
 



 o Pre\-authorisation workflows 
 



 o Reimbursement and cashless claims 
 



 o Auto\-adjudication and manual assessment flows 
 



 o Claims intake and registration 
 



 o Medical coding and clinical pathways 
 



 o Provider and hospital workflows 
 



 o Claims payment, settlement, and recovery 
 



 o Fraud, Waste, and Abuse controls 
 



 o Claims correspondence and communication processes 
 



 • Guide customers on how to use the platform effectively rather than over customising it. 
 



 • Identify where customer requirements can be solved through product  configuration versus custom development. 
 



 • Ensure solution designs align with industry best practices and support  operational efficiency. 
 



 • Understand the broader impact of claims processes on customer experience,  operational teams, provider networks, and downstream finance systems.
 



  





 • Be able to challenge customer requests when they introduce  unnecessary complexity, operational risk, or deviation from the product  roadmap. 
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by combining deep claims  knowledge with practical implementation experience. 
 



  





**Experience Profile** 




 • 12\+ years of total experience 
 



 • 2\- 4\+ years of experience specifically in Life and Health Claims platforms • Proven experience leading international, on\-site insurance implementations • Strong exposure to APAC, EMEA, or other global insurer environments • Experience working across complex insurer IT landscapes and multiple  stakeholder groups 
 



 • Hands\-on involvement in large\-scale implementations, production go\-lives, and  hypercare 
 



 • Strong ability to work across business, technology, and delivery teams • Ability to operate independently and drive outcomes under pressure 
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Smooth and predictable go\-lives with minimal escalations 
 



 • Strong confidence and trust from customer CIOs, Heads of Claims, and  business leadership teams 
 



 • Well\-designed integrations and stable production systems 
 



 • Delivery teams aligned to a product\-first implementation approach • Clear architectural decisions with minimal ambiguity or rework • Faster implementation cycles with reduced delivery risk 
 


* • Reduced dependency on founders and senior leadership for delivery assurance • Customers viewing the individual as a trusted advisor rather than only a  technical architect

This global presence enables us to offer localized expertise with a worldwide perspective. Join Straive to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of data analytics and AI innovation. Here, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to transformative projects, supported by significant investments and an entrepreneurial drive fueled by our partnership with EQT.
 



  





**Data Solution Architect (Azure \& Databricks)** 




**Location: Straive Locations \| Experience: 10–12 Years** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a highly experienced Data Solution Architect (Azure \& Databricks) to serve as a primarytechnical authority driving the architecture, design, and execution of modern enterprise data platforms.This role bridges high\-performance data engineering with cutting\-edge semantic modeling,conversational AI, and agentic framework designs across Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems.
 



 The ideal candidate brings deep architectural expertise across the Medallion lakehouse lifecycle, source\-to\-target mapping (STTM), domain ontologies, Unity Catalog governance, and AI\-driven experiences(such as Databricks AI/BI Genie, Fabric Data Agents, and LangGraph/RAG integrations). **Key Responsibilities** 




  Platform \& Architecture Design: Design, build, and oversee high\-performance, scalable data
 



 lakehouses using Microsoft Azure, Azure Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric. Establish and optimize
 



 multi\-tier storage strategies (Raw, Bronze, Silver, Gold / Medallion Architecture).
 



  Semantic, Contextual \& Ontology Modeling: Architect advanced semantic layers, business context mappings, and domain ontologies to bridge raw technical data structures with business\-ready,machine\-interpretable context. Model domain ontologies and knowledge graphs within Databricks(e.g., using GraphRAG) and leverage Purview Business Glossaries/Fabric Domains in Microsoft Fabric.
 



  Conversational AI \& Metric Standardization: Architect and deploy Databricks AI/BI Genie Spaces, AI Agents, and Unity Catalog Metric Views to enable secure, natural\-language ad\-hoc analytics and standardized KPIs. Design equivalent conversational and semantic interfaces in Microsoft Fabric using Fabric Data Agents, AI Skills, and Power BI Direct Lake Semantic Models.
 



  AI \& Agentic Framework Integration: Design data pipelines and semantic foundations optimized for modern AI workflows, enabling seamless integration with Agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph,LangChain, Agentbricks), Vector databases, and RAG architectures.
 



  Data Architecture \& STTM Creation: Author and maintain comprehensive end\-to\-end Source\-to\-Target Mapping (STTM) documents, defining granular transformation logic, business rules, schema evolution, and conceptual/logical/physical models.
 



  Pre\-Sales \& Proposal Leadership (Plus): Collaborate with sales and practice leads to drive technical pre\-sales engagements, architect RFP technical solutions, author bid responses, deliver client demonstrations, and estimate project effort and sizing.
 



  Governance \& Security: Implement unified governance, metadata management, and access
 



 controls across the data estate (utilizing Unity Catalog, Fabric OneLake governance, and Master Data Management strategies).
 



  Cross\-Functional Leadership: Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Business
 



 Architecture teams to translate complex functional demands into executable, enterprise\-grade
 



 technical blueprints.
 



 Technical Skills \& Qualifications ,Primary Requirements (Must\-Have)
 



  Cloud \& Platform Expertise: Advanced hands\-on experience across the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse) and hands\-on proficiency with Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouses, Warehouses, Pipelines, Fabric Data Agents, AI Skills) and CI/CD pipelines\\(Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform).
 



  Databricks Ecosystem: Deep hands\-on mastery of Databricks (Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity
 



 Catalog, PySpark, Spark SQL, Databricks AI/BI Genie Spaces, Genie Agents, and Metric Views).
 



  Semantic \& Knowledge Modeling: Proven experience in building semantic layers, contextual layers,and domain\-specific ontologies/knowledge graphs for enterprise data platforms across Unity Catalog and Microsoft Purview.
 



  AI \& Agentic Systems: Familiarity or hands\-on exposure to agentic frameworks and AI ecosystems such as LangChain, LangGraph, Agentbricks, GraphRAG, and vector database platforms.

7bb9f3a3.title: Senior / Solution Consultant - Veeva Quality India
7bb9f3a3.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer\-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value\-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross\-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof\-of\-concepts and executive engagement.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, differentiated Veeva Quality solution approaches.
* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.
* Lead consultative engagements—including discovery workshops, solution workshops, conference room pilots and proof\-of\-concepts—to demonstrate business value.
* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years overall experience including 3\+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre\-sales and solution consulting customer\-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of time within India.
* Based in or able to work from the target territories: Mumbai, Hyderabad or Bangalore.
* English and Hindi proficiency; familiarity with relevant regional languages is an advantage.


****Nice to Have****
* Experience with software solutions used by Quality Assurance and Manufacturing organizations in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech or Diagnostics.
* Hands\-on knowledge of one or more enterprise applications such as QMS, DMS, LMS, VMS or LIMS.
* Experience with SaaS/cloud technology and enterprise software platforms.
* Consulting, business analysis or software implementation experience.
* Previous experience with Veeva applications, including Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Safety.
* Experience in competitive software evaluations and legacy\-system replacement programs.
* Strong teamwork and willingness to contribute to broader team goals.
* The candidate should be curious, energetic, commercially aware, collaborative and comfortable taking ownership of customer\-facing engagements from preparation through follow\-up.


**Perks \& Benefits**
* Health \& wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break


 Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
   

  

 Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

**About VikingCloud:** 




 VikingCloud is the leading Predict\-to\-Prevent cybersecurity and compliance company, offering businesses a single, integrated solution to make informed, predictive, and cost\-effective risk mitigation decisions – faster. Powered by the Asgard Platform™, the industry’s largest repository of anonymized cybersecurity and compliance event data, we continuously monitor and analyze over 6\+ billion online events every day.
 



  





 VikingCloud is the one\-stop partner trusted by 4\+ million customers to provide the predictive intelligence and competitive edge they need to stay one step ahead of cybersecurity and compliance disruptions to their business. Our 1,000 dedicated cybersecurity and compliance expert advisors understand that it’s not just about technology. It’s about transacting business and delivering an exceptional customer experience every day, without fail. That’s the measurable value we deliver. And that’s what we call, Business Uninterrupted.
 



  





**This Position** 




 Sales Engineering focused on pre\-sales and on\-going client support.
 



 Location : Vadodara (Work from office)
 



 Shift : US Shift
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 As a Pre\-Sales Engineer your responsibilities will include:
 


* Pre\-sales support for Compliance, Managed Security Sales, and Security consulting opportunity for designated accounts
* Engage clients in defining and identifying business requirements relating to Managed Security Solutions, Compliance Solutions, Managed Security Testing, and Vulnerability Management.
* Own and positively develop the relationships with key technical decision makers and influencers within target customers
* Drive new sales opportunities by proactively engaging with the technical community within target accounts
* Scope and clearly translate defined requirements, proposed solutions, and value proposition into Proposals/Statement of Work (SOW).
* Present and articulate our value proposition to customers at all levels within the organization both technical and business audience (including C\-levels)
* Be a trusted advisor who provide sound security advise to customer and help them establish business case, including TCO and ROI justification, and shape requirement
* Be the voice\-of\-customer, channeling constructive feedback from value customer to provide market\-driven inputs to our product and services team
* Be the solution owner, taking lead and working with cross\-functioning team including professional services, product management, sales, and marketing to drive the development of market\-driven solution and services, and for marketing events



  





**Qualifications** 




 As a Pre\-Sales Security Consultant your skills and qualifications will include:
 


* Must have at least 3 years of strong hands\-on experience in Cyber Security with at least 2 years in technical solutioning and presales
* Significant professional experience in a presales/sales engineering role within managed services or professional services, focused on supporting sales to Enterprise accounts
* Must have experience working in a customer\-facing role and comfortable presenting to a small to medium audiences on both technical and business\-related topics
* Strong communications skills for product demonstrations and presentations to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Excellent written skills for RFP responses, proposals, pricing, and gathering technical requirements
* Must have working technical knowledge of security technologies (across multiple domains such as SIEM, EDR, Cloud Security, Firewall, Network IPS, DLP etc.), information security concepts and familiar with security products (Microsoft, Palo Alto, Netskope, Splunk, Carbon Black, Fortinet etc.) and the security marketplace.



  





 Desirable:
 


* Professional security related qualification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, GIAC or equivalent
* Working knowledge and familiarity with GRC and Offensive Security consulting services (e.g. penetration testing, PCI audit, security assessment) is highly desirable (pre\-sales perspective)
* Broad experience and understanding of industry standards, framework, and best practices such as ISO27001, PCI DSS, NIST, etc.
* Broad experience and understanding of security trend, threat landscape and framework such as the cyber kill\-chain
* Experience with Managed Security Services or Professional Services
* Experience in preparing technical architecture blueprint and responding to large scale complex RFP



  





  





 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, political affiliation or opinion, medical condition, status as a veteran, and/or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

912a09c0.title: Data Presales Engineer (Microsoft Fabric)
912a09c0.description:
CloudGate is a Microsoft Solutions Partner headquartered in Sharjah Media City, UAE, with offices in Cairo, Riyadh, Bangalore, and London. We help enterprises across MENA and Africa modernize on Microsoft Azure, and our data practice is built around Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
 



 We're hiring a Data Presales Consultant to be the customer\-facing voice of our Microsoft Fabric offering. You'll present Fabric to senior customer audiences, build analytics use cases for different industries, and turn customer conversations into well\-scoped solutions that win deals. Success in this role means strong customer presentations, convincing demos, and Proofs of Value that convert into signed projects. You'll work closely with Account Managers, our Data \& AI Lead, and Microsoft field teams.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Present Microsoft Fabric and CloudGate's data offerings to CIO, CTO, CDO, and Head of Analytics audiences across MENA and Africa.
* Run Discovery Workshops and Fabric assessments, and turn business needs into clear solution scope.
* Design Fabric solutions using OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Real\-Time Intelligence, and Power BI, including medallion architecture and F\-SKU capacity sizing.
* Build industry analytics use cases with the right KPIs and dashboards. These cover real estate, oil \& gas, banking, FMCG, manufacturing, and healthcare. Examples include occupancy and revenue, production and SCADA telemetry, regulatory reporting and customer 360, sell\-out and trade promotion, OEE, and patient flow.
* Build and deliver tailored Fabric and Power BI demos, and run Proof of Value engagements that convert into signed projects.
* Write technical proposals, SOWs, BOMs, effort estimates, and RFP responses.
* Work with Microsoft sellers and Partner Development Managers on co\-sell (MSX) and partner incentive programs.
* Build reusable presales material, including pitch decks, demo environments, and industry use case packs.



**Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years in data engineering, BI, or analytics, including at least 2 years in presales or solution consulting.
* Strong hands\-on Microsoft Fabric knowledge, or equivalent experience with Synapse, Azure Data Factory, or Power BI Premium.
* Strong Power BI, SQL, and data modelling skills, with the ability to build a convincing demo quickly.
* Proven ability to build industry analytics use cases for real estate, oil \& gas, banking, FMCG, or manufacturing.
* Excellent presentation skills: confident with C\-level audiences, clear at telling a data story, and able to handle questions on the spot.
* Experience with discovery workshops, demos, RFPs, proposals, and SOWs.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* Nice to have: DP\-600, DP\-700, or PL\-300 certification; Real\-Time Intelligence (KQL, Eventstream, Eventhouse) experience; presales experience with MENA or Africa customers; Arabic language skills.



**What We Offer** 



* Fully remote from India, with flexible hours that overlap with the MENA working day.
* Periodic travel to MENA and Africa for customer engagements and Microsoft events.
* Sponsored Microsoft certifications and a clear path to Presales Lead.
* A competitive base salary plus a bonus linked to deals won.



 CloudGate is an equal\-opportunity employer.

 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally.  You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
