* Solid understanding of ETL methodologies in a multi\-tiered stack with Data Modelling \& Data Governance
* Experience with BI, and data analytics databases
* Experience in converting business problems/challenges to technical solutions considering security, performance, scalability etc.
* Experience in Enterprise grade solution implementations.
* Experience in performance bench marking enterprise applications
* Strong stakeholder, client, team, process \& delivery management skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Design and propose Azure\-based data and AI solutions that align with customer objectives and solve business challenges.
* Develop and present demonstrations, prototypes, and PoCs to showcase the value and capabilities of the proposed solutions.
* Create technical proposals, presentations, and respond to requests for proposals (RFPs) and information (RFIs).
* Lead the technical aspects of project delivery, ensuring that implementations align with the initial solution design.
* Define and implement best practices and agile methodologies for the delivery of scalable Cloud solutions.
* Provide expert guidance on data strategy, cloud architecture, and the technology stacks needed for data modernization, AI, and machine learning workloads.
* Data: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, and Cosmos DB.
* AI/ML (knowledge): Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI.
* Minimum 7 years hand\-on experience in one or more of the above areas.
* Minimum 10 years industry experience


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

63796d8c.title: Delivery Lead Manager
63796d8c.description:
**Skill required:** 
 Marketing Operations \- Operations Management
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Delivery Lead Manager
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 Any Graduation
   

  

**Years of Experience:** 
 13 to 18 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 The Operations Service Delivery Lead is the professional responsible for coordinating the delivery of services to key enterprise customers and includes developing and executing activities related to end\-to\-end project management, as well as monitoring, managing and reporting on execution of deliverables. Extensive experience in a multinational environment managing and working within Business Excellence frameworks or with service delivery is required General Duties and Responsibilities Assists or leads in developing supplier/vendor/sub\-contractor strategy for service delivery operations. Awareness of CX products Understand and implement tools which would lead to efficiency gains Manage recruiting, staffing, pyramid mix, utilization and capacity of staff to optimize balance between cost and delivery targets. Resolve performance issues with delivery leadership. Responsible for improving delivery and both supporting and assisting in the creation of strategic initiatives for clients partnering with the different teams within Accenture. Formalize delivery plans for the service delivery operations(s) with service group delivery leadership. Ensure execution of delivery work across one or more service delivery operations. Deliver efficiencies through standard processes and synergies. Manage supply and demand, service quality and processes to meet delivery expectations, always looking for methods of improvement. Proactively improve client and customer relationships through extensive contact, while working with Client Account and Account Delivery Team leadership. Deliver agreed scope of services while achieving profitability improvements and productive gains. Manage and reduce costs on standard offerings, assets, technologies, licenses and facilities. Implement standard service level agreement (SLA) and other financial/operational metrics. Support the achievement of targets on contract controllable income (CCI) and cost\-to\-serve. Support estimate at completion (EAC) adjustments (if required).
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Achieve year on year efficiencies in conjunction with the delivery service providers. Designs and drives Program/Capability ownership, Stakeholder management and collaboration. Ensuring customer satisfaction by acting as the escalation point for any problems or concerns from project and delivery managers, as well as clients
   

  

* Responsible for all services including incident and change management. Drive optimization of delivery of standard solutions within area(s) of expertise. Address performance issues across the service delivery operations, create operational approach and implement continuous improvement. Implement the levers to consistently achieve performance targets such as Six Sigma, operational excellence, etc. Participate in account quality review process and engage appropriately in the Accenture Quality Assurance program. Review and validate the standard solutions/models for new deals, and take responsibility for their successful execution/completion. Tracking duties and deliverables from several project managers and their respective projects. Responsible for career management of service delivery operations staff (training, engagement, mentoring, succession planning and annual performance process). Lead service delivery strategy and execution. Act as subject matter expert supporting teams and applying deep expertise and knowledge.
* Must have Skills Fluent in oral and written English skills (will have direct contact with clients). Proven leadership skills. Ability to motivate others to achieve goals and deadlines. Conflict resolution and negotiation skills to balance customer s needs and goals with company s strategies and goals. Skilled at delegating tasks to others. Generation of clear and functional reports for both supervisors and peers (both technical and non\-technical). At least 10 years of experience leading Software Development with emphasis in web / front\-end technology based delivery. Expertise in Digital Content Publishing. Extensive experience working with global teams and offshore/nearshore production
* Roles and Responsibilities:
* In this role you are required to identify and assess complex problems for area of responsibility
* The person would create solutions in situations in which analysis requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors
* Requires adherence to strategic direction set by senior management when establishing near\-term goals
* Interaction of the individual is with senior management at a client and/or within Accenture, involving matters that may require acceptance of an alternate approach
* Some latitude in decision\-making in involved
* you will act independently to determine methods and procedures on new assignments
* Decisions individual at this role makes have a major day to day impact on area of responsibility
* The person manages large \- medium sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture
* Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts At least 15 years of experience in Client Management and relationship\-building. The ability to lead a complex project/program in which new services/tools are used or created. Recognize issues and opportunities and initiate proper action to solve or take advantage of them. Monitor and devise methods of improvement for overall performance and services. Review and contribute to creation of financial reports and supporting documentation for funders as outlined in funding agreements by projects. Ensure operations teams are aware of expectative and business needs
* Assure successful service delivery \- SLA achievement and high level of customer satisfaction. Collaborate with Sr. management to create strategies for improved client account management as well as growth and other opportunities. Working with the client and operations teams to identify and manage service improvement activities. Good to have Skills Certified in PMP, Agile, Scrum, Six Sigma

5b6592ef.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
   

  

**Project Delivery Manager – Supply Chain Applications**
**Your Role**
 Supply Chain transformations shape the backbone of global operations — and in this role, you will be at the center of driving them. As Project Delivery Manager for Supply Chain Applications, you will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, business\-critical application projects across a global landscape, working closely with Business Product Owners, IT Project Managers, Service Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, vendors, and senior business stakeholders across sectors and regions. You will own the full project lifecycle — from initiation and scope definition through execution, governance, and transition into operations — ensuring delivery is on time, within budget, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards and operational readiness requirements. Acting as the primary delivery lead for strategic initiatives, you will drive execution across internal teams and external partners, manage risk and budget transparency, lead governance activities and executive updates, and contribute to Supply Chain transformation roadmaps. This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact across a global application landscape in a matrixed, cross\-functional environment.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You bring substantial professional experience in IT project management, program management, or delivery management, with a proven track record of delivering complex enterprise application projects in global environments.
* Lead and Co\-Lead large\-scale Supply Chain application projects from initiation through hypercare and transition into operations for global applications such as Blue Yonder, Esko, and Tracelink
* You have hands\-on experience with Supply Chain application landscapes and related business processes, including planning, fulfillment, and traceability domains.
* You are skilled in project governance, stakeholder management, budgeting, forecasting, and vendor management, and you communicate effectively across both technical and business audiences.
* You are experienced in both Agile and traditional delivery methodologies, with a solid understanding of application lifecycle management and transition\-to\-support processes.
* You hold a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or bring equivalent professional experience.
* You are business\-fluent in English (written and spoken) and are comfortable with regular regional and international travel as part of the role.
* Experience in the healthcare or life sciences industry is a strong advantage.


**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
   

  

 Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

968fd2e1.title: VSSE Delivery Manager
968fd2e1.description:
The Delivery Manager, VSSE\-IT Systems Engineering, is responsible for leading the delivery and operational performance of technology solutions supporting Ford’s vehicle software and systems engineering. The role oversees PLM and Teamcenter capabilities, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, DevOps, application development, and AI/ML\-enabled engineering tools. This role will develop high\-performing teams, establish delivery priorities, manage strategic technology initiatives, and ensure solutions meet organizational standards for security, quality, reliability, scalability, and business value.
   

  

* Lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of VSSE\-IT software platforms, modeling ecosystems, and engineering data capabilities.
* Define and execute technology roadmaps supporting systems engineering, digital engineering, product development, traceability, collaboration, and enterprise data integration.
* Provide technical leadership for Siemens Teamcenter customization tools such as VSEM, IVS and PLM integrations, including product structures, bills of materials, requirements management, workflows, lifecycle states, change management, release processes, and configuration management.
* Oversee Teamcenter architecture, customization, administration, upgrades, environment management, troubleshooting, data synchronization, and operational readiness.
* Lead integrations between Teamcenter, MagicDraw/Cameo Systems Modeler, Teamwork Cloud, MBSE tools, requirements platforms, and enterprise engineering systems.
* Apply integration technologies and configuration tools such as REST, SOA, ITK, BMIDE, Active Workspace, or comparable PLM technologies.
* Manage and mentor cross\-functional engineering teams responsible for full\-stack development, cloud platforms, DevOps, quality, cybersecurity, and production operations.
* Guide the delivery of secure, scalable, and high\-performance applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript, Angular or React, RESTful APIs, databases, and GCP cloud\-native services.
* Establish and improve DevOps practices, including Kubernetes/OpenShift, containerization, Jenkins or Tekton, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, observability, and infrastructure automation.
* Advance AI/ML\-enabled engineering capabilities through the integration of LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, analytics platforms, AI APIs, and intelligent modeling workflows.
* Partner with Siemens Product Development to address core product issues and coordinate the development and delivery of customer\-specific patches and fixes.
* Collaborate with product owners, systems engineers, architects, PLM teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to prioritize delivery, manage risks, and conduct architecture and production\-readiness reviews.
* Promote engineering excellence through Agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation, code reviews, quality practices, performance management, and continuous process improvement.
* Ensure VSSE\-IT solutions meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, data quality, traceability, performance, reliability, maintainability, and user adoption.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.
* At least 10 years of progressive experience in software engineering, enterprise application development, technology delivery, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of experience with Product Lifecycle Management platforms, including PLM customization, integrations, product structures, bills of materials, requirements, workflows, change management, release processes, and configuration management.
* At least 3 years of experience in people management, engineering management, delivery leadership, or a comparable technical leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading the end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise software products and platforms using Agile, Scrum, or other iterative development methodologies.
* Strong technical experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, Python, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React.
* Experience designing, deploying, and supporting cloud\-native applications using GCP, OpenShift or Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, Tekton or Jenkins, and Terraform.
* Experience leading PLM integrations with engineering, MBSE, ERP, requirements management, or enterprise data systems using REST, SOA, ITK, BMIDE, Active Workspace, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with data platforms, analytics solutions, AI/ML initiatives, or engineering data integration programs. Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, and TensorFlow is a plus.
* Proven ability to establish technical direction, manage delivery risks, improve engineering processes, and deliver secure, reliable, production\-ready solutions.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, decision\-making, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high\-performing teams and partner effectively with engineering, product, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, PLM, and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Siemens Teamcenter, Teamcenter X, 3DEXPERIENCE, or comparable PLM platforms.
* Knowledge of PLM data models, product structures, BOMs, workflows, lifecycle states, change management, and configuration management.
* Experience with PLM integrations, migrations, APIs, customization, and enterprise engineering systems.
* Familiarity with MagicDraw/Cameo Systems Modeler, Teamwork Cloud, SysML, Codebeamer, VIATRA, or similar MBSE tools.
* Knowledge of automotive product development, systems engineering, digital engineering, or regulated environments.
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, distributed systems, AI/ML applications, LLMs, and analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with GCP, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, CI/CD, containers, observability, and cloud security.
* Experience leading distributed or global engineering teams in a collaborative, inclusive environment.

a2fbd7be.title: AI Engagement Manager
a2fbd7be.description:
**Who We Are**
 WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our “DevOps for Content” revolution as we partner with global brands and agencies to transform their end\-to\-end creative workflows – from ideation to activation – to deliver AI\-powered content services with speed, scale, and governance.
   

  

 Through an AI\-first experimentation approach and deep expertise in both first\-party and third\-party AI models, we develop new applications, platforms, and scalable patterns that unlock the GenAI\-powered Content Supply Chain. We function as a continuous product innovation engine—feeding repeatable customer solutions straight into the product roadmap to accelerate product\-led growth.
   

  

 As an AI Engagement Manager, you're
 **highly skilled at leading customer engagements – identifying and documenting business use cases, mapping them to solutions, and driving fast time to measurable value** 
 . You are a
 **hands\-on product owner** 
 and customer leader at heart with expertise and experience in
 **business consulting, digital strategy, agile pod\-based software development** 
 , enterprise software,
 **AI/ML, cloud deployments, and data integration** 
 . If you thrive in start\-up environments—scaling products from prototype to production, pushing innovative research into real\-world use cases, and owning product \& business outcomes—you’ll fit right in here!
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Customer Leadership
   

  

* Drive enterprise\-scale creative and marketing operations transformations using Generative AI solutions as catalyst for organizational change
* Establish trusted advisor relationships with key customer collaborators by demonstrating deep expertise in generative Al applications and digital strategy aligned to the customer’s business and objectives
* Proactively handle customer issues and challenges, developing mitigation strategies before they impact project success or customer happiness.
* Build trust, confidence, and advocacy for the project/program team
* Build executive communication cadences that showcase progress and value, and maintain enthusiasm for GenAI transformation efforts within a governance framework


 Product Leadership
   

  

* Develop comprehensive GenAI and digital transformation strategies using generative Al technologies/first\-party models and third\-party models to solve complex business challenges for enterprise customers
* Collaborate with customer executives to define use cases, build requirements and specifications for Forward Deployed Engineers and Architects, lead solution configuration and deployment, drive adoption, and ensure business value realization.
* Facilitate workshops and strategic planning sessions to help customers identify high\-impact opportunities for generative AI implementation
* Design scalable frameworks that integrate generative AI capabilities into customers’ existing technology ecosystems and workflows
* Create proof\-of\-concept implementations that demonstrate the transformative potential of first\-party and third\-party AI offerings


 Value Realization and Adoption
   

  

* Partner with C\-suite executives to articulate vision, establish success metrics, and secure ongoing commitment for transformation initiatives
* Monitor implementation progress against business goals, adjusting strategies to overcome adoption barriers and improve value realization
* Drive solution adoption through enablement sessions and demonstrations. Partner with Customer Success Managers and Enablement resources for comprehensive plans.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 4\-10\+ years experience (based on level) in business consulting, digital strategy, agile pod\-based software development lifecycle, enterprise software, AI/ML, cloud deployments, and data integration.
* Customer\-Centricity: Always prioritizing the customer and their needs and expectations first in everything you do. You are outstanding at creating a culture of customer\-centricity among your team and your extended ecosystem.
* Proven track record of leading successful digital transformation initiatives for enterprise clients in multiple industries
* Have a product \& human\-centric approach – be the intersection among business, strategy, design, and technology.
* Passion for AI and understanding of Adobe Creative Cloud, Express, Firefly, Firefly Services solutions, and GenStudio for Performance Marketing for the creation of content.
* Knowledge of Adobe Experience Cloud solutions preferred
* Prior experience as Director of Creative Studio, Operations or Agency is a plus.
* Experience leading projects in Agile Scrum and commanding knowledge of various project and process applications (i.e., SharePoint, Jira, Workfront, Miro, Confluence, AI tools).
* Ability to be adaptable and flexible as a product offering and GTM evolves
* Exceptional communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes for executive audiences
* Strong analytical thinking with experience in quantifying business impact of technology investments
* Demonstrated ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics and drive consensus among diverse stakeholders


 What we can offer you
   

  

 Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
   

  

 Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
   

  

 We lead with
 **Heart** 
 , fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.
   

  

 We empower your
 **Brains** 
 for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
   

  

 And we champion
 **Courage** 
 , inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 41956cb3.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
41956cb3.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 Foundational Data \& Model Services sits in Data \& AI Foundations, inside Business \& Market Insights. We own the data that B\&MI's analytics and insights products are built on: the pipelines that bring it in, the data models that shape it, and the standards that keep it consistent for everyone downstream. When a product team needs transaction data modelled a particular way, or a new source onboarded, or a definition that means the same thing in two products, that is us.
   

  

 About half the estate is Hadoop and Hive with on\-prem ETL that has been running for years and still serves live products. The other half is Databricks, and we are moving the rest across. The work is two things at once: keeping the old platform reliable while it is still load\-bearing, and rebuilding the data models properly on the new one rather than lifting and shifting what is already there.
   

  

 The team itself is new, brought together from teams that used to sit apart, and the roadmap is still being written. Plenty is undecided. If that reads as an opportunity rather than a risk, you will enjoy this.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 You Will Own The Delivery Plan Across The Squads Doing This Work, And Manage The Dependencies Between Them, The Platform Teams We Rely On, And The Product Teams Waiting On Us. Specifically, You Will
   

  

 Own delivery of the shared data models and pipelines that several product teams depend on, where success is adoption rather than features shipped.
   

  

 Run the migration off Hadoop and on\-prem ETL onto Databricks: sequencing, cutover, and actually switching the old thing off.
   

  

 Keep the legacy platform's operational commitments visible in the plan, so migration work does not quietly starve the systems still in production.
   

  

 Broker the dependencies we do not control, working with central platform, cloud operations and data governance teams.
   

  

 Run vendor and partner engagement: roadmap alignment, milestone tracking, performance against commitments.
   

  

 Bring enough technical depth to challenge decisions on data modelling, pipeline design and data quality, and to explain the trade\-offs to business stakeholders without flattening them.
   

  

 Set how a new team plans and reports: intake, prioritization, cadence, and what leadership sees each month.
   

  

**All About You**
 We do not expect any one person to bring all of this, so apply if most of it fits.
   

  

 Experience running technical programs in data engineering, data platforms or analytics infrastructure.
   

  

 Working knowledge of the stack on both sides of the migration: Hadoop, Hive and traditional ETL on one side, Databricks, Spark and orchestration tooling such as Airflow on the other. Strong SQL throughout. Enough to scope work and spot risk without an engineer translating every conversation.
   

  

 Experience of platform migrations where the old system stays live throughout and the decommissioning is the hard part.
   

  

 Understanding of data modelling and why it matters: schemas, lineage, common definitions, and what breaks downstream when they drift.
   

  

 Understanding of data governance, access control and handling customer data in a regulated business.
   

  

 A track record of getting internal teams to adopt shared platforms, which comes down to persuasion, evidence and follow\-through rather than mandate.
   

  

 Comfortable with ambiguity: able to build a credible plan before every input is settled, and to change it without treating that as a failure.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

8292473d.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
8292473d.description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly accomplished Technical Program Manager (TPM) — at the Staff level — to play a pivotal role in spearheading our product development and geographic expansion initiatives. This strategic role requires a deep technical background to effectively partner with product managers and engineering managers, providing technical leadership to own the execution plan and deliver complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives. You will be the champion for predictable and timely delivery, able to take ownership of and drive the mitigation of risks to the program, and skilled in facilitating quantifiable success across diverse engineering and product teams. Your core responsibility is to ensure the predictable delivery of products by actively engaging in technical discussions, identifying and proactively resolving dependencies and technical blockers, mitigating architectural risks, and applying best\-in\-class program management practices.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Technical Strategy \& Planning
   

  

* Drive strategic, cross\-functional planning and prioritization, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to develop comprehensive program plans, including roadmap definition, dependency mapping, and resourcing models.
* Drive the process of translating high\-level business and product requirements into actionable, concrete engineering tasks, milestones, and technical specifications.
* Contribute to the definition and tracking of effective technical metrics, driving improvements that optimize engineering operating performance and system health.


 Technical Execution \& Delivery
   

  

* Lead and facilitate regular program\-level meetings and reviews with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure projects achieve successful outcomes.
* Proactively monitor program health, tracking status, risks, issues, and complex technical dependencies across engineering teams.
* Deep dive into technical issues to facilitate resolution, and drive appropriate executive\-level escalations and program\-level change management processes as\-needed.
* Take personal ownership of engineering roadblocks and technical delays, escalating issues appropriately and driving them to timely closure by working directly with engineering leads.


 Process \& Communication
   

  

* Manage high\-level program communications, ensuring all stakeholders—from delivery teams to executive management—are consistently informed of roadmap changes, release plans, and delivery status, with a clear explanation of technical trade\-offs and risks.
* Establish, document, and champion the adoption of new program frameworks, tools, and best practices across the R\&D organization.
* Act as an agent of change, helping to establish and strengthen the Technical Program Management function across the company.


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience as TPM, Engineering Lead, Manager, or equivalent working directly with software engineering teams.
* Proven track record to communicate technical issues effectively to technical and non\-technical partners at different levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to build and implement detailed plans accounting for ambiguity, dependencies, and technical complexity in a fast\-moving environment.
* Demonstrated excellence in the practice of technical program management, especially in establishing TPM processes from scratch.
* Highly skilled in pragmatically identifying, tracking and reporting on cross team dependencies and collaboratively addressing them effectively with providing/receiving teams.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and a hands\-on disposition.
* Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Outstanding ability to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization from engineers to executives.
* Four\-year Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related degree, or equivalent work experience.


**Additional Information**
 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com
   

  

 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

cca6a497.title: Technical Program Manager
cca6a497.description:
**Who we are** 




 Graviton Research Capital is a privately funded quantitative trading firm. We trade across a multitude of asset classes and trading venues using a diverse range of concepts, from time series analysis and stochastic models to machine learning and statistical inference. We analyse terabytes of data to identify pricing anomalies and drive innovation in financial markets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Program Manager who thrives at the intersection of rigorous engineering and predictable delivery. You will not just "manage tasks" — you will orchestrate the development lifecycle for mission\-critical systems. Your goal is to ensure that our elite engineering teams can focus on high\-performance code while you own the execution strategy, dependency mapping, and release discipline.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Stand\-ups, Retrospectives) tailored for deep\-tech engineering teams.
* Transform high\-level trading requirements into granular, executable backlogs. Own capacity planning and burn\-down metrics to provide high\-visibility delivery timelines.
* Navigate the complex interplay between engineering teams (e.g., Connectivity, Core Infrastructure, Simulation) to prevent bottlenecks.
* Build and maintain advanced Jira dashboards, automated roadmaps, and Confluence documentation that serve as the "single source of truth" for stakeholders.
* Proactively identify technical debt, architectural blockers, or resource gaps that threaten release stability.
* Continuously refine Agile methodologies to suit low\-latency, performance\-sensitive development cycles (where "Definition of Done" includes rigorous performance benchmarking).



  





**Eligibility \& Required Skills** 



* 5\+ years of experience as a TPM, Program Manager, or Scrum Lead in a product\-engineering environment (HFT, FinTech, Networking, or Kernels/Systems).
* A strong grasp of the software development lifecycle for high\-performance systems. While you won't write code, you must understand concepts like build systems, CI/CD, and performance regressions.
* Exposure to low\-latency, trading systems, capital markets, networking, quant research or infra software is preferred
* Expert\-level proficiency in Jira Service Management/Software and Confluence. Ability to use JQL for advanced reporting.
* Exceptional ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear business updates for Engineering Leads and Partners.

**Project Role :** Security Architect

**Must have skills :** Industry X Security  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:  

  

As an OT Security Consultant, your typical day involves assessing, designing, and enhancing cybersecurity controls for Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and SCADA environments. You will work closely with clients to identify security risks, develop remediation strategies, and implement robust security solutions to protect critical industrial assets. You will leverage your expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, industrial control systems, security assessments, and risk management to deliver secure and resilient OT environments. Your role also includes contributing to the development of new cybersecurity service offerings, supporting business development initiatives, and driving innovation in industrial security practices.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:  

Expected to perform independently and become an SME.  

Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.  

Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.  

Provide subject matter expertise in the execution of Operational Technology (OT) security workshops, risk assessments, and remediation engagements.  

Conduct security reviews and assessments of OT, ICS, and SCADA environments to identify security gaps and recommend improvements.  

Develop cybersecurity strategies, operating models, roadmaps, and security enhancement plans for clients.  

Lead solution engineering activities and oversee project delivery for OT security engagements.  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical security solutions.  

Support the development of new industrial cybersecurity products, services, and offerings to reduce cyber risk in OT environments.  

Perform security research, consulting, and security assessments covering OT Security, ICS Security, SCADA Security, Network Security, Embedded Security, and Industrial Security domains.  

Architect, recommend, and implement security solutions for industrial control systems, applications, data, assets, and personnel.  

Support presales activities, proposal development, scope definition, and marketing initiatives for OT security services.  

Assist in building internal industrial security capabilities, methodologies, frameworks, and best practices.  

Mentor junior team members and contribute to organizational knowledge sharing initiatives.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:  

Must To Have Skills: Operational Technology (OT) Security, Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Security, SCADA Security, Network Security.  

Good To Have Skills: Web Penetration Testing, Infrastructure Security Testing, Endpoint Security Testing, Application Security Testing, IoT/IIoT Security.  

Minimum 5\-6 years of experience in security research, consulting, and security assessments covering OT Security, ICS Security, SCADA Security, and Network Security.  

Preferred experience in Web, Infrastructure, IoT/IIoT, Endpoint, and Application Penetration Testing.  

Extensive expertise in cybersecurity with a strong focus on OT and Industrial Control System security.  

Comprehensive understanding of SCADA systems, PLCs, DCS, HMIs, and industrial control devices.  

Strong knowledge of cybersecurity standards and frameworks including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800\-82, NERC CIP, and IEC 61511\.  

Experience in performing risk assessments, incident management, and security strategy development within OT environments.  

Proficiency in administering and managing industrial cybersecurity platforms and OT monitoring solutions.  

Strong understanding of software and hardware technologies commonly used in ICS environments, including operating systems, databases, and programming languages.  

Hands\-on experience with industrial cybersecurity tools and technologies such as Nozomi, Dragos, Tenable, Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and industrial firewalls.  

Experience with vulnerability research, threat modeling, security code reviews, reverse engineering, exploitation techniques, and security testing methodologies including fuzzing and penetration testing.  

Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple engagements and stakeholders effectively.  

  

Additional Information:  

The candidate should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in Operational Technology (OT) Security and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Security.  

Experience in developing OT security capabilities, service offerings, frameworks, and solutions will be an added advantage.  

Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential.  

Demonstrated ability to work effectively and deliver results within cross\-functional teams.  

This position is based at multiple location.  

A 15 years full time education is required.

**Global Sales**

Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000\+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector \& small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Contributions have visible technical impact on a product or major subcomponent. Applies in\-depth professional knowledge and innovative ideas to solve complex problems. Visible contributions improve time\-to\-market, achieve cost reductions, or satisfy current and future unmet customer needs. Recognized internal authority on key technology area applying innovative principles and ideas. Provides technical leadership for significant project/program work. Leads or participates in cross\-functional initiatives and contributes to mentorship and knowledge sharing across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Documents ongoing work (activities, tasks) throughout the sales cycle using specific tools and resources and sharing best practices with peers and partners to collaborate more effectively.
* Engages with and builds consultative presence and advisory influence with VPs, CxO, and line\-of\-business (LOB) management and customer thought leaders.
* Anticipates customer needs and proactively engages partners and resources to design innovative solutions and generate customer demand.
* Proactively shares knowledge with peers and actively helps develop knowledge and expertise within the Presales community.


**Education And Experience**
**What you need to bring:**
* Advanced degree in technology or related field preferred, or equivalent technical qualifications
* 12\+ years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling;
* 2\+ Industry standard relevant technology certifications or equivalent experience expected.

**Knowledge And Skills**
* Unique mastery and experience leading solution configurations and overall architecture design and creating, managing, and positioning demos and proofs\-of\-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.
* Unique mastery of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, and adjacent solution domain(s), showing how they can be combined to address customer needs, and how the workload solution can be adapted for strategic customer and industry solutions.
* Unique mastery with expertise and deep working knowledge with the as\-a\-service (aaS) business model, business value, and complete ecosystem and how that drives aaS strategic goals within one or more domains.
* Expert ability to collaborate cross\-functionally and across HPE to generate new revenue through increased subscription consumption and other aaS models.
* Mastery of executive\-level written, verbal and nonverbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, with ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages as need to perform job requirements.
* Demonstrates unique mastery of discussion and persuasion skills used to support company point\-of\-view, while respectfully questioning and challenging proposed solutions.
* Unique mastery of financial and business acumen\- sales cycle, funnel management, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage \- including typical KPIs important to CxOs; knowledgeable about TCO/ROI concepts and calculations, financial models, and understand how customers generate revenue.
* Unique mastery of consultative and value selling skills, advisory influence, and executive gravitas, including presenting, white boarding, storytelling, objection\-handling, and closing skills.

59f7338b.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Data Cloud) Architect
59f7338b.description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/23/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Work Experience 5\+ years
* Remote Job
### **Job Description**


This is a remote position.


Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Data Cloud) Architect  

  

  

Job Details
  

* **Employment Type:** Contract
* **Work Mode:** Remote
* **Location:** Offshore
* **Total Experience Required:** 6 to 10 years
* **Relevant Experience Required:** 3\+ years of dedicated architecture and implementation experience within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Data/Journeys) ecosystem
* **Mandatory Certification:** Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Journeys) Functional Consultant Associate or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert

  

Job Summary
  

We are seeking an experienced **Dynamics 365 Customer Insights Architect** to design, secure, and optimize our enterprise Customer Data Platform (CDP) and engagement engine. The ideal candidate will orchestrate multi\-source data ingestion streams, map identity resolution rules, configure calculated metrics, and establish real\-time activation loops to power downstream personalization, customer segmentations, and automated marketing journeys.  

  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

* **Design and govern the global Customer Insights data architecture**, configuring real\-time data ingestion pipelines from Microsoft Dataverse, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and external third\-party transactional networks.
* **Architect complex Identity Resolution rules**, establishing data unification parameters, deduplication logic, match/merge profiles, and unified Customer 360 schemas.
* **Build advanced calculated insights and measures**, utilizing custom SQL\-based metrics, behavioral attributes, and predictive models to score customer lifetime values and churn probabilities.
* **Design high\-impact, omni\-channel customer journeys**, configuring dynamic audience segmentation rules, real\-time trigger events, and personalized content loops across communication channels.
* **Establish secure platform integration blueprints**, constructing data streaming flows connecting Customer Insights with Power BI dashboards, core Dynamics apps (Sales/Service), and external API endpoints.
* **Enforce absolute data privacy and governance guardrails**, managing role\-based access controls (RBAC), multi\-tenant compliance frameworks, and corporate data scrubbing rules (GDPR/CCPA).
* **Audit platform operations and processing latencies**, monitoring ingestion sync health, data refresh cycles, segment processing times, and API limit throttles.

  

  

### **Requirements**


* **6 to 10 years** of enterprise data engineering, CRM consulting, or marketing technology experience, with **3\+ dedicated years** actively designing, building, and maintaining setups explicitly on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (formerly Customer Data Platform) framework.
* **Strong technical mastery** of Microsoft Dataverse, Power Platform structures, Azure data ecosystem tools (Data Lake, Synapse), SQL, advanced segmentation logic, and REST APIs.
* **Deep structural understanding** of big data concepts, semantic data modeling, customer lifecycle matrices, identity resolution strategies, and cloud governance frameworks.
* **Mandatory certification:** Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights Associate or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

  

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Prior experience implementing **Azure AI/ML studio integrations** to feed custom predictive models directly into Customer Insights profile grids.
* Familiarity with real\-time web/mobile tracking integrations utilizing JavaScript SDKs or enterprise tag management tools.

87646a84.title: Junior Architect
87646a84.description:
Junior Architect

Location: Calicut, Kerala – Onsite

Workplace: Kidzink Calicut Office, Office 2604, Tower 2, HiLITE Business Park, Palazhi, Kozhikode, Kerala

Experience: 2\+ years

Employment Type: Permanent

Salary: ₹30,000 – ₹55,000 per month

About the Role

We are looking for a passionate, energetic and motivated Junior Architect who wants to be actively involved in shaping projects, developing design ideas and taking responsibility for delivering high\-quality work.

The role offers hands\-on exposure to education\-led architecture, interior, fit\-out and construction projects, with involvement across design development, technical documentation, coordination and project delivery.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, thinks critically, solves problems and takes ownership of their work, with a genuine ambition to grow as an architect.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and contribute to architectural and interior design concepts from initial ideas through design development.
* Prepare and develop plans, elevations, sections, details, presentations and technical documentation.
* Translate design concepts into practical and buildable solutions.
* Coordinate architectural design with interior, structural, MEP, FF\&E, landscape and specialist consultants.
* Work closely with senior architects, designers, technical teams, consultants and contractors.
* Participate in design reviews, coordination meetings, client discussions and site visits.
* Identify design and technical issues and proactively work towards practical solutions.
* Assist with material selections, specifications, BOQs, schedules and construction documentation.
* Review drawings and information to ensure accuracy, coordination and design intent are maintained.
* Support projects through construction and develop an understanding of how design decisions translate into the built environment.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables, ensuring they are completed to a high standard and within agreed timelines.

Required Skills \& Experience

* 2\+ years of professional experience in architecture, interior design, fit\-out or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture or equivalent.
* Strong interest and understanding of architectural design and design development.
* Ability to develop ideas and contribute meaningfully to the design process.
* Good understanding of architectural drawings, detailing, materials, construction principles and buildability.
* Ability to translate design concepts and ideas into clear and coordinated project information.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to design quality.
* Good communication, coordination, organisation and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities and work with an appropriate level of independence.
* Ability to manage priorities and deliver high\-quality work within agreed programmes.

Preferred Skills \& Experience

* Experience in education, hospitality, retail or premium commercial fit\-out projects.
* Exposure to multidisciplinary design coordination.
* Experience with BIM\-based workflows and model coordination.
* Exposure to construction documentation, site coordination or project delivery.
* Experience working with international design consultants, clients or project teams.

What Success Looks Like

* Assigned design responsibilities are owned and progressed proactively with minimal follow\-up required.
* The architect actively contributes ideas and solutions rather than simply responding to instructions.
* Design work is thoughtful, well resolved and aligned with the project brief and overall design intent.
* Accurate, coordinated and well\-presented drawings and project information are delivered within programme.
* Design and technical issues are identified early, communicated clearly and followed through towards resolution.
* The architect demonstrates increasing confidence and independence in developing and presenting design solutions.
* Technical, design, software and project delivery knowledge continue to develop through each project.
* Feedback is actively sought, understood and applied to improve future work.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

This role serves as a trusted partner between business stakeholders and IT, providing functional expertise, solution design, application support, continuous improvement, and delivery of technology\-enabled business capabilities.  He or she manages solutions throughout their lifecycle, including analysis, design, implementation, adoption, optimization, support, and retirement. The role works closely with Sr. Solution Managers, business process owners, developers, vendors, and end users to ensure reliable, secure, and value\-driven technology solutions.

c8e7abaa.title: Customer Solutions Engineer
c8e7abaa.description:
Customer Solutions Engineer \- Forward Deployment Engineering
 




  






 Company: KAVIA AI
 





 Location: India — Remote
 





 Type: Full\-time
 





 Reports to: Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering
 





 Experience: 4–8 years
 





 Compensation: INR 20,00,000 to INR 28,00,000 annual CTC, based on background, experience, and demonstrated customer\-facing technical ownership
 




  






 About KAVIA AI
 





 KAVIA AI is an enterprise software company building the enterprise software engineering platform for complex codebases.
 





 We help engineering teams understand, plan, change, and validate large software systems. KAVIA connects code understanding, workflow automation, artifact generation, reviewable code, and validation across repositories and environments.
 





 Our platform is used by enterprise teams working on consequential software systems. As KAVIA’s product and customer footprint grow, we are expanding the customer engineering capability that turns difficult technical use cases into successful pilots and production adoption.
 




  






 The Role
 





 This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing engineering role at a growing enterprise software company. At KAVIA, the Customer Solutions Engineer serves as a Forward Deployed Engineer: part software engineer, part technical problem solver, and part pilot owner.
 





 Reporting to KAVIA’s Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering, you will work closely with enterprise engineering customers, KAVIA’s product and engineering teams, and company leadership. You will understand a customer’s codebase and operating constraints, demonstrate KAVIA against the right problem, translate that problem into a tightly scoped pilot, and stay accountable through technical validation.
 





 Success in this role is not measured by the number of demos delivered. It is measured by whether KAVIA earns technical confidence: the right problem is selected, the evaluation is credible, blockers are resolved, results are documented, and the customer can make an informed production decision.
 





 This is not a conventional sales\-engineering role built around standard demonstrations, and it is not a support role limited to routing issues. You must be comfortable reading unfamiliar code, working directly in technical environments, and communicating clearly with both engineers and senior stakeholders. The role requires regular overlap with US and European business hours and may include occasional customer travel.
 




  





 What You’ll Do
 

 Lead Technical Discovery
 
* Run structured discovery with engineering leaders, architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders.
* Understand the customer’s codebase, architecture, repositories, build and test systems, development workflow, constraints, and desired outcome.
* Separate the stated request from the underlying engineering problem, and identify where KAVIA can create measurable value.
* Surface dependencies, security or deployment requirements, data\-access constraints, technical risks, and decision criteria early.
* Determine whether an opportunity is technically ready for a demonstration or pilot, and say so clearly when it is not.



 Prepare and Deliver Tailored Demonstrations
 
* Design demonstrations around the customer’s actual use case rather than rely on a generic product walkthrough.
* Select representative code, workflows, and evidence that make KAVIA’s value understandable and technically credible.
* Configure and test the demonstration environment, anticipate likely questions, and prepare recovery paths when live systems behave unexpectedly.
* Explain KAVIA’s reasoning, outputs, limitations, and deployment options with precision and without overclaiming.
* Capture questions and objections, follow up with clear technical answers, and identify what must be proven next.



 Convert Use Cases into Well\-Scoped Pilots
 
* Translate discovery into a concise pilot definition with a clear problem statement, scope, inputs, deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, schedule, and acceptance criteria.
* Define success measures that compare KAVIA\-assisted work with the customer’s current process, including time, effort, quality, completeness, or validation outcomes where appropriate.
* Keep pilots narrow enough to execute quickly while meaningful enough to support a purchase or deployment decision.
* Align customer and internal stakeholders on what is in scope, what is not, and what evidence will constitute success before work begins.



 Own Pilot Execution and Resolve Technical Blockers
 
* Serve as the technical owner for assigned pilots from kickoff through final validation.
* Work directly with repositories, manifests, branches, build systems, APIs, development environments, and deployment configurations as required by the engagement.
* Use KAVIA hands\-on to investigate the customer’s problem, generate or review outputs, and validate results against agreed criteria.
* Diagnose blockers, distinguish product issues from environment or integration issues, and coordinate the right engineering response without losing momentum.
* Maintain a clear execution plan, technical decision log, risk list, and next action for every active pilot.
* Escalate product gaps and delivery risks early, with enough evidence for engineering and leadership to act.



 Move Customers to Technical Validation
 
* Design and run the final validation against the agreed acceptance criteria, including build, test, review, or workflow evidence where applicable.
* Present results honestly, including what worked, what remains unresolved, and what would be required for production use.
* Quantify before\-and\-after outcomes when the evidence supports them and avoid unsupported or inflated claims.
* Produce the technical readout, recommendations, open issues, and proposed next step needed for the customer and KAVIA to make a decision.
* Support the transition from successful pilot to deployment, expansion, or a clearly defined follow\-on phase.



 Turn Customer Learning into Reusable Assets
 
* Write concise technical follow\-ups, solution notes, pilot plans, validation summaries, runbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Contribute credible technical evidence and approved results to case studies, sales collateral, product documentation, and enablement material.
* Convert repeated customer patterns into reusable demo assets, pilot templates, checklists, and internal playbooks.
* Bring structured customer feedback to product and engineering, distinguishing one\-off requests from broadly valuable product improvements.
* Help improve KAVIA’s customer\-engineering methods as the company builds a repeatable enterprise adoption motion.



 What We’re Looking For
 

 Required
 
* 4–8 years of professional software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation engineering, or forward deployed engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on technical ownership.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and production experience in at least one widely used programming language such as Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, C, or C\+\+.
* Ability to enter an unfamiliar codebase, form a useful system model, trace dependencies, diagnose failures, and make progress without a fully specified playbook.
* Working knowledge of Git\-based development, APIs, build and test workflows, CI/CD, containers, cloud or on\-premises environments, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience leading technical discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, implementations, or similarly bounded customer engagements.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous customer problem into a clear technical plan, measurable success criteria, and disciplined execution.
* Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to explain complex technical matters to engineers, executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Sound judgment under pressure, intellectual honesty about product limitations, and the confidence to challenge an unworkable scope or unsupported claim.
* Strong project ownership, including action tracking, risk management, documentation, follow\-through, and timely escalation.
* Ability to maintain dependable overlap with US or European business hours when customer meetings and pilot execution require it.
* Comfort working in a startup environment where priorities change, processes are still being built, and customer outcomes matter more than role boundaries.



 Strong Plus
 
* Experience with enterprise developer tools, AI\-assisted software engineering, code intelligence, software modernization, testing, or engineering productivity platforms.
* Experience with complex brownfield systems, multi\-repository codebases, embedded Linux, Android, Yocto, RDK, OpenWrt, automotive software, telecom software, or similar platform environments.
* Experience designing secure enterprise deployments, including customer\-controlled cloud, self\-hosted, restricted\-network, or air\-gapped environments.
* Experience working with large language models, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, or evaluation frameworks.
* Experience gathering defensible before\-and\-after metrics and presenting technical validation results to enterprise decision\-makers.
* Experience working across product, engineering, sales, and customer teams without losing clarity about technical ownership.
* Startup experience or a record of building repeatable methods from early customer engagements.




 A Note from KAVIA
 





 We are not looking for someone who has used every technology or worked in every domain listed above.
 





 We are looking for a strong, hands\-on engineer who can earn trust with enterprise customers, bring structure to ambiguous technical work, and stay accountable until the customer has credible evidence. Applicants with demonstrated engineering depth and customer\-facing ownership are encouraged to apply, even if their current title is not Customer Solutions Engineer or Forward Deployment Engineer.

 Full\-time
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Mainframe Infrastructure Architect to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout the presales cycle, focusing on mainframe solutions and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe environments, coupled with exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including C\-level executives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Solution Design \& Architecture:
+ Lead the design and definition of overall mainframe infrastructure solutionframeworks for mainframe components within client proposals and bids.
+ Analyze client requirements, existing IT landscapes, and business objectives to architect tailor\-made mainframe solutions, including on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid models.
+ Develop detailed architectural designs, high\-level designs, and associated documentation (e.g., application views, multiple sections \& views, artefacts).
+ Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate mainframe systems with the broader technology ecosystem.
+ Identify improvements, options, and tradeoffs to define target state solutions.

* Presales \& Client Engagement:
+ Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the presales phase, supporting the sales team in all technical aspects.
+ Engage directly with clients, including C\-level executives, technical decision\-makers, and business stakeholders, to understand their challenges and demonstrate how our mainframe solutions can address their needs.
+ Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs\-of\-concept (POCs).
+ Collaborate with sales, program/project, and consulting teams to ensure proposed solutions align with client expectations and internal capabilities.
+ Participate in the development of RFP/RFS responses, providing technical analysis, cost estimations, and architectural validation.
+ Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

* Mainframe Modernization \& Innovation:
+ Provide technical and strategic input for mainframe modernization strategies, including re\-hosting, refactoring, re\-platforming, and rewriting initiatives.
+ Guide customers in planning, evaluating, architecting, and re\-engineering legacy applications to leverage modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
+ Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML for modernization), and best practices in mainframe and cloud landscapes.
+ Contribute to the development of white papers, case studies, and thought leadership content related to mainframe solutions and modernization.

* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:
+ Provide technical leadership to design, development, and implementation teams for custom solutions.
+ Mentor developers, designers, and junior architects, fostering their growth and enhancing their capabilities.
+ Contribute to internal architecture practices by conducting interviews and sharing knowledge.

* Costing \& Risk Management:
+ Develop fully costed solution architectures and provide accurate cost estimates for mainframe solution implementation (such as MFaaS) and ongoing support.
+ Identify implementation risks and potential impacts, proposing mitigation strategies.
+ Validate solutions from a technology, cost structure, and customer differentiation perspective.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Typically 12\+ years of experience in a technology environment, with a strong focus on mainframe infrastructure solutions
* Minimum of 5\+ years of hands\-on technical experience with mainframe systems and technologies such as:
+ Languages: COBOL, JCL, PL/I, Assembler, REXX, Natural, RPG.
+ Databases: DB2 for z/OS, IMS DB, VSAM, Adabas.
+ Transaction Managers: CICS, IMS TM.
+ Operating Systems: z/OS, z/VM, zLinux.
+ Middleware: MQ, WebSphere.
+ Tools: IBM Debug Tool for z/OS, Syncsort, SPUFI, ChangeMan, Endevor, CA\-7/ESP/Control\-M (Job Schedulers).

* Proven experience in designing and delivering complex mainframe solutions, including large\-scale migrations and modernizations.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience in architecting solutions for mainframe to cloud migration/integration and tools like Zowe, OpenShift, Wazi
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
* Proven presentation skills, comfortable presenting to large groups and executive levels.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Willingness to travel as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer Engineering / relevant
* Experience with specific mainframe modernization tools and patterns (re\-architecture, rewrite, refactor, rehost).
* Familiarity with distributed client\-server architecture systems.
* Exposure to GenAI technologies (LLMs, NLP) for application modernization assessments or code transformation.
* Experience with ITILv3 or ITSM principles.
* IBM Mainframe administration certification

 The position requires
 **hands\-on Azure deployment skills** 
 and
 **basic Active Directory knowledge**

 This is primarily a
 **project delivery and implementation role** 
 , with limited post\-go\-live stabilization support.

----------------------------


* Manage and grow assigned program’s patient engagement and site utilization

**Job Description**
 About the job
   

  

**About Comprinno**
 Comprinno is a NASSCOM\-incubated company headquartered in Bangalore, with offices in Pune, Coimbatore, and the United States. We specialize in cloud transformation, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and Artificial Intelligence, enabling organizations to build scalable, secure, and high\-performing cloud environments on AWS. Our flagship SaaS platform, Tevico, offers intelligent cloud governance and observability for AWS workloads. It helps enterprises improve uptime, reduce costs, and ensure compliance by proactively detecting anomalies and triggering automated remediation workflows. As a trusted partner to both startups and enterprises, we combine deep cloud expertise with a customer\-first mindset. Our services span Cloud Migration, Modernization, Security, Managed Services, Data Analytics, and Generative AI solutions, driving innovation and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a dynamic and customer\-focused Presales Engineer – Cloud \& AI to support our Cloud Transformation, Modernization, Managed Services, and AI/GenAI practices. This role is pivotal in shaping technical solutions for prospective customers, driving value\-based conversations, and bridging the gap between customer challenges and Comprinno's cloud and AI capabilities.
